Geomorfologik tahlil va himoya choralarini tanlash tartibi berilgan. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: o‘zani tez o‘zgaradigan Markaziy Osiyo daryolari ustidagi inshootlar uchun foydali.

title: Urban Drainage Design (HEC-22, 4th ed., FHWA-HIF-24-006)
abs: The 2024 fourth edition of FHWA's urban drainage manual covering pavement drainage, inlets, storm drains, detention and stormwater quality for highways in built-up areas. It replaces the 2009 third edition.

uz.t: Shahar hududida suv qochirishni loyihalash (HEC-22, 4-nashr)
uz.ab: 2024-yilgi nashr qatnov qismidan suvni qochirish, suv qabul qilgichlar, yomg‘ir kanalizatsiyasi va suvni ushlab turish inshootlarini loyihalashni qamrab oladi. Avvalgi 2009-yilgi nashr o‘rnini bosadi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: shahar ko‘chalari va aylanma yo‘llarda suv to‘planishi muammosini hal qilishda qo‘llanma bo‘ladi.

title: Highway Hydrology (HDS-2, 3rd ed., FHWA-HIF-24-007)
abs: Third edition (2024) of FHWA Hydraulic Design Series 2 on estimating design flows for highway drainage structures. It covers rainfall and runoff methods, statistical flood analysis and hydrographs.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llari gidrologiyasi (HDS-2, 3-nashr)
uz.ab: Qo‘llanma yo‘l suv o‘tkazish inshootlari uchun hisobiy suv sarfini aniqlash usullarini — yog‘in-oqim modellari, toshqinlarni statistik tahlili va gidrograflarni — bayon qiladi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: sel va toshqin xavfi yuqori tog‘oldi hududlarida quvur va ko‘priklarni to‘g‘ri o‘lchamlash uchun zarur.

title: Design of Roadside Channels with Flexible Linings (HEC-15, 3rd ed., FHWA-NHI-05-114)
abs: FHWA circular on designing stable roadside ditches with vegetation, riprap, gabions and manufactured flexible linings. It gives the shear-stress based design procedure and examples.

uz.t: Yo‘l bo‘yi ariqlarini egiluvchan qoplamalar bilan loyihalash (HEC-15)
uz.ab: Sirkulyar kyuvet va ariqlarni o‘t, tosh to‘kma, gabion va boshqa egiluvchan qoplamalar bilan eroziyadan himoyalash usulini beradi. Urinma kuchlanishga asoslangan hisob tartibi misollar bilan keltirilgan. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: yo‘l poyi yon ariqlarining yuvilishini kamaytirish uchun amaliy usul.

title: Hydraulic Design of Energy Dissipators for Culverts and Channels (HEC-14, 3rd ed., FHWA-NHI-06-086)
abs: FHWA manual on predicting erosion at culvert outlets and designing energy dissipators such as riprap aprons, drop structures and stilling basins.

uz.t: Quvurlar va kanallar uchun energiya so‘ndirgichlarni gidravlik loyihalash (HEC-14)
uz.ab: Qo‘llanma quvur chiqishidagi yuvilishni bashorat qilish va tosh to‘shamalar, pog‘onali inshootlar, tinchlantirish havzalarini loyihalash usullarini beradi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: qiya joylardagi yo‘l quvurlari chiqishida eroziyaning oldini olishda qo‘llaniladi.

title: Hydraulic Design of Highway Culverts, Third Edition (HDS-5, FHWA-HIF-12-026)
abs: FHWA's main reference on hydraulic design of highway culverts, covering inlet and outlet control, improved inlets and design procedures. The record page on the FHWA hydraulics library links to the full PDF (about 49 MB).

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘li suv o‘tkazgich quvurlarini gidravlik loyihalash (HDS-5, 3-nashr)
uz.ab: Qo‘llanma quvurlarning kirish va chiqish nazorati rejimlari, takomillashtirilgan kirish qismlari va loyihalash tartibini batafsil yoritadi. Sahifada to‘liq PDF (taxminan 49 MB) havolasi bor. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: yo‘l tarmog‘idagi minglab quvurlarni hisoblash va qayta tiklashda asosiy manba.

title: LRFD Seismic Analysis and Design of Transportation Geotechnical Features and Structural Foundations (GEC 3, FHWA-NHI-11-032)
abs: FHWA reference manual on seismic hazard analysis, site response, liquefaction, slopes, retaining walls and foundations for transportation structures under LRFD. It serves as Geotechnical Engineering Circular No. 3.

uz.t: Transport geotexnik elementlari va poydevorlarini LRFD bo‘yicha seysmik hisoblash (GEC 3)
uz.ab: Qo‘llanma seysmik xavfni baholash, gruntning seysmik javobi, suyuqlanish, qiyaliklar, tirgak devorlar va poydevorlarni zilzilaga hisoblashni qamrab oladi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: seysmik faol O‘zbekistonda ko‘priklar va yo‘l ko‘tarmalarini loyihalashda juda dolzarb.

title: Design and Construction of Mechanically Stabilized Earth (MSE) Walls (GEC 11, FHWA-HIF-24-002)
abs: The 2023 update of FHWA Geotechnical Engineering Circular 11 on design and construction of mechanically stabilized earth walls. It covers materials, LRFD design, construction control and inspection.

uz.t: Mexanik mustahkamlangan grunt (armogrunt) devorlarini loyihalash va qurish (GEC 11, 2023)
uz.ab: 2023-yilgi yangilangan sirkulyar armogrunt devorlar uchun materiallar, LRFD hisobi, qurilish nazorati va tekshiruvni bayon qiladi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: yo‘l o‘tkazgichlar va tog‘ yo‘llarida tirgak devorlarni arzonroq qurish imkonini beradi.

title: Ground Modification Methods Reference Manual, Volume I (GEC 13, FHWA-NHI-16-027)
abs: Volume I of FHWA's reference manual on ground improvement techniques for transportation projects, including densification, consolidation, reinforcement and chemical stabilisation of weak soils.

uz.t: Gruntlarni mustahkamlash usullari bo‘yicha qo‘llanma, I jild (GEC 13)
uz.ab: Qo‘llanma zaif gruntlarni zichlash, konsolidatsiyalash, armirlash va kimyoviy barqarorlashtirish texnologiyalarini tanlash va loyihalashni yoritadi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: cho‘kuvchan lyoss va sho‘rlangan gruntlarda yo‘l poyi qurishda dolzarb.

title: Geotechnical Aspects of Pavements (FHWA-NHI-05-037)
abs: NHI reference manual linking geotechnical engineering with pavement design: subgrade characterisation, unbound base materials, drainage and subgrade stabilisation for flexible and rigid pavements.

uz.t: Yo‘l to‘shamalarining geotexnik jihatlari
uz.ab: Qo‘llanma yo‘l poyi gruntini tavsiflash, bog‘lanmagan asos materiallari, drenaj va gruntni barqarorlashtirishni qattiq va nobikr to‘shamalar loyihasi bilan bog‘laydi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: to‘shamalarning muddatidan oldin buzilishi ko‘pincha grunt asosga bog‘liq bo‘lgani uchun muhim.

title: Geohazards, Extreme Weather Events, and Climate Change Resilience Manual (FHWA-HIF-23-008)
abs: FHWA manual (2023) on assessing and managing geohazards such as landslides, rockfall and debris flows on highways in the context of extreme weather and climate change.

uz.t: Geoxavflar, ekstremal ob-havo va iqlim o‘zgarishiga chidamlilik qo‘llanmasi
uz.ab: Qo‘llanma ko‘chki, tosh qulashi va sel kabi geoxavflarni ekstremal ob-havo va iqlim o‘zgarishi sharoitida baholash va boshqarishni bayon qiladi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: Qamchiq, Toshkent–O‘sh kabi tog‘ yo‘llarida ko‘chki va sel xavfini boshqarishga mos.

title: Capturing the Durability of High Recycled Binder Ratio Asphalt Mixtures (NCHRP Research Report 1130)
abs: NCHRP Project 09-65 report proposing a stepwise mix design approach for asphalt mixtures with high recycled binder ratios (RAP, RAS) that keeps cracking, rutting and moisture resistance. The read-online page gives free access; the PDF can be downloaded as guest.

uz.t: Qayta ishlangan bog‘lovchi ulushi yuqori asfalt aralashmalarining chidamliligi (NCHRP 1130)
uz.ab: Hisobot RAP va RAS ulushi yuqori aralashmalarni yorilish, iz hosil bo‘lishi va namlikka chidamliligini saqlagan holda loyihalash bosqichlarini taklif qiladi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: eski qoplamani qayta ishlash orqali bitum va chaqiqtoshni tejash imkonini beradi.

title: AI Applications for Automatic Pavement Condition Evaluation (NCHRP Synthesis 636)
abs: Synthesis of US state DOT practice in automated pavement distress detection and machine learning for condition evaluation, based on a literature review, survey and interviews. It notes integration and ground-truth challenges.

uz.t: Qoplama holatini avtomatik baholashda sun’iy intellekt (NCHRP Synthesis 636)
uz.ab: Sintez AQSh shtat transport departamentlarida qoplama nuqsonlarini avtomatik aniqlash va mashinaviy o‘qitishni qo‘llash tajribasini umumlashtiradi. Ma’lumotlarni integratsiyalash va etalon ma’lumotlar muammolari qayd etilgan. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: yo‘l holatini raqamli monitoring qilish tizimini yaratishda tayyor tajriba.

title: LTPP Data Analysis: Improving Use of FWD and Longitudinal Profile Measurements (NCHRP Web-Only Document 416)
abs: NCHRP Project 20-50(22)A study using LTPP data on how climate affects pavement response, with procedures for adjusting falling weight deflectometer deflections and assessing curl and warp of concrete slabs from profile data.

uz.t: LTPP ma’lumotlari tahlili: FWD va bo‘ylama profil o‘lchovlaridan foydalanishni takomillashtirish
uz.ab: Tadqiqot iqlimning qoplama javobiga ta’sirini o‘rganib, FWD egilishlarini harorat va mavsumga moslash hamda beton plitalarning qiyshayishini baholash usullarini beradi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: keskin kontinental iqlimda FWD sinovlarini to‘g‘ri talqin qilish uchun kerak.

title: Considerations for the Design and Construction of Bonded and Unbonded Post-Tensioned Concrete Bridge Elements (NCHRP Research Report 1139)
abs: NCHRP Project 12-118 report on post-tensioned concrete bridge elements with unbonded or mixed bonded/unbonded tendons, which ease tendon replacement given durability concerns with grouted tendons. Companion appendices are in NCHRP Web-Only Document 417.

uz.t: Bog‘langan va bog‘lanmagan arqonli oldindan zo‘riqtirilgan beton ko‘prik elementlarini loyihalash va qurish (NCHRP 1139)
uz.ab: Hisobot bog‘lanmagan yoki aralash arqonli zo‘riqtirilgan beton elementlarni qo‘llash, ularning afzalliklari va loyihalash tavsiyalarini ko‘rib chiqadi. Ilovalar NCHRP Web-Only 417 hujjatida. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: zamonaviy uzun oraliqli beton ko‘priklarning chidamliligini oshirishda foydali.

title: Highway Design Manual (HDM), 7th Edition
abs: Caltrans' 7th edition design manual setting standards for geometric design, drainage, pavements, bicycle facilities and other elements of California state highways. The page offers chapter PDFs and a combined PDF updated in August 2025.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash qo‘llanmasi (Caltrans HDM, 7-nashr)
uz.ab: Kaliforniya transport departamentining qo‘llanmasi geometrik loyiha, suv qochirish, yo‘l to‘shamalari, velosiped yo‘laklari va boshqa elementlar bo‘yicha standartlarni belgilaydi. Sahifada boblar va 2025-yil avgustdagi yig‘ma PDF mavjud. O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ahamiyati: seysmik va issiq-quruq iqlimli shtat tajribasi O‘zbekiston normalarini yangilashda taqqoslash uchun qulay.

title: Conducting experimental studies of cement concrete pavement joints
abs: Field study of step faulting and settlement at transverse joints of cement concrete slabs on a section of highway A-380 under hot, dry climate. Slab steps were measured with an electronic caliper, and longitudinal evenness from a mobile laboratory was correlated with IRI. Published in E3S Web of Conferences 401 (CONMECHYDRO-2023), open access.

uz.t: Sement-beton qoplama choklarini eksperimental tadqiq qilish
uz.ab: A-380 avtomobil yo‘lining uchastkasida sement-beton plitalarning ko‘ndalang choklaridagi pog‘ona va cho‘kishlar o‘lchangan hamda ular IRI ravonlik ko‘rsatkichi bilan bog‘langan. Issiq-quruq iqlimda qurilgan sement-beton yo‘llarni ekspluatatsiya qilish va ta’mirlashni rejalashtirish uchun bevosita foydali.

title: The effect comparative evaluation of energy-saving additives on the bitumen properties
abs: Experimental comparison of energy-saving (warm-mix type) additives used in Uzbek road construction and their influence on standard, adhesive and rheological properties of viscous petroleum road bitumen. E3S Web of Conferences 401, 05028 (2023), open access.

uz.t: Energiya tejovchi qo‘shimchalarning bitum xossalariga ta’sirini qiyosiy baholash
uz.ab: O‘zbekiston yo‘l qurilishida qo‘llanayotgan energiya tejovchi qo‘shimchalarning neft yo‘l bitumining standart, adgezion va reologik xossalariga ta’siri tajribada aniqlangan. Asfaltbeton ishlab chiqarishda harorat va yoqilg‘i sarfini kamaytirish yechimlarini tanlashda qo‘l keladi.

title: Анализ и применение технологии литого сероасфальтбетона на автомобильных дорогах Республики Узбекистан
abs: Conference paper (BNTU, Minsk, 2022) reviewing cast asphalt concrete and its properties, and presenting sulfur bitumen obtained by a new modification method together with its application on roads of Uzbekistan. Open repository record with full-text PDF.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston avtomobil yo‘llarida quyma oltingugurtli asfaltbeton texnologiyasini tahlil qilish va qo‘llash
uz.ab: Quyma asfaltbetonning xossalari ko‘rib chiqilib, bitumni oltingugurt bilan modifikatsiyalashning yangi usuli va uning O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida qo‘llanishi bayon etilgan. Mahalliy oltingugurt resursidan foydalanib bardoshli qoplamalar yaratish uchun muhim.

title: Research on methods for effective use of machines in kit in construction and repair of asphalt concrete pavement
abs: Proposes a methodology for efficient use of asphalt pavers and haul trucks as a machine set, focusing on cost and productivity of hauling and laying asphalt mix, and an optimisation algorithm for the fleet in construction and repair works. E3S Web of Conferences 401, 02054 (2023).

uz.t: Asfaltbeton qoplamani qurish va ta’mirlashda mashinalar komplektidan samarali foydalanish usullarini tadqiq qilish
uz.ab: Asfaltbeton qorishmasini tashish va yotqizishda mashinalar to‘plamining unumdorligi va tannarxini optimallashtirish algoritmi taklif etilgan. Yo‘l pudratchilari texnika parkini rejalashtirishda amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

title: Technology of obtaining a binder for the base of asphalt roads and roofing
abs: Describes processing of local Mubarek oil sludge into a binder for road bases and roofing, including an oxidation route to an asphalt binder and chemical/elemental analysis of the dehydrated sludge. E3S Web of Conferences 264, 05026 (2021).

uz.t: Asfalt yo‘llar asosi va tom yopish uchun bog‘lovchi olish texnologiyasi
uz.ab: Muborak neft shlamini qayta ishlab yo‘l asoslari uchun bog‘lovchi olish usuli va uning kimyoviy tarkibi keltirilgan. Mahalliy chiqindilardan yo‘l qurilish materiali olish va importni kamaytirish nuqtai nazaridan dolzarb.

title: Calculation of monolithic bridges taking into account seismic conditions of Republic of Uzbekistan
abs: Dynamic analysis of a monolithic overpass on highway M-39 near Samarkand using two real accelerograms (Gazli and Manjil). Concludes that seismic checks of transport structures should use record sets with dominant frequencies close to site conditions and that this should be reflected in regulations. E3S Web of Conferences 365, 02005 (2023).

uz.t: O‘zbekiston seysmik sharoitini hisobga olgan holda monolit ko‘priklarni hisoblash
uz.ab: Samarqand yaqinidagi M-39 yo‘lidagi monolit estakada Gazli va Manjil zilzilalari yozuvlari bilan dinamik hisoblangan. Seysmik hududlarda ko‘priklarni loyihalash me’yorlarini takomillashtirish uchun tavsiyalar beradi.

title: Calculation of the stress-strain state of monolithic bridges on the action of real seismic impacts
abs: Models a monolithic bridge on the M-39 highway near Samarkand under real Gazli and Manjil records, analysing longitudinal/vertical displacements and normal stresses along the span; finds safety margins for an 8-point MSK-64 event. E3S Web of Conferences 401, 05080 (2023).

uz.t: Real seysmik ta’sirlarda monolit ko‘priklarning kuchlanish-deformatsiya holatini hisoblash
uz.ab: M-39 yo‘lidagi monolit ko‘prik oralig‘idagi siljish va normal kuchlanishlar real zilzila yozuvlari asosida tahlil qilingan. O‘zbekistondagi ko‘priklarning seysmik bardoshliligini baholashda namunaviy yondashuv.

title: Безопасность дорожного движения в Республике Узбекистан
abs: Short paper in a BNTU collection (2022) examining road traffic safety on the roads of Uzbekistan and arguing for automating the diagnosis of road safety conditions. Open repository record with PDF.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston Respublikasida yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi
uz.ab: O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida harakat xavfsizligi holati ko‘rib chiqilib, xavfsizlikni diagnostika qilish jarayonini avtomatlashtirish zarurligi asoslangan. Yo‘l xavfsizligi auditi tizimini rivojlantirish uchun foydali manba.

title: Calculation of the dynamic effects of a monolithic overpass taking into account the post-tensioning of the span rope on the basis of real earthquake records
abs: Seismic analysis of a 120 m monolithic road overpass in Jizzakh (8-point zone) over the Tashkent–Samarkand high-speed railway, using Gazli accelerograms and accounting for post-tensioned tendons. Published in the Science and innovation journal and archived on Zenodo with PDF.

uz.t: Real zilzila yozuvlari asosida oraliq arqonini oldindan zo‘riqtirishni hisobga olib monolit estakadaning dinamik ta’sirlarini hisoblash
uz.ab: Jizzaxdagi 120 metrli monolit avtomobil estakadasining 9 ballgacha zilzilalarga bardoshliligi real akselerogrammalar bilan baholangan. Seysmik hududlarda zamonaviy estakadalarni loyihalash amaliyoti uchun dolzarb.

title: Mechanical and moisture performance of asphalt concrete containing polyurethane-coated basalt fiber and recycled polyethylene
abs: Laboratory study of a composite additive of polyurethane-coated basalt fibre and recycled polyethylene for dense-graded and stone-mastic asphalt, reporting higher stability, tensile strength and lower moisture susceptibility, plus partial reuse of RAP. Vibroengineering Procedia 62 (2026), open access.

uz.t: Poliuretan qoplangan bazalt tola va qayta ishlangan polietilen qo‘shilgan asfaltbetonning mexanik va namga chidamlilik ko‘rsatkichlari
uz.ab: Bazalt tola va ikkilamchi polietilendan iborat qo‘shimcha asfaltbetonning mustahkamligi va suvga chidamliligini oshirishi laboratoriyada ko‘rsatilgan. Keskin harorat o‘zgarishi va og‘ir harakatli O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun mo‘ljallangan.

title: The effect of shale mineral powder on the strength of asphalt concrete
abs: Develops a mineral filler from local shale (Samarkand and Jizzakh regions) for fine-grained hot dense asphalt concrete; tests show lower water absorption and compressive strength at 60–70°C above GOST 9128-2013 requirements, with reduced filler and bitumen content. E3S Web of Conferences 264, 02052 (2021).

uz.t: Slanets mineral kukunining asfaltbeton mustahkamligiga ta’siri
uz.ab: Samarqand va Jizzax slanetslaridan olingan mineral kukun asfaltbetonning yuqori haroratdagi mustahkamligini oshirishi va bitum sarfini kamaytirishi ko‘rsatilgan. Mahalliy xomashyodan foydalanib yozgi izlanishga (kolei) qarshi qoplamalar yaratish uchun muhim.

title: Review of chemical methods for road pavement stabilization: prospects for application in Uzbekistan
abs: Review of nanomaterial and polymer additives (nanosilica, nanoclays, carbon nanotubes, polymers) for stabilising subgrade soils, with recommendations by soil type and climate zone for Uzbekistan’s loess and silty clays. Vibroengineering Procedia 58 (2025), open access review.

uz.t: Yo‘l asoslarini kimyoviy stabilizatsiyalash usullari sharhi: O‘zbekistonda qo‘llash istiqbollari
uz.ab: Nanomateriallar va polimerlar yordamida yo‘l poyi gruntlarini mustahkamlash usullari solishtirilib, O‘zbekistonning lyoss va changsimon gruntlariga mos tavsiyalar berilgan. Cho‘kuvchan gruntlarda yo‘l qurishda usul tanlash uchun foydali.

title: Crack investigation on automobile roads in Tashkent region
abs: Field surveys of road sections in Tashkent region with different traffic, climate and pavement age, recording crack types, widths, lengths and spacing to explain how materials, traffic stresses and environment drive cracking. Vibroengineering Procedia 62 (2026), open access.

uz.t: Toshkent viloyati avtomobil yo‘llaridagi yoriqlarni tadqiq qilish
uz.ab: Toshkent viloyatidagi turli yoshdagi qoplamalarda yoriqlarning turi, kengligi va oralig‘i dala sharoitida qayd etilgan. Yo‘llarni saqlash va ta’mirlashni rejalashtirishda mahalliy ma’lumot bazasi sifatida muhim.

title: Some issues of forecasting crack formation on automobile roads
abs: Discusses causes and development of cracking in asphalt concrete highway pavements, its effect on bearing capacity and safety, and the need for a crack database, using Uzbek regulations and Tashkent-region crack and temperature data. Vibroengineering Procedia 62 (2026), open access.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llarida yoriq hosil bo‘lishini prognozlashning ayrim masalalari
uz.ab: Asfaltbeton qoplamalarda yoriqlar paydo bo‘lish sabablari va rivojlanishi tahlil qilinib, yoriqlar ma’lumotlar bazasini yaratish taklif etilgan. Qoplamalar xizmat muddatini bashorat qilish uchun dolzarb.

title: Improvement of the physical and mechanical properties of crushed stone used in the construction of asphalt concrete pavements
abs: Laboratory study on improving crushed stone for asphalt concrete: grading, dust contamination and aggregate–bitumen adhesion, using the TITAN additive which significantly improved bonding. Vibroengineering Procedia 62 (2026), open access.

uz.t: Asfaltbeton qoplamalar qurilishida ishlatiladigan chaqiq toshning fizik-mexanik xossalarini yaxshilash
uz.ab: Chaqiq toshning donadorligi, changlanganligi va bitum bilan yopishishi o‘rganilib, adgezion qo‘shimcha samaradorligi ko‘rsatilgan. Mahalliy karyer materiallari sifatini oshirish uchun foydali.

title: Road zoning in the Fergana Valley based on the level of traffic safety
abs: Develops a traffic-safety zoning method for roads of the Fergana Valley combining crash statistics, road geometry, pavement condition, traffic and climate into a composite indicator, yielding safety categories for planning and countermeasures. Vibroengineering Procedia 60 (2025), open access.

uz.t: Farg‘ona vodiysi yo‘llarini harakat xavfsizligi darajasi bo‘yicha rayonlashtirish
uz.ab: Avariyalar statistikasi, yo‘l geometriyasi va harakat jadalligi asosida Farg‘ona vodiysi yo‘llari xavfsizlik toifalariga ajratilgan. Hududiy yo‘l xavfsizligi dasturlari va xavfli uchastkalarni bartaraf etishda bevosita qo‘llanadi.

title: Modern strengthening techniques for enhancing the load-carrying capacity of in-service road bridges in Uzbekistan
abs: Compares strengthening methods for in-service road bridges in Uzbekistan — section enlargement, external prestressing/continuity and CFRP — with a worked 12 m RC girder example and practical notes for arid climate. Vibroengineering Procedia 60 (2025), open access.

uz.t: O‘zbekistonda foydalanilayotgan avtomobil ko‘priklarining yuk ko‘tarish qobiliyatini oshirishning zamonaviy kuchaytirish usullari
uz.ab: Ekspluatatsiyadagi ko‘priklarni an’anaviy, tashqi zo‘riqtirish va uglerod tolali kompozitlar bilan kuchaytirish usullari solishtirilgan. Eskirgan ko‘priklarni rekonstruksiya qilish dasturlari uchun amaliy qo‘llanma vazifasini o‘taydi.

title: New composition of film-forming materials for maintaining freshly laid cement-concrete road pavements
abs: Develops a curing compound for fresh concrete pavements based on ‘Gach’, a local petroleum wax by-product, compared with imported products; lab tests show effective film at lower application rates and lower curing cost. Vibroengineering Procedia 60 (2025), open access.

uz.t: Yangi yotqizilgan sement-beton yo‘l qoplamalarini parvarishlash uchun plyonka hosil qiluvchi materiallarning yangi tarkibi
uz.ab: Mahalliy neft mumi chiqindisi asosida sement-beton qoplamani parvarishlash tarkibi ishlab chiqilib, import mahsulotlar bilan solishtirilgan. Sement-beton yo‘llar qurilishini kengaytirish sharoitida mahalliylashtirish uchun muhim.

title: Technology for producing modified polymer sulfur bitumen and its properties
abs: Method for producing polymer–sulfur bitumen for hot climates by blending sulfur and polymer modifiers at controlled temperatures; 3% polyethylene wax raised softening point and viscosity. Vibroengineering Procedia 60 (2025), open access.

uz.t: Modifikatsiyalangan polimer-oltingugurtli bitum olish texnologiyasi va uning xossalari
uz.ab: Oltingugurt va polimer qo‘shimchalar bilan bitumning issiqqa chidamliligini oshirish texnologiyasi taklif etilgan. Issiq iqlimli O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun arzon va bardoshli bog‘lovchi yaratishda dolzarb.

title: Optimization of polymer-sulfur asphalt concrete composition for high-temperature pavement applications
abs: Selection and calculation of polymer–sulfur asphalt concrete compositions resistant to high temperatures, with granite aggregates and activated shale filler from Samarkand region; seven mixes tested for physical-mechanical properties. Vibroengineering Procedia 62 (2026), open access.

uz.t: Yuqori haroratli sharoit uchun polimer-oltingugurtli asfaltbeton tarkibini optimallashtirish
uz.ab: Samarqand materiallari asosida yetti xil polimer-oltingugurtli asfaltbeton tarkibi sinovdan o‘tkazilgan. IV–V yo‘l-iqlim zonalarida kolei paydo bo‘lishiga qarshi qoplamalar uchun muhim.

title: Dynamic interaction of bridge spans and piers as a tuned system for seismic load reduction
abs: Treats the bridge span as a tuned dynamic element to reduce pier seismic response, using a 2-DOF model and parametric selection of span–support stiffness and damping; case study of a highway bridge over the Chirchik River (7–9 point zone). Vibroengineering Procedia 62 (2026), open access.

uz.t: Seysmik yuklamani kamaytirish uchun ko‘prik oraliq qurilmasi va tayanchlarining sozlangan tizim sifatida dinamik o‘zaro ta’siri
uz.ab: Chirchiq daryosi ustidagi avtomobil ko‘prigi misolida oraliq qurilmani dinamik so‘ndirgich sifatida ishlatib, tayanchlardagi eguvchi momentni kamaytirish ko‘rsatilgan. Seysmik faol O‘zbekistonda ko‘priklarni tejamkor loyihalash uchun foydali.

title: Estimation of a monolithic reinforced concrete overpass under the seismic effect
abs: Linear spectral finite-element analysis (Midas Civil) of a continuous monolithic RC overpass at km 1083 of highway M-39 in Samarkand; pile-soil pressures within limits, with peak moment near pile head recommended for strengthening. Vibroengineering Procedia 62 (2026), open access.

uz.t: Seysmik ta’sir ostida monolit temirbeton estakadani baholash
uz.ab: Samarqanddagi M-39 yo‘lining 1083-km dagi estakadasi chekli elementlar usulida seysmik hisoblangan va qoziq boshini kuchaytirish tavsiya etilgan. Magistral yo‘llardagi sun’iy inshootlar seysmik xavfsizligi uchun muhim.

title: Avtomobil transportining yuk aylanmasi hajmi (yillik) — statistik ko‘rsatkich metama’lumotlari
abs: Yillik statistik ko‘rsatkich: avtomobil transportining yuk aylanmasi (mln t-km), 2000-yildan respublika, viloyatlar va Toshkent shahri kesimida. SIAT/SDMX metama’lumot va jadval PDF shaklida.

title: Avtomobil transportining yuk aylanmasi hajmi (choraklik) — statistik ko‘rsatkich metama’lumotlari
abs: Choraklik statistik ko‘rsatkich: avtomobil transportining yuk aylanmasi hajmi (mln t-km). Milliy statistika qo‘mitasi xizmatlar statistikasi boshqarmasi tomonidan yangilanadi.

title: Avtomobil transportining yo‘lovchi aylanmasi (choraklik) — statistik ko‘rsatkich metama’lumotlari
abs: Choraklik statistik ko‘rsatkich: avtomobil transportining yo‘lovchi aylanmasi. Yo‘llardagi harakat talabini baholash uchun rasmiy ma’lumot manbai.

title: Adjustable Cross-frames for the Erection of Steel Girder Bridges
abs: IDEA Project 227 tackled the poor fit of cross-frames in curved and heavily skewed steel girder bridges, where girders twist and deflect unevenly during erection. The team developed a deployable adjustable cross-frame tool, studied it numerically and demonstrated it in laboratory experiments as a low-cost aid to installation.

uz.t: Po‘lat to‘sinli ko‘priklarni o‘rnatish uchun sozlanadigan ko‘ndalang bog‘lagichlar
uz.ab: Egri va keskin qiyshiq po‘lat to‘sinli ko‘priklarda montaj paytida to‘sinlar buralib, ko‘ndalang bog‘lagichlarni joyiga moslash qiyinlashadi; loyiha shu muammoni yechuvchi sozlanadigan qurilmani ishlab chiqib, hisob va tajriba orqali sinagan. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l o‘tkazgichlar va murakkab geometriyali ko‘priklar ko‘payayotgani sababli montaj sifatini oshirish uchun foydali tajriba.

title: New Tool for Predicting the Retroreflectivity (RL) of Pavement Markings
abs: IDEA Project 237 built a machine-learning decision tool that forecasts pavement marking retroreflectivity up to three years ahead using only the initial measured value and routinely available project data. It targets agencies that cannot afford regular field measurement and restripe on visual checks or fixed schedules.

uz.t: Yo‘l chiziqlarining retroreflektivligini bashorat qilish uchun yangi vosita
uz.ab: Mashinali o‘qitishga asoslangan vosita yo‘l chizig‘ining boshlang‘ich yorug‘lik qaytarish ko‘rsatkichi va oddiy loyiha ma’lumotlari bo‘yicha uch yilgacha bo‘lgan holatini oldindan aytadi. Bu chiziqlarni qayta bo‘yashni jadval yoki ko‘z bilan baholash o‘rniga ma’lumotga tayanib rejalashtirishga imkon beradi — O‘zbekistonda tungi xavfsizlik va bo‘yoq xarajatlarini tejash uchun muhim.

title: Low-Cost Sensing System for the Detection and Classification of Wide Base Tire Types and Distribution at the Network Level
abs: IDEA Project 238 developed an inexpensive traffic sensing system that uses sensors embedded in EPDM rubber strips with force transducer technology to measure tire width, vehicle class and wheel wander at highway speed. It is intended for busy corridors to track wide-base (super single) tires and their effect on pavements.

uz.t: Tarmoq darajasida keng profilli shinalar turini aniqlash va tasniflash uchun arzon datchik tizimi
uz.ab: Rezina tasmaga o‘rnatilgan kuch datchiklari yordamida avtomagistral tezligida shina kengligi, transport toifasi va g‘ildirak izining siljishini o‘lchaydigan arzon tizim yaratilgan. Og‘ir yuk mashinalari oqimi ko‘p bo‘lgan O‘zbekiston magistrallarida qoplamaga tushadigan real yukni baholash va loyihalash uchun foydali.

title: A Real-Time Ice Warning System Empowered by Dielectric Ice Sensors for Bridges
abs: IDEA Project 239 produced a real-time active ice warning system for bridge decks based on a sensor that reads the dielectric constant of the surface layer using time domain reflectometry. The system classifies deck surface condition so that icing can be flagged to drivers and maintenance crews in time.

uz.t: Dielektrik muz datchiklariga asoslangan ko‘priklar uchun real vaqtli muzlash ogohlantirish tizimi
uz.ab: Ko‘prik qoplamasi yuzasining dielektrik doimiysini TDR usulida o‘lchab, sirt holatini (quruq, nam, muz) real vaqtda aniqlovchi ogohlantirish tizimi ishlab chiqilgan. O‘zbekistonning tog‘li va shimoliy hududlarida ko‘priklar yo‘ldan oldin muzlashi sababli qishki saqlash va xavfsizlik uchun bevosita foydali.

title: Producing DynaSignal: A Novel Aerodynamic Solution for Traffic Signal Lights to Mitigate Large Vibrations and Fatigue-Related Issues in Structural Supports of Traffic Signals
abs: IDEA Project 241, a Type II follow-on to earlier wind-tunnel and simulation work, implemented an aerodynamic signal-light design on a full-scale cantilevered traffic signal structure exposed to natural wind. Long-term monitoring of an in-service structure was used to validate vibration reduction and estimate the extension of fatigue life at pole-to-arm connections.

uz.t: DynaSignal: svetofor tayanchlarida kuchli tebranish va charchoqni kamaytiruvchi aerodinamik yechim
uz.ab: Konsolli svetofor tayanchlarida shamol tebranishi ustun va konsol ulanishida charchoq yoriqlariga olib keladi; loyiha aerodinamik svetofor korpusini real shamolda to‘liq o‘lchamli inshootda sinab, tebranish kamayishini uzoq muddat kuzatgan. Shamolli hududlarda svetofor va belgi tayanchlari xizmat muddatini uzaytirish uchun O‘zbekistonda ham qo‘llasa bo‘ladi.

title: Development of an AI-Powered Dynamic Modulus Test with a Low-Cost Loading Frame
abs: IDEA Project 242 developed IDEAL-E*, an AI-assisted test that estimates the dynamic modulus of asphalt mixtures on an inexpensive loading frame instead of costly servo-hydraulic equipment. The goal is a quick, practical E* measurement for routine use by highway agencies and industry, since E* is a key input to mechanistic pavement design.

uz.t: Arzon yuklash ramasi va sun’iy intellekt asosidagi dinamik modul sinovini ishlab chiqish
uz.ab: Asfaltbetonning dinamik modulini (E*) qimmat servogidravlik uskunasiz, arzon yuklash ramasi va sun’iy intellekt yordamida aniqlovchi IDEAL-E* sinovi yaratilgan. E* qoplamani mexanik-empirik loyihalashda asosiy parametr bo‘lgani uchun bu usul O‘zbekiston laboratoriyalarida asfalt sifatini nazorat qilishni arzonlashtirishi mumkin.

title: Augmenting the Hearing of Safety-Critical Sounds for Highway Workers Using Artificial Intelligence
abs: IDEA Project 247 explored a wearable AI-augmented hearing protector that filters noise in real time while letting through safety-critical sounds such as backup alarms and intrusion warnings. It aims to protect highway construction workers from hearing loss without blocking the signals that warn them of danger.

uz.t: Sun’iy intellekt yordamida yo‘l ishchilariga xavf signallarini eshitishni kuchaytirish
uz.ab: Shovqinni real vaqtda filtrlab, orqaga yurish signali va ish zonasiga transport bostirib kirishi haqidagi ogohlantirishlarni o‘tkazib yuboradigan aqlli eshitish himoya vositasi o‘rganilgan. Faol harakat ostida ta’mirlash ishlari olib boriladigan O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida ishchilar xavfsizligi uchun dolzarb.

title: “Temiryo‘l, avtomobil yo‘llari va gidrotexnik tunnellar hamda metropolitenlarning qurilish-montaj qilish ishlari” QR 06.05-23 qurilish reglamenti (Vazirning 396-son buyrug‘i, 23.11.2023)
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
abs: Temiryo‘l, avtomobil yo‘li va gidrotexnik tunnellar hamda metropoliten inshootlarini qurish-montaj qilish ishlariga qo‘yiladigan talablarni belgilovchi qurilish reglamenti. Vazirlikning 2023-yildagi 396-son buyrug‘i bilan tasdiqlangan; tog‘li hududlardagi yo‘l tunnellari loyihalari uchun asosiy me’yoriy hujjat.

title: “Po‘lat konstruksiyalari. Ishlab chiqarish va ishlarni qabul qilish qoidalari” QR 03.02-23 qurilish reglamenti (Vazirning 460-son buyrug‘i, 2023)
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
abs: Po‘lat konstruksiyalarni tayyorlash, montaj qilish va bajarilgan ishlarni qabul qilish qoidalarini belgilovchi qurilish reglamenti. Po‘lat oraliq qurilmali ko‘priklar, yo‘l o‘tkazgichlar va boshqa metall inshootlar qurilishida qo‘llaniladi. Buyruq sarlavhasi va ilovadagi sanalar bir-biridan farq qiladi, hujjatning o‘zida tekshirish tavsiya etiladi.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llarini qurish, rekonstruksiya qilish va ta’mirlashda laboratoriya sinovlarini amalga oshirish to‘g‘risidagi nizomni tasdiqlash haqida (Transport vazirining 4-son buyrug‘i, ro‘yxat raqami 3904)
abs: Avtomobil yo‘llarini qurish, rekonstruksiya va ta’mirlash jarayonida yo‘l qurilish materiallari va ishlar sifatini laboratoriya sinovlari orqali nazorat qilish tartibini belgilaydi. Ilovada sinov turlari va qo‘llaniladigan GOST standartlari ro‘yxati berilgan. 2026-yil iyulda Adliya vazirligida ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazilgan, 22.10.2026 dan kuchga kiradi.

title: “Yo‘l harakati to‘g‘risida”gi O‘zbekiston Respublikasining Qonuni (O‘RQ-900-son, 19.01.2024)
abs: Yo‘l harakatini tashkil etish va xavfsizligini ta’minlash bo‘yicha amaldagi asosiy qonun; 2024-yil 21-iyuldan kuchga kirgan. Yo‘l inshootlari tushunchalari, harakatni tashkil etishning texnik vositalari, yo‘l egalarining majburiyatlari hamda yo‘llarni loyihalash, qurish va saqlashga qo‘yiladigan talablarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llarida inson xavfsizligini ishonchli ta’minlash va o‘lim holatlarini keskin kamaytirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PQ-190-son qarori, 04.04.2022)
abs: Yo‘llarda halokatlar va o‘lim holatlarini kamaytirishga qaratilgan qaror: xavfsiz yo‘l infratuzilmasi ustuvorliklari, haydovchilarni tayyorlash islohoti, jarima ballari tizimi va hududlar uchun “Xavfsiz yo‘l” samaradorlik indeksi joriy etilgan. Keyinchalik bir necha bor o‘zgartirishlar kiritilgan.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi yo‘l xo‘jaligi tizimini chuqur isloh qilish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PF-5890-son farmoni, 09.12.2019)
abs: Yo‘l xo‘jaligini boshqarishni isloh qilish farmoni: investitsiyalar va davlat-xususiy sheriklikni jalb etish, qo‘mitaning tartibga solish va xo‘jalik funksiyalarini ajratish, yangi loyihalarni tender asosida berish hamda yo‘l rivojlantirish jamg‘armalarini tashkil etishni nazarda tutadi. 2024-yildagi farmonlar bilan o‘zgartirilgan.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llari bo‘ylab katta hajmli va og‘ir vaznli avtotransport vositalarining harakatlanish tartibini takomillashtirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 710-son qarori, 28.10.2024)
abs: Umumiy foydalaniladigan yo‘llarda katta hajmli va og‘ir vaznli transport vositalarining harakati, vazn va gabarit nazorati tartibini belgilaydi. Karyer operatorlarining yuklarni tortish majburiyatlari 2025-yilda aniqlashtirilgan; yo‘l qoplamalarini ortiqcha yuklamadan himoya qilish uchun muhim hujjat.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Transport vazirligi huzuridagi Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasi to‘g‘risidagi nizomni tasdiqlash haqida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 295-son qarori, 19.05.2020)
abs: Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasining vazifalari, funksiyalari va tuzilmasini belgilovchi nizom; qo‘mita umumiy foydalaniladigan yo‘llarni loyihalash, qurish, ta’mirlash va saqlash bo‘yicha yagona buyurtmachi sifatida belgilangan. Oxirgi o‘zgartirishlar 2025-yil yanvarida kiritilgan.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Moliya vazirligi hamda Qoraqalpog‘iston Respublikasi Moliya vazirligi, viloyatlar va Toshkent shahar hokimliklari moliya bosh boshqarmalari huzuridagi Avtomobil yo‘llarini rivojlantirish maqsadli jamg‘armalari faoliyatini tashkil etish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 123-son qarori, 05.03.2020)
abs: Respublika va hududiy Avtomobil yo‘llarini rivojlantirish maqsadli jamg‘armalarining shakllanishi, mablag‘larni sarflash yo‘nalishlari, boshqaruv va hisobot tartibini belgilaydi. Hududiy yo‘l yig‘imlari bo‘yicha jamoatchilik muhokamasi tartibi ham nazarda tutilgan.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llari sohasida ochiqlik standartlarini joriy etish va sohada jamoatchilik nazoratini kuchaytirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 49-son qarori, 02.02.2022)
abs: Yo‘l sohasida ochiq e’lon qilinadigan ma’lumotlar ro‘yxatini, “Shaffof yo‘l” platformasini va qurilish-ta’mirlash obyektlarining interaktiv xaritasini joriy etgan qaror. Ichki yo‘llarni ta’mirlashni “Ochiq byudjet” orqali fuqarolar ovozi bilan tanlash va obyektlarda QR-kodli axborot taxtalarini o‘rnatish tartibini ham belgilaydi.

title: Umumiy foydalaniladigan avtomobil yo‘llarini qurish va ulardan foydalanishni tashkil etishni hamda sifatini nazorat qilishni takomillashtirish to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 226-son qarori, 01.11.2006)
abs: Umumiy foydalaniladigan yo‘llar va yo‘l inshootlarini qurish, rekonstruksiya va kapital ta’mirlashda sifat nazorati hamda tugallangan ishlarni qabul qilish tartibini belgilaydi. O‘zgartirishlar bilan amalda; oxirgi tahrir 2025-yil dekabriga to‘g‘ri keladi.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi hududidagi avtomobil yo‘llarida xavfsizlikni ta’minlash va tashkil etish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 342-son qarori, 26.12.2011)
abs: Avtomobil yo‘llari va shahar ko‘chalarida xavfsizlikni tashkil etish, yo‘l qurilishi va ta’mirlash ishlarida xavfsizlik choralari hamda ko‘priklar va sun’iy inshootlardan o‘tishda yuk cheklovlari bo‘yicha talablarni belgilaydi. Ilovalarda ko‘priklarga ruxsat etilgan yuklamalar keltirilgan.

title: “Avtomobil yo‘llari to‘g‘risida”gi O‘zbekiston Respublikasining Qonuni (O‘RQ-117-son, 02.10.2007)
abs: Avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash, qurish, ta’mirlash, saqlash va ulardan foydalanishni tartibga solgan qonun; yo‘l qurilish materiallarini standartlashtirish va sertifikatlash masalalarini ham qamrab olgan. 2026-yil 6-avgustda O‘RQ-1162-son yangi qonun kuchga kirishi bilan o‘z kuchini yo‘qotgan — tarixiy-qiyosiy tahlil uchun foydali.

title: Umumiy foydalaniladigan avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalashtirish, qurish va rekonstruksiya qilish tartibini takomillashtirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PQ-499-son qarori, 25.10.2006)
abs: Umumiy foydalaniladigan yo‘llarni loyihalash, qurish va rekonstruksiya qilish hamda ularni Respublika yo‘l jamg‘armasi orqali moliyalashtirish tartibini takomillashtirgan qaror. 2017-yilda PF-5097 farmoni bilan o‘z kuchini yo‘qotgan.

title: Respublika yo‘l jamg‘armasini tashkil etish to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 334-son qarori, 05.07.1993)
abs: Mustaqillikning dastlabki yillarida umumiy foydalaniladigan yo‘llarni loyihalash, qurish, ta’mirlash va saqlashni moliyalashtirish uchun Respublika yo‘l jamg‘armasini tashkil etgan qaror. Jamg‘arma daromad manbalari (korxonalar yig‘imlari, transport vositalari xaridi va yoqilg‘i savdosidan ajratmalar) belgilangan; 2003-yilda o‘z kuchini yo‘qotgan.

title: O‘zbekiston avtomobil yo‘llari qurish va foydalanish (“O‘zavtoyo‘l”) davlat-aksiyadorlik konserni ustavini tasdiqlash to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 171-son qarori, 06.04.1993)
abs: Umumiy foydalaniladigan yo‘llarni qurish va ulardan foydalanish uchun mas’ul bo‘lgan “O‘zavtoyo‘l” davlat-aksiyadorlik konsernining ustavini tasdiqlagan qaror. O‘zbekiston yo‘l boshqaruvi tizimi tarixini o‘rganish uchun manba; 1997-yilda o‘z kuchini yo‘qotgan.

title: “Yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi to‘g‘risida”gi O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qonuniga o‘zgartish va qo‘shimchalar kiritish haqida (O‘RQ-348-son, 10.04.2013)
abs: 1999-yilgi “Yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi to‘g‘risida”gi qonunning yangi tahririni tasdiqlagan qonun: davlat organlari vakolatlari, transport vositalari va haydovchilarga, shuningdek yo‘llarga qo‘yiladigan talablar belgilangan. 2024-yil 21-iyuldan O‘RQ-900-son “Yo‘l harakati to‘g‘risida”gi qonun bilan almashtirilgan.

title: Об организации деятельности Государственного комитета Республики Узбекистан по автомобильным дорогам (Постановление Президента ПП-2776, 14.02.2017)
abs: Avtomobil yo‘llari davlat qo‘mitasi faoliyatini, yo‘l qurilishi va saqlash korxonalari tizimini hamda yo‘l moliyalashtirish tartibini tashkil etgan qaror. Keyinchalik UP-6218, UP-101 farmonlari va PQ-330 qarori bilan o‘zgartirilgan, ayrim ilovalari chiqarib tashlangan.

title: О мерах по дальнейшему совершенствованию системы управления дорожным хозяйством (Указ Президента УП-4954, 14.02.2017)
abs: Umumiy foydalaniladigan yo‘llar va muhandislik inshootlarini boshqarish, moliyalashtirish, qurish va saqlash tizimini qayta tashkil etib, Avtomobil yo‘llari davlat qo‘mitasini tuzgan farmon. 2024-yil 15-apreldagi UP-64 farmoni bilan o‘z kuchini yo‘qotgan.

title: О внесении изменений, а также признании утратившими силу некоторых актов Президента Республики Узбекистан (Указ Президента УП-64, 15.04.2024)
abs: Yo‘l sohasini yanada rivojlantirish munosabati bilan Prezidentning bir qator hujjatlariga o‘zgartirish kiritgan va eski farmonlarni (jumladan UP-4954) bekor qilgan farmon. 2024-yil 22-apreldan kuchga kirgan; amaldagi yo‘l xo‘jaligi qonunchiligini kuzatish uchun muhim.

title: Mahalliy barqarorlashtiruvchi qo‘shimcha asosida polimer-chaqiq tosh-mastikali asfaltbeton qoplamalarini ekspluatatsion ko‘rsatkichlarini oshirish
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi avtoreferati, 05.09.02 – “Geotexnika” ixtisosligi, TDTU huzuridagi PhD.15/31.08.2022.T.73.05 ilmiy kengash. Ishda mahalliy xomashyodan olingan barqarorlashtiruvchi qo‘shimcha (modifikatsiyalangan bazalt va sellyuloza tolasi, polimer-bitum) asosidagi chaqiq tosh-mastikali asfaltbeton tadqiq etilgan. Izchil iz hosil bo‘lishiga, suvbardoshlik va yoriqbardoshlikka ta’siri o‘rganilib, Toshkent halqa yo‘lida (M39b) tajriba uchastkasi sinovdan o‘tkazilgan.

title: Ekspluatatsiya qilinayotgan avtoyo‘l temirbeton ko‘priklarining yuk ko‘tarish qobiliyatini oshirish usullarini takomillashtirish
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi avtoreferati, 05.09.02 – “Geotexnika” (Ko‘priklar, transport tonnellari va metropolitenlar) ixtisosligi, TDTU huzuridagi DSc.15/31.08.2022.T.73.04 ilmiy kengash. Ishda foydalanilayotgan avtomobil yo‘li temirbeton ko‘priklarining yuk ko‘tarish qobiliyatini oshirish usullari ko‘rib chiqilgan. Asosiy yondashuv — qo‘shimcha beton qatlami hisobiga oraliq qurilmaning ishchi balandligini oshirish.

title: Yo‘l-transport majmuasi resurs salohiyati boshqaruvi samaradorligini oshirish metodologiyasini takomillashtirish
abs: Iqtisod fanlari doktori (DSc) dissertatsiyasi avtoreferati, 08.00.13 “Menejment” va 08.00.05 ixtisosliklari, TDTU huzuridagi DSc.15/31.12.2020.I.09.04 ilmiy kengash. Ish yo‘l-transport majmuasining resurs salohiyatini boshqarish samaradorligini oshirish metodologiyasiga bag‘ishlangan. Resurs samaradorligini baholash usullari va monitoring markazi tashkil etish taklif qilingan; bu muhandislik emas, iqtisodiy-boshqaruv yo‘nalishidagi tadqiqot.

title: Tog‘li avtomobil yo‘llarida transport oqimining harakat sharoitini baholashni modellashtirish (“Qamchiq” dovoni misolida)
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 05.09.02 – “Geotexnika” (Yo‘llar, yo‘llarni raqamlashtirish va yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi) ixtisosligi. Himoya TDTU huzuridagi PhD.10/2025.27.12.T.01.05 ilmiy kengashida 2026-yil 8-sentabrga belgilangan edi. Ishda tog‘li avtomobil yo‘llarida transport oqimining harakat sharoitini baholash modellashtirilgan, “Qamchiq” dovoni misolida. Havola rasmiy himoya e’loniga olib boradi; avtoreferat matni hozircha ochiq havolada emas.

title: Sho‘rlangan gruntli yo‘l poyi ishchi qatlamining takroriy yuklamalar ta’sirida hisobiy ko‘rsatkichlarini asoslash
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 05.09.02 ixtisosligi, TDTU huzuridagi DSc.18/30.12.2019.T.09.01 ilmiy kengash. Ishda sho‘rlangan gruntlardan tashkil topgan yo‘l poyi ishchi qatlamining takroriy transport yuklamalari ostidagi hisobiy ko‘rsatkichlari asoslangan. Himoya 2022-yil 5-fevralga e’lon qilingan; havola rasmiy himoya e’loniga olib boradi.

title: Kompozit gruntlar tarkibini ularning mexanik ko‘rsatgichlariga ta’siri
org: Mirzo Ulug‘bek nomidagi Samarqand davlat texnika universiteti (O‘zbekiston)
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 05.09.02 – “Asoslar, poydevor va yer osti inshootlari. Ko‘priklar va transport tonnellari. Yo‘llar, metropolitenlar” ixtisosligi. Himoya 2025-yil 25-iyulda Samarqandda PhD.26/26.01.2023.T.109.02 ilmiy kengashida bo‘lib o‘tgan. Ishda kompozit gruntlar tarkibining ularning mexanik ko‘rsatkichlariga ta’siri o‘rganilgan; mavzu yo‘l poyi va asoslar geotexnikasiga tegishli, lekin bevosita yo‘l qoplamasi haqida emas.

title: Operational Tests of the Conservation Traffic Control Load Switch
abs: The project field- and lab-tested a traffic-signal load switch that regulates lamp voltage, distributing 200 units to about 100 signal laboratories. In accelerated tests regulated lamps lasted roughly 3 to 4 times longer than with a conventional switch, while output voltage stayed within a fraction of a volt of the set point. Remaining issues included cabinet wiring compatibility and unit price.

uz.t: Energiya tejovchi yuklama kalitini ekspluatatsion sinash
uz.ab: Svetofor lampalari tez kuyishi va ularni almashtirish ishchilar uchun xavfli bo‘lgani sababli lampaga beriladigan kuchlanishni barqarorlashtiruvchi yuklama kaliti sinovdan o‘tkazildi. 200 ta qurilma 100 ga yaqin laboratoriyaga yuborildi; tezlashtirilgan sinovda lampalar oddiy kalitdagi 395–470 daqiqa o‘rniga 1480–1720 daqiqa ishladi, ya’ni umri 3,1–4,4 barobar uzaydi. Dala sinovida chiqish kuchlanishi belgilangan qiymatdan atigi 0,03 V atrofida farq qildi, qurilma har fazada 10 A yuklamani ko‘tardi. Kuchlanishi beqaror tarmoqlarda ishlaydigan O‘zbekiston svetoforlari uchun bu yondashuv lampa almashtirish xarajati va yo‘ldagi xavfli ishlarni kamaytirishi mumkin.

title: Tuned Dampers and Cable Fillers for Suppression of Bridge Stay Cable Vibrations
abs: Rain-wind vibration of stay cables threatens their fatigue life because their natural damping is very low. On 1/7-scale cable models the study compared latex-modified grout fillers, tuned mass and liquid dampers, damping tape and neoprene or polyurethane guide-pipe treatments. A small tuned mass damper was by far the most effective, raising damping to about 2.35 percent, whereas fillers and tape gave little benefit.

uz.t: Ko‘prik vantlari tebranishini so‘ndirish uchun ichki so‘ndiruvchi to‘ldirgichlarni moslashtirish
uz.ab: Vantli ko‘priklarda yomg‘ir va shamol birga ta’sir qilganda vantlar 1–2 m amplitudada tebranib, charchoq mustahkamligini pasaytiradi, chunki ularning o‘z so‘ndirishi atigi 0,05–0,5 % atrofida. 1/7 masshtabli vant modellarida lateksli to‘ldirgich qorishma, sozlangan massali va suyuqlikli dempferlar, so‘ndiruvchi lenta hamda neopren halqalar sinab ko‘rildi. Lateksli qorishma so‘ndirishni faqat 0,05 % dan 0,08 % gacha oshirdi, neopren halqalar 0,61 % gacha berdi, vant massasining taxminan 3 % iga teng sozlangan massali dempfer esa so‘ndirishni 2,35 % ga yetkazdi va eng samarali, arzonroq yechim deb topildi. O‘zbekistonda vantli va osma ko‘priklar ko‘paya borgani sari bunday tebranishni nazorat qilish usullari ko‘priklarni saqlash amaliyoti uchun foydali.

title: A Novel Approach to Determine Material Parameters to Predict Remaining Life of Infrastructure
abs: Conventional nondestructive testing of concrete yields elastic moduli but not remaining strength. This exploratory study combined Lamb-wave frequency scans of mortar plates with the Disturbed State Concept model to estimate damage and predict the stress-strain response. A blind prediction of peak stress (5.80 MPa) closely matched the measured value (5.74 MPa), though validation on real concrete and field equipment remained to be done.

uz.t: Beton ko‘prik konstruksiyasining qoldiq resursini bashorat qilishning yangi yondashuvi
uz.ab: Betonni buzmasdan sinashning odatiy usullari asosan elastiklik modulini beradi, ammo konstruksiyada qancha mustahkamlik qolganini ko‘rsatmaydi. Tadqiqotda qorishma plastinalari 100–800 kHz chastotali Lamb to‘lqinlari bilan skanerlanib, olingan signal “buzilgan holat” (DSC) modeli bilan bog‘landi va namunaning kuchlanish–deformatsiya egri chizig‘i bashorat qilindi. Kalibrlashda ishlatilmagan namunalar uchun bashorat qilingan eng katta kuchlanish 5,80 MPa, o‘lchangani esa 5,74 MPa bo‘lib, natijalar juda yaqin chiqdi; mualliflar usulni haqiqiy betonda va dala qurilmalarida tekshirish zarurligini qayd etgan. O‘zbekistondagi eskirgan beton ko‘priklarni ta’mirlashni rejalashtirishda qoldiq resursni buzmasdan baholash muhim vazifa bo‘lib qolmoqda.

title: Design, Development and Validation of an Advanced In-Situ Shear Stiffness Test Facility for Asphalt Concrete Pavements
abs: Carleton University built InSiSST, a trailer-mounted device that twists a steel plate bonded to the pavement to measure in-situ shear stiffness and strength of asphalt concrete without coring. Torque capacity rose to 1,550 N·m, repeatability improved markedly over the earlier prototype, and shear stiffness correlated with rutting rate on six Ontario test sections (R² = 0.81).

uz.t: Asfaltbeton qoplamalarda joyida siljishga mustahkamlikni sinash qurilmasini loyihalash va tekshirish
uz.ab: Asfalt qoplamadagi izlanish (koleya) siljishga qarshilik bilan bog‘liq, lekin uni yo‘lning o‘zida kern olmasdan o‘lchaydigan usul yo‘q edi. Carleton universiteti jamoasi InSiSST nomli tirkamaga o‘rnatilgan qurilma yaratdi: qoplamaga yelimlangan po‘lat plastinkaga burovchi moment berilib, siljish bikrligi va mustahkamligi aniqlanadi; moment sig‘imi 508 dan 1550 N·m gacha oshirildi, takrorlanuvchanlik esa sezilarli yaxshilandi (variatsiya koeffitsiyenti 19,2% o‘rniga 7,2%). Ontariodagi oltita sinov uchastkasida siljish bikrligi bilan izlanish tezligi o‘rtasida kuchli bog‘liqlik (R² = 0,81) topildi, qurilma narxi 50 ming dollardan kam deb baholandi, ammo mualliflar qo‘shimcha dala tekshiruvlari zarurligini ta’kidlaydi. Yozgi jaziramada asfalt qoplamalari tez koleya hosil qiladigan O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun qabul nazoratida qoplamaning siljishga chidamliligini joyida tekshirish g‘oyasi juda dolzarb.

title: Landslide Stabilization Using Wick Drains
abs: Lowering groundwater is one of the most effective ways to stabilize landslides, but drilled horizontal drains clog and are costly. The team installed over 100 horizontal geosynthetic wick drains (almost 1,500 m) at eight sites by driving a steel pipe with ordinary earthmoving equipment. At one site the factor of safety rose from 1.28 to 1.46, at an installed cost of about 3.64 dollars per foot, and design guidelines were proposed.

uz.t: Vertikal drenalar yordamida ko‘chkilarni barqarorlashtirish
uz.ab: Ko‘chkilarni barqarorlashtirishning eng samarali yo‘li yer osti suvini pasaytirish, ammo burg‘ulangan gorizontal drenalar tez loyqa bilan to‘lib qoladi va qimmat turadi. Loyihada yassi geosintetik (pilik) drenalar oddiy buldozer yoki ekskavator yordamida po‘lat quvur bilan qiyalikka gorizontal kiritildi: sakkiz obyektda 100 dan ortiq drena, jami qariyb 1500 m o‘rnatildi. Sinov ko‘tarmasida har bir drena soatiga taxminan 40 litr suv chiqarib, suv sathini 0,3 m dan ko‘proq tushirdi, Jasper (Indiana) obyektida esa qiyalikning barqarorlik koeffitsienti 1,28 dan 1,46 ga oshdi; o‘rnatish narxi bir fut uchun taxminan 3,64 dollar bo‘ldi. Tog‘li hududlardagi O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida (masalan, Qamchiq dovoni kabi uchastkalarda) ko‘chki xavfini arzon usulda kamaytirish uchun bu tajriba qiziqarli.

title: Quantitative Characterization of Asphalt Concretes Using High-Resolution X-ray Computed Tomography
abs: Researchers at the University of Texas at Austin used industrial X-ray CT and wrote the Blob3D software to segment, separate and measure every aggregate particle and contact inside asphalt concrete cores. Validation on glass-bead phantoms reproduced the sphere grading within 2%, while the scan settings limited reliable analysis to particles larger than about 2 mm.

uz.t: Yuqori aniqlikdagi rentgen tomografiyasi bilan asfaltbetonni miqdoriy tavsiflash
uz.ab: An’anaviy mexanik sinovlar asfaltbetonning ichki tuzilishini bevosita ko‘rsatmaydi, shu sababli loyiha uni buzmasdan miqdoriy o‘lchash usulini ishlab chiqdi. Mualliflar sanoat rentgen tomografiyasida namunalarni skanerlab, har bir to‘ldiruvchi donasining hajmi, shakli, yo‘nalishi va donalar orasidagi kontaktlarni hisoblaydigan Blob3D dasturini yaratdilar. Shisha sharchalardan tayyorlangan nazorat namunalarida 8343 ta shar taxminan 21 soatda o‘lchandi va donadorlik tarkibi kutilgan qiymatdan 2% aniqlik bilan qayta tiklandi; biroq qo‘llangan skanerlash rejimida faqat ~2 mm dan yirik donalarni ishonchli tahlil qilish mumkin bo‘ldi. O‘zbekiston yo‘l laboratoriyalari salohiyatini oshirishda asfaltbeton tarkibini (g‘ovaklik, to‘ldiruvchi joylashuvi) chuqur tahlil qilish uchun bu usul zamonaviy yo‘nalish namunasi bo‘la oladi.

title: An All Composite Bridge Sidewalk
abs: The project designed a lightweight, corrosion-free cantilevered sidewalk for a narrow bridge using carbon-fiber/epoxy I-beam supports and a glass-fiber truss walkway. Static testing to the 16,650 lb design load showed no signs of failure, with stresses far below strength and deflection under the allowable limit. The system weighs about 100 lb per running foot, roughly one-third of a steel and concrete alternative.

uz.t: To‘liq kompozit ko‘prik piyodalar yo‘lagi
uz.ab: Tor ko‘prikka piyodalar yo‘lagi qo‘shish uchun an’anaviy po‘lat-beton yechim juda og‘ir (har yugurik fut uchun qariyb 300 funt) va korroziyaga moyil bo‘lgani sababli to‘liq kompozit konsol yo‘lak ishlab chiqildi. Tayanchlar uglerod tola va epoksiddan yasalgan 18 dyuymli qo‘shtavr to‘sinlardan, yo‘lakning o‘zi esa shisha tolali fermadan iborat bo‘ldi. 16 650 funtlik loyiha yuklamasigacha statik sinovda buzilish belgisi kuzatilmadi, eng katta kuchlanish taxminan 10 ksi bo‘lib, mustahkamlikdan ancha past chiqdi, salqilik ham ruxsat etilgan chegaradan kam bo‘ldi; tizim po‘lat-beton variantdan taxminan uch barobar yengil. O‘zbekistondagi tor eski ko‘priklarni piyodalar uchun kengaytirishda tayanch konstruksiyani kuchaytirmasdan yengil kompozit yechimlar qo‘l kelishi mumkin.

title: Geocomposite Capillary Barrier Drain for Limiting Moisture Changes in Pavement Subgrades and Base Courses
abs: Water in base courses and subgrades weakens pavements, and conventional drains only handle saturated flow. This project developed a three-layer geocomposite capillary barrier drain that removes unsaturated water from the base and blocks capillary rise from below. In large test-box pavements it drained base water and kept the subgrade dry under most simulated storms and long-term infiltration, though the fiberglass transport layer was costly.

uz.t: Yo‘l poyi va asos qatlamlarida namlik o‘zgarishini cheklovchi geokompozit kapillyar to‘siqli drena
uz.ab: Asos qatlami va yo‘l poyida namlik to‘planishi ularning mustahkamligini pasaytirib, iz hosil bo‘lishi va ko‘pchishga olib keladi, oddiy drenajlar esa faqat to‘yingan suvni chiqaradi. Tadqiqotchilar uch qatlamli geokompozit kapillyar to‘siqli drena (transport geotekstili, georeshyotka va ajratuvchi geotekstil) yaratib, uni 6,2 m uzunlikdagi sinov qutisidagi yo‘l modelida 6 soatlik va 1 soatlik jala sharoitida sinadi. Uzoq muddatli namlanishda drena berilgan suvning taxminan 37 % ini chiqarib yubordi (ariqqa ~24 %), ko‘p sinovlarda yo‘l poyi namlanmadi, ammo shisha tolali transport qatlami qimmatligi qayd etildi. O‘zbekistonning sho‘rlangan va kapillyar namlik ko‘tariladigan gruntlarida yo‘l poyini suv va tuzdan himoyalash uchun bunday kapillyar to‘siq g‘oyasi juda dolzarb.

title: Aggregate Shape Characterization Using Digital Image Processing
abs: Manual caliper and voids tests for aggregate flatness, elongation and angularity are slow and subjective. The study evaluated an upgraded camera-based image analysis system against ASTM caliper measurements on over 56,000 particles and introduced a new angularity index. Imaging was efficient and more reproducible than calipers for flat-and-elongated particles, and its angularity measure correlated with voids tests.

uz.t: Raqamli tasvirga ishlov berish orqali to‘ldiruvchi shaklini tavsiflash
uz.ab: To‘ldiruvchi donalarining yassi, cho‘ziq va qirrali ekanini qo‘lda shtangensirkul bilan aniqlash sekin va sub’ektiv. Loyihada kameralar, orqa yoritish va tasvirni qayta ishlash dasturiga ega WipShape tizimi takomillashtirilib, 20 ta namunadagi jami 56 926 dona bo‘yicha ASTM D4791 qo‘lda o‘lchash natijalari bilan solishtirildi. Tasvir usuli qo‘lda o‘lchashdan barqarorroq chiqdi (masalan, 12,5 mm fraksiyada qayta tiklanuvchanlik 1,30 % ga qarshi 6,01 %), yangi “o‘rtacha minimal egrilik radiusi” ko‘rsatkichi esa bo‘shliqlik sinovlari bilan bog‘liqlik ko‘rsatdi; zarbali maydalagichlar kubsimonroq dona berishi ham aniqlandi. O‘zbekiston karyerlari va asfalt zavodlari laboratoriyalarida chaqiq tosh sifatini tez va xolis nazorat qilish uchun bu yondashuv foydali.

title: Development of a Wide Area Optical Surface Contamination Detection System for Public Transportation Application
abs: The project adapted an aircraft laser-polarization ice detector to identify ice, snow and water on road surfaces from a distance. After data collection on several continents, prototypes including a pan-tilt laser road surface sensor were built and tested. Laboratory estimates indicated detection of snow and ice up to about 75 ft, and the authors concluded the technique can be adapted for roadway use, though field validation was limited.

uz.t: Jamoat transporti uchun keng maydonli optik sirt ifloslanishini aniqlash tizimi
uz.ab: Ko‘priklar va shamol ochiq uchastkalardagi “qora muz” jiddiy xavf bo‘lgani uchun samolyotlarda qo‘llanadigan IceHawk lazer-polyarizatsion muz detektori yo‘l sirtini masofadan kuzatishga moslashtirildi. Skandinaviya, Shimoliy Amerika va Osiyoda ma’lumot yig‘ilgach, burilib-egiluvchi lazer yo‘l sirti sensori prototiplari yasalib, sinovdan o‘tkazildi; tasvirda muz qizil, qor to‘q ko‘k, suv och ko‘k rangda ko‘rsatiladi. Laboratoriya baholariga ko‘ra 23 fut balandlikka o‘rnatilganda qor va muz 75 futgacha, suv ko‘lmaklari taxminan 45–50 futgacha aniqlanadi, ammo bu raqamlar dala sinovida to‘liq tasdiqlanmagan. Tog‘ dovonlari va ko‘priklarda qishki xizmatni o‘z vaqtida yuborish uchun bunday masofaviy sensorlar O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun ham qiziqarli.

title: Development of an Adaptive Damper for Cable Vibration Control
abs: Stay cables have low inherent damping and suffer large rain-wind vibrations, while conventional dampers must sit near the cable ends. The project combined a tuned mass damper with a magnetorheological damper and tested it on a scaled model cable after characterizing two commercial MR dampers. The hybrid damper cut vibration to roughly 20 percent of the uncontrolled level and worked even in passive mode.

uz.t: Vant tebranishini boshqarish uchun moslashuvchan dempfer
uz.ab: Vantli ko‘priklar vantlari yomg‘ir-shamol ta’sirida 1–2 m gacha tebranadi, oddiy mexanik dempferlar esa faqat vant uchiga yaqin joyda samarali. Tadqiqotda ikki tijoriy magnitoreologik (MR) dempfer tok, chastota va harorat ta’sirida sinab ko‘rilib, so‘ng sozlangan massali dempfer bilan birlashtirilgan maxsus TMD-MR qurilmasi yasaldi va 7,16 m uzunlikdagi masshtabli vant modelida tekshirildi. Gibrid dempfer tebranishni boshqarilmagan holatning taxminan 20 % iga tushirdi, toksiz (passiv) rejimda ham ishladi, ammo rezonansdan tashqarida tokni oshirish natijani yomonlashtirishi mumkinligi aniqlandi. O‘zbekistonda yangi vantli ko‘priklarni loyihalash va saqlashda tebranishni moslashuvchan boshqarish tajribasi foydali bo‘ladi.

title: Advanced Traffic Sensor for Work Zone and Incident Management Systems
abs: Existing non-intrusive traffic sensors are costly and hard to maintain in temporary work zones. The team built a relocatable prototype combining a Doppler microwave radar, tilt-sensing compass, solar-battery power and satellite communication. Limited field tests showed real-time speed reporting was feasible at a hardware cost of about 4,150 dollars, but lane-specific data and miniaturization still needed work.

uz.t: Ish zonalari va hodisalarni boshqarish tizimlari uchun ilg‘or transport sensori
uz.ab: Vaqtinchalik ish zonalarida mavjud harakat sensorlarini o‘rnatish, sozlash va quvvat bilan ta’minlash qiyin va qimmat bo‘lgani uchun “qo‘yib unutiladigan” ko‘chma sensor prototipi yaratildi. Qurilmada K-diapazonli Doppler radar, qiyalikni sezuvchi raqamli kompas, quyosh paneli bilan akkumulyator va GPS-li sun’iy yo‘ldosh aloqa terminali birlashtirildi. Aleksandriya (Virjiniya) ko‘chasidagi sinovda 97 ta tezlik o‘lchami yig‘ildi, ma’lumot uzatish 5–10 soniya davom etdi, qurilma qiyalik 20° dan oshsa ogohlantirdi; uskunaning umumiy narxi 4150 dollar bo‘ldi, ammo ko‘p bo‘lakli yo‘llarda radar aniqligi pasaydi. Uyali aloqa qamrovi zaif uzoq hududlardagi O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida ta’mirlash zonalarini kuzatish uchun bunday avtonom sensorlar qo‘l kelishi mumkin.

title: Liquefaction Mitigation Using Vertical Composite Drains: Full Scale Testing
abs: Densifying loose saturated sand to prevent earthquake liquefaction is costly and slow. Full-scale blast tests near Vancouver evaluated slotted vertical composite drains installed with low- and high-vibration methods. Drains sped up pore-pressure dissipation and cut settlement to about 60 percent of the untreated area, at an estimated 48 dollars per square metre versus 75 to 107 for conventional treatments.

uz.t: Vertikal kompozit drenalar bilan gruntning suyulishini kamaytirish: to‘liq o‘lchamli sinov
uz.ab: Suvga to‘yingan bo‘sh qumlarda zilzila paytida grunt suyulib, yo‘l va ko‘priklarga katta zarar yetkazadi, uni zichlashtirishning an’anaviy usullari esa qimmat va sekin. Vankuver yaqinidagi sinov maydonida 10 sm diametrli teshikli plastik drenalar 1,22 m oraliqda 12,8 m chuqurlikkacha o‘rnatilib, so‘ng portlatish orqali suyulish sun’iy hosil qilindi. Drenalar dastlabki suyulishning oldini olmadi, lekin g‘ovak bosimini ancha tez pasaytirdi va cho‘kishni ishlov berilmagan maydondagining taxminan 60 % iga kamaytirdi; narxi kvadrat metr uchun ~48 dollar bo‘lib, tosh ustunlar (~107) va vibrozichlashdan (~75) arzon chiqdi. Seysmik faol O‘zbekistonda suvga to‘yingan qumli gruntlardagi ko‘prik va ko‘tarmalarni himoyalash uchun bu usul e’tiborga loyiq.

title: A Study of Fiber Reinforced Plastics for Seismic Bridge Restrainers
abs: Steel cable restrainers that keep bridge spans from unseating in earthquakes are intrusive to install and hard to inspect. The study tested glass and carbon FRP strips and their bond to concrete, then designed and shake-table tested FRP restrainers. Elastomer coating raised carbon strength by about 40 percent, bond strength rose with loading rate, and FRP restrainers were judged a feasible alternative to steel.

uz.t: Ko‘prikning seysmik cheklagichlari uchun tolali plastiklar
uz.ab: Zilzila paytida ko‘prik oraliq qurilmalari tayanchdan sirg‘alib tushmasligi uchun qo‘llanadigan po‘lat trosli cheklagichlarni o‘rnatish uchun betonni teshish kerak, ularni ko‘zdan kechirish ham qiyin. Tadqiqotda shisha va uglerod tolali plastik (FRP) lentalar turli deformatsiya tezligida cho‘zishga, betonga yopishishi esa 40 ta namunada sug‘urib olishga sinaldi, so‘ng FRP cheklagichlar loyihalanib, silkituvchi stolda tekshirildi. Elastomer qoplama uglerod lenta mustahkamligini taxminan 40 % ga oshirdi, betonga yopishish mustahkamligi esa yuklash tezligi bilan o‘sdi (50 000 µε/s da ~30 % ga); mualliflar FRP cheklagichlarni po‘latga istiqbolli muqobil deb baholadi. Seysmik faol O‘zbekistonda mavjud ko‘priklarni zilzilaga moslab kuchaytirishda bu yengil va korroziyaga chidamli yechim foydali bo‘lishi mumkin.

title: Mobile Geophysical Technology: A Subsurface Scoping Tool for Reducing Unforeseen Roadblocks in Project Delivery
abs: Argus Technologies towed its EM3 electromagnetic induction system behind an ATV to map buried utilities, culverts and soil changes ahead of two Caltrans highway projects. On I-80 at Donner Summit it surveyed about 32 line miles in two days and found 58 transverse features, 18 of them absent from the CAD files, including apparent unmapped culverts.

uz.t: Mobil geofizik texnologiya: loyihada kutilmagan to‘siqlarni kamaytirish uchun yer osti tekshiruvi
uz.ab: Yo‘l qurilishidagi kechikishlarning asosiy sabablaridan biri — oldindan ma’lum bo‘lmagan yer osti sharoitlari: ko‘milgan kommunikatsiyalar, eski quvurlar, kutilmagan grunt o‘zgarishlari. Loyihada kvadrotsiklga tirkalgan EM3 elektromagnit induksiya tizimi (soatiga 8–16 km tezlikda, ~6 m chuqurlikkacha) Kaliforniyadagi ikki yo‘l loyihasida sinaldi. I-80 yo‘lida ikki kunda qariyb 32 mil chiziq tekshirilib, 58 ta ko‘ndalang ob’ekt topildi, ulardan 18 tasi chizmalarda yo‘q edi (jumladan, rejaga kiritilmagan quvurlar); boshqa uchastkada esa neft ifloslanishi bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan yuqori o‘tkazuvchanlik zonasi aniqlandi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘llarni rekonstruksiya qilishda eski kommunikatsiyalar xaritasi ko‘pincha to‘liq emas, shuning uchun burg‘ilashdan oldin tezkor geofizik tekshiruv loyihalash xatolari va kechikishlarni kamaytirishi mumkin.

title: Relationship of Aggregate Texture to Asphalt Pavement Skid Resistance Using Image Analysis of Aggregate Shape
abs: Texas A&M combined Micro-Deval polishing with AIMS image-based texture measurement to rank aggregates by how they keep surface texture, and validated it on nine IH-20 test sections. Aggregate type, not mix type, governed skid resistance: in 2005 sandstone sections measured about 48 skid number versus 40 for quartzite and 37 for siliceous gravel.

uz.t: To‘ldiruvchi shakli tasvir tahlili orqali qoplama mikroteksturasini bashorat qilish metodikasi
uz.ab: Qoplamaning ho‘l holatdagi ishqalanishi past bo‘lsa, avariyalar ko‘payadi, ammo an’anaviy Britaniya mayatnik sinovi to‘ldiruvchilarni bir-biridan yaxshi ajrata olmaydi. Tadqiqotchilar donalarni Micro-Deval barabanida silliqlab, sirt teksturasini AIMS tasvir tizimida o‘lchadilar va natijani Texasdagi IH-20 yo‘lining to‘qqizta sinov uchastkasida tekshirdilar. Ishqalanishni aralashma turi emas, to‘ldiruvchi turi belgiladi: 2005 yilda qumtosh qo‘llangan uchastkalarda ishqalanish soni ~48, kvarsitda 40, kremniyli shag‘alda ~37 bo‘ldi; bir xil teksturali donalar yaxshiroq natija berdi. O‘zbekistonda asfalt uchun mahalliy chaqiq tosh manbalarini tanlashda ularning silliqlanishga chidamliligini oldindan baholash yo‘l harakati xavfsizligini oshirishga xizmat qiladi.

title: Development of a Simple Test to Determine the Low Temperature Creep Compliance of Asphalt Mixtures
abs: The University of Minnesota showed that thin asphalt-mixture beams can be tested in the Bending Beam Rheometer, already common for binder testing, instead of the costlier indirect tensile tester. At the two higher test temperatures IDT creep stiffness was about 86.5% of the BBR value for laboratory mixtures, and a draft specification was prepared for AASHTO review.

uz.t: Asfalt aralashmalarining past haroratdagi siljuvchanligini aniqlovchi oddiy sinov
uz.ab: Past haroratdagi yoriqlar sovuq hududlarda asfalt qoplamaning asosiy nuqsoni, uni baholovchi standart IDT sinovi esa qimmat uskunani talab qiladi. Minnesota universiteti jamoasi bitum sinovida keng tarqalgan egiluvchi balka reometrida (BBR) asfalt aralashmasidan kesilgan yupqa balkachalarni sinash mumkinligini tekshirdi: 660 ta balka uch haroratda sinaldi. Ikkita yuqoriroq haroratda laboratoriya aralashmalari uchun IDT bikrligi BBR qiymatining taxminan 86,5% ini tashkil qildi, eng past haroratdagi natijalar esa ishonchsiz bo‘lib, ular yuqoriroq haroratlardan hisoblab topilishi tavsiya etildi; AASHTO uchun standart loyihasi tayyorlandi. Qishi sovuq, haroratlar farqi katta bo‘lgan O‘zbekiston hududlari uchun asfaltning past haroratga chidamliligini mavjud laboratoriya uskunasi bilan arzon baholash imkonini beradi.

title: An Acoustic Emission-Based Test to Determine Asphalt Binder and Mixture Embrittlement Temperature
abs: The University of Illinois cooled thin binder films and asphalt mixture samples while acoustic emission sensors listened for the first thermal microcracks, defining an embrittlement temperature. AE results closely matched BBR cracking temperatures (for example −36.3 °C vs −34.5 °C), showed coefficients of variation mostly of 1–6%, and the authors judged the device ready for commercial development.

uz.t: Bitum va aralashmaning mo‘rtlashish haroratini akustik emissiya bilan aniqlash sinovi
uz.ab: Sovuq iqlimda asfalt qoplamaning termik yorilishi keng tarqalgan, ammo uni tez va arzon baholaydigan amaliy sinov yo‘q edi. Illinoys universiteti olimlari bitum plyonkasi va asfalt namunalarini +20 °C dan −50 °C gacha sovutib, mikroyoriqlar paydo bo‘lganda chiqadigan tovush to‘lqinlarini akustik emissiya datchiklari bilan qayd etdilar va birinchi kuchli signal haroratini “mo‘rtlashish harorati” deb belgiladilar. Natijalar BBR sinoviga juda yaqin chiqdi (masalan, −36,3 °C va −34,5 °C), takrorlanuvchanlik koeffitsiyenti asosan 1–6% bo‘ldi; RAP qo‘shilgan aralashmalarning mo‘rtlashish harorati yuqoriroq ekani aniqlandi, mualliflar qurilmani tijoriy ishlab chiqishga tayyor deb baholadi. O‘zbekistonda qayta ishlangan asfalt (RAP) qo‘llash kengayayotgan va qishki sovuqlar ham bo‘ladigan sharoitda bitumning past haroratdagi sifatini nazorat qilish uchun bu usul qiziqarli.

title: Rapid Rehabilitation of Highway Slopes using Seeded Microbial Bio-Cement
authors: South Dakota School of Mines and Technology
abs: Bare slopes after wildfires or construction erode by wind and water, raising dust and clogging drainage. The project tested a low-dose, single-application microbially induced calcite precipitation treatment on three soils in the lab and on 16 field plots in South Dakota. The treatment formed a crust of up to over 430 kPa surface strength that controlled erosion while still allowing revegetation, though spilled solutions pose a eutrophication risk.

uz.t: Mikrobli bio-sement bilan yo‘l qiyaliklarini tez tiklash
uz.ab: Yong‘in yoki qurilishdan keyin yalang‘och qolgan yo‘l qiyaliklari shamol va suvdan yemirilib, chang ko‘taradi va suv o‘tkazgich quvurlarni loyqa bilan to‘ldiradi. Tadqiqotda S. pasteurii bakteriyasi, karbamid va kalsiy xloridi bilan bir martalik, kam dozali mikrobli kalsit cho‘ktirish (BioCaN) usuli uch xil gruntda laboratoriyada hamda Janubiy Dakotadagi 16 ta dala maydonchasida an’anaviy usullar bilan solishtirildi. Ishlov berilmagan qumning sirt mustahkamligi 0 bo‘lsa, 0,5x dozada taxminan 240 kPa, 2x dozada 430 kPa dan oshdi; qobiq eroziya va changni kamaytirgani holda o‘simlik o‘sishiga to‘sqinlik qilmadi, biroq eritma suvga to‘kilsa evtrofikatsiya xavfi borligi qayd etildi. Quruq va changli iqlimli O‘zbekistonda, ayniqsa Orolbo‘yi va cho‘l hududlaridagi yo‘l qiyaliklari va yo‘l bo‘yi chang nazorati uchun bu usul e’tiborga loyiq.

title: Beton Laboratuvar El Kitabı
authors: Karayolları Genel Müdürlüğü — Araştırma ve Geliştirme Dairesi Başkanlığı
abs: Handbook of the KGM R&D Department describing laboratory test procedures for road and structural concrete: aggregates, cement, fresh and hardened concrete, admixtures, self-compacting concrete, paving blocks, kerbs, shotcrete and core sampling. Roughly 220 pages with worked examples for evaluating in-situ strength of existing structures.

uz.t: Beton laboratoriyasi qo‘llanmasi (KGM, 2023)
uz.ab: Turkiya avtomobil yo‘llari bosh boshqarmasining ~220 betlik qo‘llanmasi beton uchun to‘ldiruvchilar, sement, yangi qorilgan va qotgan beton, kimyoviy qo‘shimchalar, o‘zi zichlanuvchi beton, yo‘lak plitalari, bordyur toshlari, torkret-beton va kern namunalarini sinash usullarini EN standartlari asosida bosqichma-bosqich bayon qiladi. Mavjud inshootlarda betonning joyidagi mustahkamligini baholash bo‘yicha ishlangan misollar ham bor. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l va ko‘prik laboratoriyalari sinov tartiblarini xalqaro amaliyotga moslashtirishda tayyor namuna bo‘ladi.

title: Karayolu Ulaşım İstatistikleri (2025) / Highway Transportation Statistics
authors: Karayolları Genel Müdürlüğü — Trafik Güvenliği Dairesi Başkanlığı
abs: Bilingual (Turkish/English) statistical yearbook of the Turkish General Directorate of Highways with end-2025 data, published June 2026. Reports a network of 68,517 km (3,796 km motorways), about 96% paved, and 33.6 million motor vehicles (390 per 1,000 people).

uz.t: Turkiya avtomobil yo‘llari transporti statistikasi (2025-yil ma’lumotlari)
uz.ab: KGM ning 2026-yil iyunida chiqqan ikki tilli statistik to‘plami 2025-yil oxiridagi holatni beradi: yo‘l tarmog‘i 68 517 km (shundan 3 796 km avtomagistral, 30 789 km davlat va 33 932 km viloyat yo‘llari), qariyb 96% qattiq qoplamali; avtomobillar soni 33,6 mln, har 1000 kishiga 390 ta. Yuk va yo‘lovchi tashishning taqsimoti ham keltirilgan. O‘zbekiston yo‘l statistikasini yuritish va mintaqaviy taqqoslash uchun tayyor format va solishtirma ko‘rsatkichlar beradi.

title: Karayolları Genel Müdürlüğü 2024-2028 Stratejik Planı
authors: Karayolları Genel Müdürlüğü — Strateji Geliştirme Dairesi Başkanlığı
abs: Strategic plan of Turkey's General Directorate of Highways for 2024–2028, prepared in 2023, with 5 aims, 16 targets and 45 performance indicators. Targets include 1,567 km of new divided roads, 5,474 km of hot-mix asphalt on state and provincial roads, 697 km of new motorways and 206 treated accident black spots by 2028.

uz.t: Turkiya Avtomobil yo‘llari bosh boshqarmasining 2024–2028 yillarga strategik rejasi
uz.ab: Reja 5 maqsad, 16 vazifa va 45 ta samaradorlik ko‘rsatkichini belgilaydi: xavfsiz va bardoshli yo‘llar qurish, tarmoqni samarali saqlash (qoplamalarni boshqarish, iqlim va ofatlarga tayyorgarlik), harakat xavfsizligi va intellektual transport tizimlari, ekologiya hamda institutsional salohiyat. 2028-yilgacha 1 567 km ikki qatnovli yo‘l, 5 474 km issiq asfaltbeton qoplama, 697 km yangi avtomagistral, 246,5 km tunnel va 206 ta avariya o‘chog‘ini bartaraf etish ko‘zda tutilgan. O‘zbekiston yo‘l xo‘jaligi uchun o‘lchanadigan maqsadli ko‘rsatkichlar bilan strategiya tuzish namunasi.

title: ВСП РК 1.3-001-2024 «Процедуры безопасности движения на автомобильных дорогах»
abs: Departmental code of practice approved by Order No. 144 of the Committee of Automobile Roads (25 Nov 2024) setting engineering road-safety procedures across the road life cycle. It requires independent audits by teams of at least two experts and periodic safety inspections of existing roads.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llarida harakat xavfsizligi tartib-taomillari (Qozog‘iston, 2024)
uz.ab: Qozog‘iston Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasining 2024-yil 25-noyabrdagi 144-son buyrug‘i bilan tasdiqlangan idoraviy qoidalar to‘plami yo‘lning butun hayotiy sikli davomida xavfsizlik auditi, mavjud yo‘llarni inspeksiya qilish va avariya o‘choqlarini boshqarish tartibini belgilaydi. Audit loyihachidan mustaqil, kamida ikki mutaxassisdan iborat guruh tomonidan o‘tkaziladi; serqatnov yo‘llar yiliga ikki marta, qolganlari kamida uch yilda bir marta tekshiriladi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l xavfsizligi auditi tizimini joriy etishda eng yaqin mintaqaviy namuna.

title: ВН РК 3.1-001-2024 «Автомобильные дороги» (с изм. № 1)
abs: Departmental design standard for new, reconstructed and capitally repaired public roads outside settlements, approved 25 Nov 2024 (Order No. 144) with Amendment No. 1 of 18 Feb 2026. It sets road categories IA–V by traffic, design speeds (150 km/h for IA on flat terrain) and design axle loads of 100 or 130 kN.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llari: idoraviy loyihalash normativi (Qozog‘iston, 2024, 1-o‘zgartirish bilan)
uz.ab: Aholi punktlaridan tashqaridagi umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llarni yangidan qurish, rekonstruksiya va kapital ta’mirlashda loyihalash talablari: IA–V toifalar harakat jadalligi bo‘yicha, hisobiy tezliklar (IA uchun tekislikda 150 km/soat, tog‘da 80 km/soat), o‘q yuklamasi 100 kN (A1) yoki 130 kN (A2, xalqaro yo‘llar uchun), ko‘ndalang kesim, plan va bo‘ylama profil, yo‘l poyi, qoplama, ko‘prik va quvurlar. 2026-yil 18-fevralda 1-o‘zgartirish kiritilgan. O‘zbekistondagi ShNQ 2.05.02 bilan solishtirish va xalqaro yo‘laklar uchun 130 kN yuklamaga o‘tish masalasida muhim manba.

title: ВН РК 1.5-001-2024 «Нормативные документы автодорожной отрасли»
abs: Departmental standard of 21 Nov 2024 defining the structure of Kazakhstan's road-sector technical regulation system and the procedure for developing, approving, repealing and applying road normative documents. It is binding on all bodies and organisations that develop or use such documents.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llari sohasining normativ hujjatlari (Qozog‘iston, 2024)
uz.ab: Hujjat Qozog‘iston yo‘l sohasida texnik reglamentlash tizimining maqsadi, tamoyillari va tuzilmasini, idoraviy normativlarni ishlab chiqish, kelishish, tasdiqlash, bekor qilish va rasmiylashtirish tartibini hamda belgilash (shifr) tizimini belgilaydi. Davlat organlari va mulkchilik shaklidan qat’i nazar barcha tashkilotlar uchun majburiy. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l normativlari bazasini yangilash va idoraviy hujjatlar tizimini tartibga solish uchun tayyor model.

title: ВН РК 7.1-002-2025 «Диагностика и паспортизация»
abs: Departmental standard approved by Order No. 120 of 4 Dec 2025 setting uniform requirements for diagnostics and passportisation of public roads and structures. It requires annual condition diagnostics, passportisation at least every five years, and assesses condition by defects, IRI roughness and skid resistance.
