uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llarini diagnostika va pasportlash (Qozog‘iston, 2025)
uz.ab: Qozog‘iston yo‘llari va sun’iy inshootlari (ko‘prik, yo‘l o‘tkazgich, tunnel, quvur)ning holatini aniqlash va pasportlash bo‘yicha yagona talablar: diagnostika har yili, pasportlash kamida 5 yilda bir marta yoki qurilish/rekonstruksiyadan keyin o‘tkaziladi; ijrochi kamida 5 yillik tajribaga va attestatsiyadan o‘tgan ko‘chma laboratoriyaga ega bo‘lishi shart. Holat nuqsonlar, IRI ravonlik ko‘rsatkichi va ilashish koeffitsiyenti bo‘yicha baholanadi, 70 balldan yuqori indeks me’yorga mos deb hisoblanadi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l aktivlarini boshqarish va ta’mir rejalashtirish ma’lumotlar bazasini yaratishda bevosita qo‘llanadigan metodika.

title: ВСП РК 11-001-2025 «Информационное моделирование с использованием BIM технологии на автомобильных дорогах»
abs: Departmental code of practice approved on 18 Nov 2025 (Order No. 119) on BIM for public roads across the whole life cycle, from surveys to demolition. It makes a Common Data Environment mandatory, defines OIR/AIR/PIR/EIR information requirements and requires open IFC deliverables for review and archiving.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llarida BIM texnologiyasi yordamida axborot modellashtirish (Qozog‘iston, 2025)
uz.ab: Qoidalar to‘plami yo‘llarni qidiruv, loyihalash, qurilish, ekspluatatsiya va rekonstruksiya bosqichlarida BIM qo‘llash talablarini belgilaydi: umumiy ma’lumotlar muhiti (CDE) majburiy, axborot talablari to‘rt darajada (OIR, AIR, PIR, EIR), modellar ekspertiza va arxiv uchun ochiq IFC formatida topshiriladi, jiddiy nomuvofiqligi bor model “nashr etilgan” zonaga o‘tkazilmaydi. O‘zbekiston yo‘l sohasida BIMni joriy etish bo‘yicha qarorlarni amalga oshirishda mintaqadagi eng yangi va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri moslashtirsa bo‘ladigan namuna.

title: ВН РК 3.2.7-001-2025 «Мостовые сооружения. Зоны сопряжения мостовых сооружений с насыпью»
abs: Departmental standard approved on 12 Dec 2025 (Order No. 127) for designing junctions between bridges and approach embankments, including transition slabs, support nodes and drainage backfill. It applies in seismic areas up to intensity 9 and requires, for example, transition slabs of at least 4 m and backfill compaction of at least 0.98.

uz.t: Ko‘prik inshootlari: ko‘priklarning ko‘tarma bilan tutashish zonalari (Qozog‘iston, 2025)
uz.ab: Normativ ko‘prik oldi ko‘tarmalari bilan tutashuv zonalarini loyihalashni tartibga soladi: temir-beton o‘tish plitalari (uzunligi kamida 4 m, cho‘kish farqidan bo‘ylama sinish 2‰ dan oshmasligi), tayanch tugunlari, shag‘al asoslar, drenaj to‘kmasi (zichlik koeffitsiyenti ≥0,98, filtratsiya ≥2 m/sutka) va qiyalik barqarorligi (zaxira koeffitsiyenti ≥1,3). 9 ballgacha seysmik hududlarda qo‘llanadi. O‘zbekiston ko‘priklarida keng tarqalgan “ko‘prik oldidagi o‘pirilish/zarb” muammosini hal qilish uchun bevosita amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

title: ВН РК 6.1-001-2024 «Зимнее содержание автомобильных дорог общего пользования»
abs: Departmental standard approved on 25 Nov 2024 (Order No. 144) on winter maintenance of public roads and structures, replacing earlier Kazakh rules. It defines five slipperiness-control methods and five maintenance levels with response deadlines, and restricts chloride de-icers in settlements and on new concrete pavements.

uz.t: Umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llarini qishda saqlash (Qozog‘iston, 2024)
uz.ab: Hujjat qishki saqlash talablari, muzlashga qarshi materiallardan foydalanish, uzluksiz va xavfsiz harakatni ta’minlash hamda mehnat va atrof-muhit muhofazasini belgilaydi. Sirpanchiqlikka qarshi kurashning besh usuli (mexanik, friksion, kimyoviy, issiqlik, aralash) va GOST 33181 bo‘yicha besh saqlash darajasi keltirilgan; 1-daraja uchun ishlov berish muddati odatiy sharoitda 2 soat. Aholi punktlarida osh tuzi ishlatish va yangi sement-beton qoplamada bir yil xlorid reagentlar qo‘llash taqiqlanadi. O‘zbekistonning tog‘li dovonlari (Qamchiq, Taxtaqoracha) qishki saqlash reglamenti uchun qo‘l keladi.

title: ВН РК 8.12-001-2024 «Контроль качества и приемка работ при строительстве и ремонте автомобильных дорог» (с изм. № 1)
abs: Departmental standard approved on 25 Nov 2024 (Order No. 144), amended 15 Apr 2026, governing quality control and acceptance of road construction and repair. It sets three-stage control (input, operational, acceptance), contractor quality plans, independent expert checks with 100% continuous control of finished asphalt, and a warranty of at least two years.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llarini qurish va ta’mirlashda ishlar sifatini nazorat qilish va qabul qilish (Qozog‘iston, 2024)
uz.ab: Normativ qurilish, rekonstruksiya, kapital, o‘rta va joriy ta’mirda sifat nazoratining uch bosqichini (materiallarni kirish nazorati, operatsion va qabul nazorati), buyurtmachi texnik nazoratini, pudratchining sifat rejasini va mustaqil ekspertizani belgilaydi; tayyor asfaltbeton qoplama 100% uzluksiz nazorat qilinadi, nuqson bartaraf etilmaguncha to‘lov qilinmaydi, kafolat muddati kamida 2 yil. 2026-yil 15-aprelda 1-o‘zgartirish kiritilgan. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l qurilishi sifatini nazorat qilish va kafolat tizimini kuchaytirish uchun to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri tajriba.

title: ВСП РК 7.2-001-2024 «Системы мониторинга мостовых сооружений»
abs: Departmental code of practice approved on 25 Nov 2024 setting requirements for monitoring systems on new and reconstructed bridges, overpasses and viaducts. Monitoring is recommended for spans over 100 m, piers above 15 m and high-seismicity or dense urban sites, with a seven-stage workflow and continuous automated systems for unique bridges.

uz.t: Ko‘prik inshootlarini monitoring qilish tizimlari (Qozog‘iston, 2024)
uz.ab: Qoidalar yangi va rekonstruksiya qilingan ko‘priklar, yo‘l o‘tkazgichlar va estakadalarda monitoring tizimlarini qo‘llash talablarini beradi: oraliqlari 100 m dan katta, tayanchlari 15 m dan baland, yuqori seysmik va zich shahar sharoitidagi inshootlar uchun tavsiya etiladi; ish tekshiruvdan uskunani demontaj qilishgacha 7 bosqichda bajariladi; noyob ko‘priklarda avtomatik uzluksiz tizim, sinov ekspluatatsiyasi 3–6 oy, kafolat kamida 12 oy. Xavfli holat aniqlansa, egasi zudlik bilan xabardor qilinib, harakat to‘xtatiladi. O‘zbekistonda katta ko‘priklar va Toshkent estakadalari uchun monitoring talablarini ishlab chiqishda foydali.

title: ВСП РК 7.2-002-2024 «Методика оценки транспортно-эксплуатационного состояния мостовых сооружений на автомобильных дорогах»
abs: Departmental methodology approved on 25 Nov 2024 for inspecting and rating bridges on all public road categories. It rates safety, load capacity and strength on six-point scales, classifies defects on five levels, and requires inspection of bridges over 100 m at least every five years and of others at least every ten years.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llaridagi ko‘prik inshootlarining transport-ekspluatatsion holatini baholash metodikasi (Qozog‘iston, 2024)
uz.ab: Metodika ko‘priklarning texnik holatini uch xususiyat — ekspluatatsion xavfsizlik, yuk ko‘tarish qobiliyati va mustahkamlik bo‘yicha olti balli shkalada baholaydi, nuqsonlarni besh darajaga ajratadi, transport-ekspluatatsion holatni xavfsiz harakat tezligiga ko‘ra besh guruhga bo‘ladi. Uzunligi 100 m dan ortiq ko‘priklar kamida 5 yilda, qolganlari 10 yilda bir marta tekshiriladi. O‘zbekistondagi ko‘priklarni inventarizatsiya qilish va ta’mir navbatini asoslashda bevosita qo‘llanadigan baholash tizimi.

title: ВСП РК 7.1-001-2025 «Учет и прогнозирование интенсивности движения транспортного потока на автомобильных дорогах»
abs: Departmental code of practice approved on 18 Nov 2025 (Order No. 119), replacing ER RK 218-04-2014, on traffic volume and composition counts and forecasting on public roads (the cover lists it as VSP RK 7.1-002-2025). It prescribes quarterly counts on mid-week days, 8-hour short counts, accuracy limits of 5% (volume) and 10% (composition), and forecasts up to 20 years.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llarida transport oqimi harakat jadalligini hisobga olish va prognozlash (Qozog‘iston, 2025)
uz.ab: Qoidalar hisob punktlarini joylashtirish, hisobni tashkil etish va kelajakdagi jadallikni prognozlash tartibini belgilaydi: hisob kamida chorakda bir marta seshanba–payshanba kunlari, qisqa muddatli hisob 8 soat (9:00–17:00) olib boriladi, xatolik umumiy soni bo‘yicha 5%, tarkibi bo‘yicha 10% dan oshmasligi kerak, uskunalar yiliga bir marta tekshiriladi. Prognoz 20 yilgacha, aholi punktlari juftliklari o‘rtasidagi aloqa modeli asosida tuziladi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l toifasini belgilash va qoplama loyihalash uchun ishonchli trafik ma’lumotlarini yig‘ishda foydali.

title: ВН РК 1.6-002-2025 «Назначение межремонтных сроков конструктивных элементов автомобильных дорог»
abs: Departmental standard approved on 18 Nov 2025 (Order No. 119) assigning inter-repair periods and warranty periods to road structural elements and furniture after construction or repair. Examples: 16 years to capital repair for Category I asphalt pavements, 25 years for cement-concrete pavements, and a minimum warranty of two years.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llari konstruktiv elementlarining ta’mirlararo muddatlarini belgilash (Qozog‘iston, 2025)
uz.ab: Normativ qurilish, rekonstruksiya va ta’mirdan keyingi qoplamalar, ko‘priklar, belgilar va to‘siqlar uchun ta’mirlararo va kafolat muddatlarini belgilaydi: I toifa (>7000 avt/sutka) asfaltbeton qoplama uchun kapital ta’mirgacha 16 yil, II toifa — 15 yil, sement-beton qoplama — 25 yil va 8 yil kafolat; polimer modifikatorli qoplama muddatni 2–3 yilga uzaytiradi; kafolat kamida 2 yil, ko‘prik elementlari 5 yil, to‘siqlar 3 yil. O‘zbekistonda pudratchilar kafolati va ta’mir rejalarini asoslash uchun tayyor raqamli mezonlar.

title: ВН РК 6.1.4-001-2026 «Содержание, эксплуатация и ремонт объектов улично-дорожной сети городов республиканского значения»
abs: Departmental standard approved on 26 Jun 2026 (Order No. 55) for maintenance, operation and repair of street networks in Kazakhstan's cities of republican significance. It covers inter-repair and warranty periods and traffic-control devices, sets spring and autumn warranty inspections, deadlines of 7 days for critical defects, and bans sodium chloride de-icers.

uz.t: Respublika ahamiyatidagi shaharlar ko‘cha-yo‘l tarmog‘i obyektlarini saqlash, ekspluatatsiya qilish va ta’mirlash (Qozog‘iston, 2026)
uz.ab: Normativ Astana, Almati, Shimkent kabi shaharlarda ko‘chalar, piyodalar va velosiped yo‘laklari, sun’iy inshootlar, belgilar va chiziqlarni saqlash talablarini, ta’mirlararo va kafolat muddatlarini belgilaydi: kafolat ko‘riklari may va sentyabrda, kritik nuqsonlar 7 kunda, jiddiylari 30 kunda bartaraf etiladi; muzga qarshi osh tuzi (NaCl) ishlatish taqiqlangan. Toshkent va boshqa yirik shaharlarimiz ko‘cha-yo‘l tarmog‘ini saqlash reglamentlari uchun eng yangi mintaqaviy namuna.

title: Р РК 218-188-2022 «Рекомендации по применению углеродно-наномодифицированного битума в дорожном строительстве»
abs: Recommendations approved on 28 Dec 2022 (Order No. 154) for hot asphalt mixes made with bitumen modified by carbon nanopowder for upper layers of Category I–III roads in road-climatic zones III–V. They specify binder preparation temperatures, nanopowder properties (100–200 nm, 90–93% carbon) and mix strength requirements.

uz.t: Yo‘l qurilishida uglerod-nanomodifikatsiyalangan bitumni qo‘llash bo‘yicha tavsiyalar (Qozog‘iston, 2022)
uz.ab: Tavsiyalar uglerod nanokukuni bilan modifikatsiyalangan bitumdagi issiq asfaltbeton qorishmalarni I–III toifa yo‘llarning ustki qatlamlarida qo‘llashni tartibga soladi: bitum 145–150 °C da qizdirilib, nanokukun qo‘shiladi, qorishma kamida 165 °C, yotqizish 145 °C dan past emas; nanokukun zarralari 100–200 nm, uglerod 90–93%; 50 °C da siqilishdagi mustahkamlik A turi uchun 1,2 MPa, B turi uchun 1,5 MPa. Issiq iqlimli O‘zbekistonda asfalt qoplamalarning iz hosil bo‘lishiga chidamliligini oshirish bo‘yicha tajriba sifatida qiziqarli.

title: Р РК 218-190-2022 «Рекомендации по улучшению сцепления битумов с каменными материалами»
abs: Recommendations approved on 28 Dec 2022 (Order No. 154) on methods for assessing and improving adhesion of bitumen to mineral aggregates, with or without adhesion-promoting additives. They cover where additives may be introduced, performance requirements and safety and environmental rules.

uz.t: Bitumlarning tosh materiallar bilan ilashishini yaxshilash bo‘yicha tavsiyalar (Qozog‘iston, 2022)
uz.ab: Hujjat bitumning turli tosh materiallarga adgeziyasini aniqlash usullarini va adgeziv qo‘shimchalarni qo‘llashni bayon qiladi: qo‘shimcha neftni qayta ishlash zavodida, bitum bazasida yoki asfalt zavodida kiritilishi mumkin; faolligi qum bo‘yicha kamida 13%, bitumning termooksidlanish eskirishiga ta’siri 3 °C dan oshmasligi kerak; qo‘shimchali bitum bir ish kunida ishlatiladi. O‘zbekistonda granit va ohaktosh chaqiqtoshlari bilan asfaltbeton qoplamalarning ko‘chib ketishini kamaytirish uchun amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

title: Р РК 218-191-2022 «Рекомендации по применению битумов отечественного производства в зависимости от климатических и эксплуатационных условий»
abs: Recommendations approved on 28 Dec 2022 (Order No. 154) for selecting road bitumen grades by forecast traffic and climate, using ST RK 1373 and GOST 33133 indicators. They link BND grades to climate zones, set minimum dynamic viscosity at 60 °C and give a method for maximum design temperature.

uz.t: Mahalliy ishlab chiqarilgan bitumlarni iqlim va ekspluatatsiya sharoitlariga qarab qo‘llash bo‘yicha tavsiyalar (Qozog‘iston, 2022)
uz.ab: Tavsiyalar bitum markasini harakat yuklamasi va iqlimga qarab tanlash tartibini beradi: BND 100/130 — III–IV, BND 70/100 va BND 50/70 — IV–V iqlim zonalari uchun; 60 °C dagi dinamik qovushqoqlik markalarga ko‘ra kamida 120, 145 va 250 Pa·s, eskirishdan keyin oshish 2,5 martadan ko‘p emas; ilovada ruxsat etilgan maksimal harorat hisoblash misoli bor. O‘zbekistonning issiq janubiy va tog‘li hududlari uchun bitum tanlash mezonlarini ishlab chiqishda bevosita taqqoslash manbai.

title: Р РК 218-197-2022 «Рекомендации по определению объема выравнивающего слоя асфальтобетонной смеси»
abs: Recommendations approved on 28 Dec 2022 (Order No. 154) for calculating the actual laid volume of asphalt levelling course on public roads. They compare geodetic (elevation-based) and tonnage-based methods and set minimum thicknesses tied to aggregate size.

uz.t: Asfaltbeton qorishmasining tekislovchi qatlami hajmini aniqlash bo‘yicha tavsiyalar (Qozog‘iston, 2022)
uz.ab: Hujjat ta’mir va rekonstruksiyada tekislovchi asfaltbeton qatlamining haqiqiy hajmini ikki usulda — yotqizishdan oldin va keyin geodezik o‘lchovlar hamda zavod yetkazib bergan tonnaj bo‘yicha hisoblash va solishtirishni bayon qiladi; qatlam qalinligi eng yirik fraksiyadan kamida 1,5 marta katta bo‘lishi kerak. O‘zbekistonda ta’mir ishlari hajmini to‘g‘ri hisoblash va smeta/to‘lov nizolarining oldini olish uchun foydali.

title: СТ РК 1912-2023 «Автомобильные дороги и улицы. Нормы и требования к эксплуатационному состоянию»
authors: Комитет технического регулирования и метрологии РК
abs: National standard dated 21 Nov 2023 and in force since 1 Jul 2024 setting operational-condition norms for public roads, urban streets and railway crossings, with inspection methods and compliance deadlines. The link is the official legal-database record (demo view; full text requires login).

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llari va ko‘chalar. Ekspluatatsion holatga qo‘yiladigan me’yor va talablar (Qozog‘iston, 2023)
uz.ab: Davlat standarti umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llar, shahar ko‘chalari va temir yo‘l kesishmalarining yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi uchun maqbul ekspluatatsion holatini belgilaydi: qatnov qismi, yo‘l yoqasi, trotuar va velosiped yo‘laklari qoplamasiga talablar, yoriq va choklarni ta’mirlash, ko‘rinish, qishki holat, nazorat usullari va nuqsonlarni bartaraf etish muddatlari. 2024-yil 1-iyuldan amalda; havola rasmiy huquqiy bazadagi yozuvga olib boradi (to‘liq matn ro‘yxatdan o‘tganlarga). O‘zbekistondagi tegishli O‘zDSt talablarini yangilashda solishtirish uchun asosiy manba.

title: Beton va asfalt-beton yo‘llarini ta’mirlash va germetizatsiyalash uchun fizik-kimyoviy modifikatsiyalangan samarali kompozitsion materiallarni ishlab chiqish
org: Islom Karimov nomidagi Toshkent davlat texnika universiteti (O‘zbekiston)
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 02.00.07 – kompozitsion, lok-bo‘yoq va rezina materiallari kimyosi va texnologiyasi ixtisosligi. Himoya 2026-yil 23-noyabr soat 11:00 da ToshDTU huzuridagi DSc.03/2025.27.12.T.02.06 ilmiy kengashida belgilangan. Ish beton va asfalt-beton yo‘l qoplamalaridagi darz va choklarni ta’mirlash hamda germetizatsiyalash uchun fizik-kimyoviy modifikatsiyalangan kompozitlarni yaratishga bag‘ishlangan; havola UzA’dagi rasmiy himoya e’loniga beriladi, avtoreferat PDF hali topilmadi.

title: Kationli sirt faol moddalar sintezi va ularni modifikatsiyalash asosida polimer-bitum emulsiyalari olish texnologiyasini ishlab chiqish
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 02.00.11 – kolloid va membrana kimyosi ixtisosligi. Himoya 2026-yil 9-oktabrda Buxoro davlat texnika universiteti huzuridagi DSc.03/2025.27.12.T.16.05 ilmiy kengashida e’lon qilingan. Ish kationli sirt faol moddalarni sintez qilish va ular asosida polimer-bitum emulsiyalari olish texnologiyasiga bag‘ishlangan — bunday emulsiyalar yo‘l qoplamalarini qurish va ta’mirlashda qo‘llaniladi, ammo e’lonning o‘zida yo‘l sohasi bevosita tilga olinmagan; havola rasmiy himoya e’loniga beriladi, avtoreferat PDF topilmadi.

title: Inverted Pavements Synthesis (FHWA-HIF-24-023)
abs: FHWA synthesis (February 2024, 275 pp.) of inverted pavements — a thin asphalt surface over an unbound crushed-stone base on a cement-stabilised layer. It reviews eight US case studies and South African experience, finding the unbound layer delays reflective cracking, and gives recommendations on climate, drainage, prime coat and base moisture.

uz.t: Teskari (inverted) yo‘l to‘shamalari bo‘yicha sintez
uz.ab: FHWA hisobotida yupqa asfalt qoplama, bog‘lanmagan chaqiq tosh asos va uning ostidagi sement bilan mustahkamlangan qatlamdan iborat “teskari” konstruksiya o‘rganilgan; AQShdagi 8 ta tajriba uchastkasi va Janubiy Afrika tajribasi tahlil qilingan. Bog‘lanmagan qatlam sementlangan qatlamdan chiqadigan aks etuvchi darzlarni sekinlashtirishi, quruq-issiq iqlimda yaxshi ishlashi, Janubiy Afrika HVS sinovlarida 2 dyuymli qoplama 50 mln standart o‘qqa bardosh bergani qayd etilgan. Quruq va issiq iqlimli, sementlangan asoslar keng qo‘llanadigan O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun bu yechim arzon va chidamli muqobil bo‘lishi mumkin.

title: Pavement Preservation Program Benchmarking (FHWA-HIF-24-024)
abs: Benchmarking study (January 2024, 46 pp.) of state DOT pavement preservation programmes based on a literature review and a 2021 survey of 50 agencies. It reports how many agencies have formal policies, contract out treatments and use performance models, and names construction quality and funding as the main obstacles.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamalarini saqlash dasturlarini qiyosiy baholash
uz.ab: AQShning 50 ta shtat yo‘l agentligi so‘rovi asosida qoplamalarni profilaktik saqlash dasturlari solishtirilgan: 27 tasida rasmiy siyosat bor, 36 tasida asfalt ishlovlari uchun ishlash modellari mavjud, 14 tasida esa umuman model yo‘q. Asosiy to‘siqlar sifatida qurilish sifati (32 agentlik) va mablag‘ yetishmasligi (26) ko‘rsatilgan, ishlashni monitoring qilish va modellashtirish eng muhim ehtiyoj deb topilgan. O‘zbekistonda ta’mirlashdan profilaktik saqlashga o‘tishni rejalashtirishda bu tajriba tayyor mezonlar beradi.

title: Use of Industrial Byproducts in Concrete Paving Applications (FHWA-HIF-24-049)
abs: FHWA technical summary (June 2024, 28 pp.) on using industrial wastes — coal and bottom ash, MSWI ash, ground glass, foundry sand, recycled concrete aggregate — as aggregate or supplementary cementitious material in concrete pavements. It discusses barriers such as variability, supply and leaching and recommends characterisation, trial batches and field trials.

uz.t: Beton yo‘l qoplamalarida sanoat qo‘shimcha mahsulotlaridan foydalanish
uz.ab: Hujjatda ko‘mir kuli, tub kuli, maishiy chiqindi yoqish kuli, maydalangan shisha, quyish qumi va qayta ishlangan beton to‘ldiruvchisini beton qoplamalarida tabiiy to‘ldiruvchi yoki sement o‘rnini bosuvchi sifatida qo‘llash ko‘rib chiqilgan. Shisha pussolani, qayta ishlangan beton va ko‘mir kuli standartlar bilan tasdiqlangan, quyish qumi va yoqish kuli uchun esa standart yo‘q; yuvilish va pH 12 gacha bo‘lgan oqova suvlar nazorati tavsiya etiladi. O‘zbekistonning IES kullari va qurilish chiqindilaridan yo‘l qurilishida foydalanish uchun amaliy asos bo‘ladi.

title: Pavement Resilience: State of the Practice (FHWA-HIF-23-006)
abs: FHWA state-of-practice report (March 2023, 37 pp.) on pavement resilience to climate stressors, drawing on climate assessments, a literature review and two 2020 peer exchanges with 92 participants. It finds flooding is the top concern, that thicker structures tolerate inundation better, and identifies gaps such as the lack of agreed climate data and risk-assessment methods.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamalarining iqlimga bardoshliligi: amaliyot holati
uz.ab: Hisobotda iqlim o‘zgarishi (harorat ko‘tarilishi, toshqinlar, dengiz sathi) yo‘l qoplamalariga ta’siri va bunga moslashish amaliyoti tahlil qilingan; 2021–2050 yillarda AQShda o‘rtacha harorat taxminan 1,4 °C ga oshishi kutilmoqda. Suv bosishi qoplama qatlamlarini to‘yintirishi, qalinroq konstruksiyalar bardoshliroq ekani va loyihalashda tarixiy emas, prognoz iqlim ma’lumotlaridan foydalanish zarurligi ta’kidlangan. Yozgi harorat 45 °C dan oshadigan va sel xavfi bor O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun iqlimga moslashgan loyihalash talablarini ishlab chiqishda foydali.

title: Responsible Use of Polyphosphoric Acid (PPA) Modification of Asphalt Binders (FHWA-HIF-23-005)
abs: Short FHWA tech brief (February 2023, 12 pp.) on modifying asphalt binders with polyphosphoric acid. It explains how PPA raises high-temperature grade, how its presence is detected (AASHTO T 377) and quantified by XRF, and summarises state limits, commonly 0.5 percent.

uz.t: Asfalt bitumlarini polifosfor kislota (PPA) bilan mas’uliyatli modifikatsiyalash
uz.ab: Qo‘llanmada bitumga polifosfor kislota qo‘shib uning yuqori haroratdagi bardoshliligini oshirish ko‘rib chiqilgan: PG64-22 bitumiga 0,25% PPA qo‘shilganda yuqori harorat chegarasi 66,1 °C dan 68,6 °C ga ko‘tarilgan. PPA borligini aniqlash (AASHTO T 377) va miqdorini rentgen-fluoressensiya bilan o‘lchash, 1% gacha namlikdan shikastlanish oshmasligi, shtatlarda odatda 0,5% chegara qo‘yilgani bayon etilgan. Issiq iqlimda iz hosil bo‘lishiga qarshi mahalliy bitumlarni modifikatsiyalashda O‘zbekiston uchun arzon yo‘l sifatida ahamiyatli.

title: Pavement Management Roadmap (FHWA-HIF-22-054)
abs: FHWA's 2022 update (September 2022, 135 pp.) of its pavement management roadmap, built from a literature review, a survey of 61 practitioners and stakeholder sessions with 147 participants. It sets a ten-year research and technology-transfer agenda of 72 action items in 15 improvement areas, grouped under data, analysis tools, workforce and technology.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamalarini boshqarish bo‘yicha yo‘l xaritasi
uz.ab: Hujjat yo‘l qoplamalarini boshqarish tizimlaridagi kamchiliklarni aniqlab, 10 yillik tadqiqot va texnologiya joriy etish rejasini taklif qiladi: 15 yo‘nalishda 72 ta chora (46 tasi qisqa muddatli), umumiy taxminiy qiymati qariyb 30,2 mln dollar. Chora-tadbirlar ma’lumotlar, tahlil vositalari, kadrlar va tashkiliy masalalar hamda yangi texnologiyalar bo‘yicha guruhlangan. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l aktivlarini boshqarish tizimini yaratish va ilmiy-tadqiqot ustuvorliklarini belgilashda namuna bo‘la oladi.

title: Utilizing Intelligent Compaction to Ensure Quality and Uniformity of Pavement Foundation (FHWA-HIF-24-097)
abs: FHWA tech brief (2024) on using intelligent compaction rollers to map stiffness of subgrade and base layers before paving. Field sections showed strong correlation with LWD modulus on some layers but weak on others, so the authors recommend pre-mapping, flagging low-percentile areas and developing an AASHTO standard and certification.

uz.t: Yo‘l asosining sifati va bir xilligini intellektual zichlash orqali ta’minlash
uz.ab: Texnik qisqacha hisobotda zichlash darajasini butun maydon bo‘yicha xaritalaydigan intellektual zichlash (IC) katoklaridan yo‘l poyi va asos qatlamlarini nazorat qilishda foydalanish baholangan; Minnesota uchastkasida LWD moduli bilan bog‘liqlik R = 0,87 bo‘lgan. Nuqtaviy sinovlar bilan solishtirish ishonchsizligi sababli oldindan xaritalash va eng past 10% hududlarni tekshirish tavsiya etiladi. O‘zbekistonda yangi yo‘l qurilishida asos zichligini nazorat qilishni zamonaviylashtirish uchun foydali.

title: Jointed Concrete Pavement Faulting Collection and Analysis: TPF-5(299) Final Report (FHWA-RC-24-0007)
abs: Pooled-fund final report (September 2024, 89 pp.) that standardises how faulting at joints of jointed concrete pavements is measured from longitudinal profiles. It proposes three equipment-neutral definitions, shows inconsistencies in current methods and recommends a two-phase certification of measuring equipment.

uz.t: Chokli beton qoplamalardagi pog‘onalarni o‘lchash va tahlil qilish
uz.ab: Hisobotda beton qoplama choklaridagi pog‘onalarni (faulting) bo‘ylama profil asosida o‘lchashning standartlashtirilgan usullari ishlab chiqilgan; tashqi g‘ildirak izining 30 dyuymli kengligi bo‘yicha uch xil uskunadan mustaqil ta’rif taklif qilingan. Mavjud usullarda choklarni aniqlash darajasi 58% dan 99,4% gacha farq qilishi ko‘rsatilgan, o‘lchov uskunalarini ikki bosqichli sertifikatlash tavsiya etiladi. O‘zbekistonda sementbeton qoplamali magistral yo‘llar ko‘payayotgani sababli ularning holatini monitoring qilishda qo‘llash mumkin.

title: Successful Practices for Quality Management of Pavement Surface Condition Data Collection and Analysis (FHWA-RC-23-0002)
abs: FHWA final report (February 2023, 141 pp.) on data quality management for automated pavement surface condition surveys, based on a review of state programmes and pilots in three states. It covers equipment certification and verification, control sites and acceptance checks, including transverse profile systems.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamasi holati ma’lumotlarini yig‘ish va tahlil qilish sifatini boshqarishning muvaffaqiyatli amaliyotlari
uz.ab: Qo‘llanmada avtomatlashtirilgan laboratoriyalar yordamida yo‘l qoplamasi holati (notekislik, darzlar, iz) bo‘yicha ma’lumot yig‘ishda aniqlik va ishonchlilikni ta’minlash usullari berilgan; Alabama, Vashington va Pensilvaniyadagi pilot loyihalar natijalari keltirilgan. Uskunalarni sertifikatlash, nazorat uchastkalari va kundalik-haftalik tekshiruvlar (masalan, kalibrlashning 95% i tolerantlik ichida bo‘lishi) tavsiya etiladi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l holati diagnostikasi va ma’lumotlar bazasini yuritishda sifat nazorati tartibini joriy etish uchun foydali.

title: Use of Recycled Concrete Aggregate in Concrete Paving Mixtures (FHWA-HIF-22-020)
abs: FHWA tech brief (February 2022) on using recycled concrete aggregate in new concrete pavement mixtures. It describes the effects on water demand, strength, permeability and shrinkage and the mix-design measures that manage them, with US project examples.

uz.t: Beton yo‘l qoplamasi aralashmalarida qayta ishlangan beton to‘ldiruvchisidan foydalanish
uz.ab: Texnik qisqacha hisobotda eski betondan olingan to‘ldiruvchini yangi beton qoplamada ishlatish tajribasi (AQShda 100 dan ortiq loyiha) umumlashtirilgan. Bunday aralashmalar 5–15% ko‘proq suv talab qiladi, mustahkamligi pastroq, o‘tkazuvchanligi 500% gacha oshishi mumkin; past suv-sement nisbati, qo‘shimcha bog‘lovchilar va mayda fraksiyani ~30% bilan cheklash tavsiya etiladi. O‘zbekistonda eski beton yo‘llarni qayta qurishda chiqindini kamaytirish va tabiiy chaqiqni tejash uchun dolzarb.

title: NDT and ICT for Asphalt Pavement Construction (FHWA-HIF-24-031)
abs: FHWA tech brief (April 2024) summarising paver-mounted thermal profiling, intelligent compaction, dielectric profiling and the Veta software for asphalt quality assurance. It links each technology to AASHTO standards and concludes they are ready as contractor QC tools, while agency acceptance needs new verification procedures.

uz.t: Asfalt qoplama qurilishida buzmasdan nazorat (NDT) va intellektual qurilish texnologiyalari (ICT)
uz.ab: Qisqacha hisobotda asfalt yotqizgichga o‘rnatiladigan termal profil tizimi, intellektual zichlash, dielektrik profil tizimi va ularni birlashtiruvchi Veta dasturi tavsiflangan (AASHTO R 110, R 111, PP 98). Missuri shtatida termal profil joriy etilgach kuchli termal segregatsiya 10% ga kamaygan, dielektrik usul takrorlanuvchanligi an’anaviy usullardan uch baravar yaxshi. O‘zbekistonda asfaltbeton qoplama sifatini real vaqtda nazorat qilishni joriy etish uchun aniq yo‘riqnoma bo‘ladi.

title: Limiting Damage to Flexible and Composite Pavements due to the Presence of Water: Guidelines (NCHRP Web-Only Document 433)
abs: Guidelines from NCHRP Project 01-54A (2025) on limiting water damage in asphalt and composite pavements. They cover identifying moisture sources and distress mechanisms, design features such as edge drains, geotextiles and stabilisation, and strategies for new construction, preservation and rehabilitation, supported by the DRAIN web application.

uz.t: Egiluvchan va kompozit yo‘l qoplamalarida suv sababli shikastlanishni cheklash: yo‘riqnoma
uz.ab: NCHRP 01-54A loyihasi yo‘riqnomasida asfalt va kompozit (betonga yotqizilgan asfalt) qoplamalarga suvning zarari, namlik manbalarini aniqlash va nasos effekti kabi buzilish mexanizmlari ko‘rib chiqilgan. Chet drenajlari, geotekstil va gruntni mustahkamlash kabi konstruktiv yechimlar hamda yangi qurilish, saqlash va reabilitatsiya strategiyalari, shuningdek DRAIN veb-ilovasi taklif etilgan. Sug‘oriladigan yerlar yonidan o‘tuvchi, grunt suvi yuqori bo‘lgan O‘zbekiston yo‘llari uchun juda dolzarb.

title: Mechanistic-Empirical Pavement Design Model: Enhancements of Climatic Inputs (NCHRP Research Report 1151)
abs: NCHRP research report (2025) evaluating NASA's MERRA-2 reanalysis climate data, accessed through FHWA's LTPP Climate Tool, as climatic input for AASHTO Pavement ME design. The project developed pavement temperature prediction models and an implementation plan with AASHTOWare.

uz.t: Mexanik-empirik qoplama loyihalash modeli: iqlim kiritmalarini takomillashtirish
uz.ab: Hisobotda AASHTO Pavement ME dasturida loyihalash uchun NASA’ning MERRA-2 global iqlim ma’lumotlaridan (LTPP Climate Tool orqali) foydalanish imkoniyati baholangan va qoplama haroratini bashorat qiluvchi modellar ishlab chiqilgan. MERRA-2 soatlik ma’lumotlarni beradi va AQShdan tashqari hududlarni ham qamrab oladi. Meteostansiyalar siyrak bo‘lgan O‘zbekiston hududlarida mexanik-empirik loyihalashni joriy etishda iqlim ma’lumotlari muammosini hal qilishga yordam beradi.

title: Wide Cracks and Joints in Flexible and Composite Pavements: State DOT Maintenance Practices (NCHRP Synthesis 640)
abs: NCHRP synthesis (2025) of how state DOTs maintain wide transverse and longitudinal cracks and joints in asphalt and composite pavements that are too wide for ordinary crack sealing. Based on a literature review, a DOT survey, interviews and seven state case examples.

uz.t: Egiluvchan va kompozit qoplamalardagi keng darz va choklar: shtat yo‘l agentliklarining saqlash amaliyoti
uz.ab: Sintezda oddiy germetiklash uchun juda keng yoki chuqur bo‘lgan ko‘ndalang va bo‘ylama darzlarni ta’mirlash usullari AQSh shtatlari so‘rovi, intervyular va yetti shtat (Arizona, Arkanzas, Merilend, Minnesota, Nevada, Pensilvaniya, Vashington) tajribasi asosida umumlashtirilgan. Materiallar, texnologiya va qaror qabul qilish yondashuvlari hamda kelgusi tadqiqot yo‘nalishlari keltirilgan. Harorat farqi katta bo‘lgan O‘zbekistonda keng termik darzlar keng tarqalgani uchun bevosita foydali.

title: Construction Strategies and Techniques for Planned Bridge Replacements in Complex Scenarios (NCHRP Synthesis 645)
abs: NCHRP synthesis (2025) on how state DOTs plan and deliver bridge replacements constrained by site, traffic, design or environment. It documents construction methods, delivery approaches and decision factors from a literature review, survey and interviews, with six case examples.

uz.t: Murakkab sharoitlarda rejali ko‘prik almashtirishning qurilish strategiyalari va usullari
uz.ab: Sintezda joy, transport harakati, loyiha yoki atrof-muhit cheklovlari bo‘lgan holatlarda eski ko‘priklarni almashtirishni rejalashtirish va bajarish bo‘yicha AQSh shtatlari tajribasi umumlashtirilgan. Qurilish usullari, loyiha amalga oshirish shakllari va qaror qabul qilish omillari hamda oltita amaliy misol keltirilgan. O‘zbekistonda sovet davrida qurilgan ko‘plab ko‘priklarni harakatni to‘xtatmasdan almashtirish dasturlari uchun foydali tajriba.

title: State DOT Policies and Practices on the Use of Corrosion-Resistant Reinforcing Bars (NCHRP Synthesis 641)
authors: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
abs: NCHRP synthesis (2025) documenting state DOT policies and practices for using corrosion-resistant reinforcing bars in bridges, where corrosion of internal steel is the main cause of concrete deterioration. Free PDF via the National Academies page (guest download).

uz.t: Korroziyaga chidamli armaturadan foydalanish bo‘yicha shtat yo‘l agentliklarining siyosati va amaliyoti
uz.ab: Sintezda temirbeton ko‘priklarning asosiy yemirilish sababi — ichki po‘lat armatura korroziyasiga qarshi epoksi qoplamali, zanglamas, galvanizlangan va boshqa korroziyaga chidamli armaturalarni qo‘llash bo‘yicha AQSh shtatlari siyosati va amaliyoti umumlashtirilgan. Hujjat materiallarni tanlash va ko‘prik xizmat muddatini uzaytirishga oid yondashuvlarni ko‘rsatadi. Sho‘rlangan gruntlar va qishki tuz ishlatiladigan O‘zbekiston yo‘llaridagi ko‘priklar uchun dolzarb.

title: Practices for Ensuring the Smoothness of Concrete Bridge Decks (NCHRP Synthesis 580)
authors: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
abs: NCHRP synthesis (2022) on how state DOTs evaluate the smoothness of concrete bridge decks at construction, track roughness over time and maintain smoothness through the structure's life. Rough decks raise user costs, safety risks and dynamic loads on the structure.

uz.t: Beton ko‘prik qatnov qismi tekisligini ta’minlash amaliyoti
uz.ab: Sintezda AQSh shtatlari yangi qurilgan beton ko‘prik plitalarining tekisligini qanday baholashi, notekislikni vaqt davomida kuzatishi va butun xizmat muddatida saqlashi o‘rganilgan. Notekis qatnov qismi transport xarajatlarini, yuk shikastlanishini, xavfsizlik xatarini va inshootga dinamik yuklamani oshiradi. O‘zbekistonda ko‘priklarni qabul qilish va ta’mirlashda tekislik mezonlarini belgilash uchun foydali.

title: ГОСТ Р 71880-2024 «Дороги автомобильные общего пользования. Противогололедные материалы. Правила применения»
abs: First-edition Russian national standard (Rosstandart order 1931-st, 18.12.2024, in force 01.02.2025) on choosing and applying anti-icing materials on public roads. It sets strategies (full removal vs. reducing slipperiness, preventive vs. reactive treatment), material choice by climate, traffic and surface, minimum application temperatures, spreading rates and limits for bridges and young concrete. Link is a metadata/full-text reference page (meganorm).

uz.t: GOST R 71880-2024 «Umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llari. Muzlashga qarshi materiallar. Qo‘llash qoidalari»
uz.ab: Rossiyaning 2025-yil 1-fevraldan amalda bo‘lgan yangi milliy standarti yo‘llarda sirpanchiqqa qarshi kimyoviy, friksion va aralash materiallarni tanlash va sepish qoidalarini belgilaydi. Unda strategiya tanlash (sirpanchiqni to‘liq yo‘qotish yoki zichlangan qor qatlami ostida saqlash, profilaktik yoki keyingi ishlov), materialning eng past qo‘llash harorati, sepish me’yorlari, ko‘priklar uchun korroziya chegarasi (0,4 mg/(sm²·sutka) dan oshmasligi) va yosh sement-beton qoplamalarda xloridlarni cheklash berilgan. O‘zbekistonning tog‘li va shimoliy hududlaridagi yo‘llarda (Qamchiq, Toshkent–O‘sh yo‘nalishlari) qishki saqlash reglamentlarini ishlab chiqishda bevosita namuna bo‘la oladi.

title: ГОСТ Р 71360-2024 «Дороги автомобильные общего пользования. Технический учет и паспортизация. Общие технические требования»
abs: Russian national standard (order 557-st, 26.04.2024, in force 01.06.2024) setting minimum requirements for technical accounting and passportization of public roads: primary, repeat (at least every five years) and current accounting, field surveys with video, segmentation, an XML database signed electronically and a PDF road passport.

uz.t: GOST R 71360-2024 «Umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llari. Texnik hisob va pasportlashtirish. Umumiy texnik talablar»
uz.ab: Standart yo‘llarni texnik hisobga olish va pasportlashtirish tartibini belgilaydi: yangi yo‘l foydalanishga topshirilgach 6 oy ichida birlamchi hisob, kamida 5 yilda bir marta takroriy hisob va har yili 1-yanvar holatiga joriy yangilash. Dala tekshiruvi va videoqayd majburiy, ma’lumotlar bazasi elektron imzoli XML ko‘rinishida, pasport esa PDF shaklida yuritiladi, ma’lumotlar 10 yil saqlanadi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘llarning raqamli pasporti va aktivlarni boshqarish tizimini joriy etishda tayyor tuzilma sifatida foydali.

title: ГОСТ Р 71329-2024 «Дороги автомобильные общего пользования. Смеси песчано-гравийные. Общие технические условия»
abs: Russian national standard (order 429-st, 09.04.2024, in force 01.05.2024; replaces PNST 403-2020) for natural and enriched sand-gravel mixes in road construction: gravel content classes, maximum grain size 8–63 mm, limits on fines and clay lumps, radioactivity limits, acceptance in batches up to 5,000 t and test methods.

uz.t: GOST R 71329-2024 «Umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llari. Qum-shag‘al aralashmalari. Umumiy texnik shartlar»
uz.ab: Standart yo‘l qurilishida ishlatiladigan tabiiy va boyitilgan qum-shag‘al aralashmalariga talablarni belgilaydi: tabiiy aralashmada shag‘al ulushi 20–80%, eng katta donadorlik 8–63 mm, chang va gil zarralari tabiiy aralashmada 5% gacha, boyitilganda 3% gacha; radioaktivlik chegarasi aholi punktlarida 740 Bk/kg. Partiyalar 5000 tonnagacha qabul qilinadi. O‘zbekistonda daryo qum-shag‘alidan asos va qo‘shimcha qatlamlarda keng foydalanilgani sababli mahalliy talablarni yangilashda taqqoslash uchun muhim.

title: ГОСТ Р 71604-2024 «Дороги автомобильные общего пользования. Вантовые системы мостовых сооружений. Элементы. Общие технические условия»
abs: Russian national standard (order 1392-st, 07.10.2024, in force 01.12.2024) on elements of cable-stayed systems for road and pedestrian bridges using closed wire ropes or parallel strands: anchorage load and fatigue tests (2 million cycles), replaceability and drainage, zinc coating ≥80 µm, damper and deviator requirements, acceptance, storage and warranties.

uz.t: GOST R 71604-2024 «Umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llari. Ko‘prik inshootlarining vantli tizimlari. Elementlar. Umumiy texnik shartlar»
uz.ab: Standart avtomobil va piyodalar ko‘priklarining vantli tizim elementlariga (yopiq po‘lat arqonlar va parallel simlar) talablarni belgilaydi: ankerlarning ±10 mrad og‘ishga chidamliligi, 2 million tsiklli toliqish sinovi, vantni almashtirish imkoniyati, kamida 80 mkm rux qoplama va C5 muhitda 25 yillik himoya, dempferlar va kafolat muddatlari. O‘zbekistonda yirik ko‘priklar va estakadalar loyihalanayotgan bir paytda vantli konstruksiyalar uchun me’yoriy bazani shakllantirishda foydali.

title: ГОСТ Р 71320-2024 «Дороги автомобильные общего пользования. Эксплуатация. Требования к проекту содержания и проекту производства работ (оказания услуг) по содержанию»
abs: Russian national standard (order 389-st, 02.04.2024, in force 01.05.2024) defining the content of road maintenance projects at the design stage and during operation, and of work-production projects for maintenance: maintenance level, scope and frequency of works, winter and summer strategies, resources and cost estimates. Link is the Garant record page.

uz.t: GOST R 71320-2024 «Umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llari. Ekspluatatsiya. Saqlash loyihasi va saqlash ishlarini bajarish loyihasiga talablar»
uz.ab: Standart yo‘lni saqlash loyihasi tarkibini belgilaydi: loyihalash bosqichida yo‘l tavsifi va iqlimi, talab etiladigan saqlash darajasi, ishlar hajmi va davriyligi, qishki va yozgi strategiya, materiallar, texnika, xodimlar ehtiyoji va smeta; ekspluatatsiya bosqichida esa yo‘l pasporti, diagnostika va harakatni tashkil etish loyihasiga tayanish talab qilinadi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘llarni saqlash bo‘yicha shartnomalarni rejalashtirish va natijaga asoslangan saqlash tizimini joriy etishda amaliy namuna.

title: ГОСТ Р 71260-2024 «Дороги автомобильные общего пользования. Требования к проекту производства работ»
abs: Russian national standard (order 253-st, 28.02.2024, in force 01.05.2024) setting requirements for the work-production project (PPR) for road construction, reconstruction, repair and maintenance: when a full or partial PPR is needed, its contents (schedule, site plan, resources, technological cards, geodesy, safety) and climate-specific factors for cold, mountain, desert and seismic areas.

uz.t: GOST R 71260-2024 «Umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llari. Ishlarni bajarish loyihasiga (PPR) talablar»
uz.ab: Standart yo‘l qurilishi, rekonstruksiyasi, ta’miri va saqlashda ishlarni bajarish loyihasi (PPR) tarkibini belgilaydi: kalendar reja, qurilish bosh rejasi, materiallar, texnika va ishchi kuchi ta’minoti, texnologik kartalar, geodeziya va mehnat xavfsizligi choralari. Sovuq, tog‘li, cho‘l va seysmik hududlar uchun alohida omillar ko‘rsatilgan. O‘zbekistonning cho‘l va seysmik sharoitlarida pudratchilar uchun PPR talablarini tartibga solishda foydali manba.

title: Анализ отраслевых потребностей в дорожно-строительной технике, оборудовании, комплектующих к ним до 2028 года
abs: ROSDORNII slide report (data to October 2024) on Russia's road-construction machinery fleet and needs to 2028: a fleet of about 52,000 units, 45% foreign-made, demand for about 44,700 units, domestic output figures for 2022–2024, machine types with no domestic equivalent, contractor complaints and support measures.

uz.t: Yo‘l-qurilish texnikasi, uskunalar va ularning butlovchi qismlariga 2028-yilgacha bo‘lgan tarmoq ehtiyojlari tahlili
uz.ab: ROSDORNII hisobotida Rossiya yo‘l tarmog‘idagi texnika parki (234 tashkilotda taxminan 52 ming birlik, 45% i xorijiy) va 2028-yilgacha taxminan 44,7 ming birlik ehtiyoj tahlil qilingan; eng ko‘p kerak bo‘lganlari – kommunal mashinalar, samosvallar, yuklagichlar va greyderlar. Frezalar, resayklerlar, grunt stabilizatorlari kabi mahalliy muqobili yo‘q texnika turlari va pudratchilarning 160 dan ortiq shikoyati keltirilgan. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l texnikasi parkini yangilash va mahalliylashtirish dasturlarini rejalashtirishda qiyosiy ma’lumot beradi.

title: Искусственный интеллект в дорожно-транспортном комплексе: вопросы стандартизации
abs: Article by ROSDORNII specialists (BKD No. 05/2025) on standardising artificial intelligence in Russia's road transport complex: 29 approved national AI standards, the importance of dataset and labelling standards, the low uptake of such standards in procurement, and proposals for a pilot zone and certification laboratories.

uz.t: Yo‘l-transport majmuasida sun’iy intellekt: standartlashtirish masalalari
uz.ab: Maqolada Rossiya yo‘l-transport sohasida sun’iy intellekt bo‘yicha 29 ta milliy standart tasdiqlangani, ma’lumotlar to‘plami va belgilash (razmetka) standartlari mashinali o‘qitish ishonchliligi uchun hal qiluvchi ekani hamda standartlarning davlat xaridlarida juda kam qo‘llanayotgani tahlil qilingan. Mualliflar sinov zonasi va mustaqil sertifikatlash laboratoriyalarini taklif qiladi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l diagnostikasi va harakatni boshqarishda SI joriy etishning me’yoriy asoslarini tayyorlashda foydali.

title: Сборник «Дороги и мосты», выпуск 52-2/2024
abs: Issue 52-2 (2024) of ROSDORNII's scientific collection 'Roads and Bridges', with papers on the road-sector standardisation system, InfraBIM, ground-penetrating radar in road surveys, road-climatic zoning, temperature warping of cement-concrete pavements and positioning of automated vehicles. The page lists the articles; full texts are not linked as a single PDF.

uz.t: «Yo‘llar va ko‘priklar» ilmiy to‘plami, 52-2/2024-son
uz.ab: ROSDORNII ilmiy to‘plamining 2024-yilgi sonida yo‘l sohasini standartlashtirish tizimi, InfraBIM asosida raqamli transformatsiya, georadiolokatsiya usulining qo‘llanishi, yo‘l-iqlim rayonlashtirish yondashuvlari, sement-beton qoplamalarda harorat ta’sirida egilish kuchlanishlari va yuqori avtomatlashtirilgan avtomobillarni joylashtirish texnologiyalari bo‘yicha maqolalar jamlangan. Sahifada maqolalar ro‘yxati bor, bitta umumiy PDF yo‘q. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l-iqlim rayonlashtirish va beton qoplamalarni hisoblash bo‘yicha tadqiqotlar uchun muhim manba.

title: JTG/T 3381-04—2025 城镇化地区公路交通安全设施设计规范 — Design Specifications for Highway Traffic Safety Facilities in Urbanized Areas
authors: 中华人民共和国交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of the PRC)
abs: Chinese recommended highway standard (MOT announcement 2025 No. 65, in force 01.03.2026) for traffic safety facilities on highways passing through urbanized areas: signs, markings, guardrails, separation strips and fences, anti-glare devices, speed humps and gateways, with emphasis on pedestrians and non-motorized users. Text in Chinese.

uz.t: JTG/T 3381-04—2025 Shaharlashgan hududlardagi avtomobil yo‘llarida harakat xavfsizligi vositalarini loyihalash qoidalari
uz.ab: Xitoy standarti aholi punktlaridan o‘tuvchi magistral yo‘llarda belgilar, chiziqlar, to‘siqlar, ajratuvchi panjaralar (balandligi 0,4–0,9 m), ko‘zni qamashtirishga qarshi vositalar va sun’iy notekisliklar (50–76 mm, faqat 50 km/soat dan past tezlikda) loyihalashni tartibga soladi. Tezlik chegarasini faqat 85-persentil tezlik bo‘yicha emas, yo‘l bo‘yi muhiti va piyodalarni hisobga olib belgilash talab etiladi. O‘zbekistonda qishloq va shaharlar orqali o‘tuvchi xalqaro yo‘llarda (masalan, M-39) piyodalar o‘limini kamaytirish uchun juda dolzarb.

title: JTG 3410—2025 公路工程沥青及沥青混合料试验规程 — Standard Test Methods of Bitumen and Bituminous Mixtures for Highway Engineering
authors: 中华人民共和国交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of the PRC)
abs: Chinese highway industry standard (MOT announcement 2025 No. 27, in force 01.10.2025) on laboratory test methods for bitumen and bituminous mixtures; it replaces JTG E20-2011. The link is the official MOT announcement page, which carries the standard's view-only PDF.

uz.t: JTG 3410—2025 Avtomobil yo‘llari qurilishida bitum va bitumli aralashmalarni sinash qoidalari
uz.ab: Xitoy Transport vazirligi 2025-yil 1-oktabrdan amalga kiritgan ushbu standart 2011-yilgi JTG E20 o‘rnini bosadi va bitum hamda asfaltbeton aralashmalarining laboratoriya sinov usullarini yagona tizimga keltiradi. Havola rasmiy e’lon sahifasiga beriladi, unda standartning faqat ko‘rish uchun mo‘ljallangan PDF matni ilova qilingan. Xitoy bitumi va texnologiyalari O‘zbekiston yo‘l loyihalarida tobora ko‘p qo‘llanayotgani uchun sinov usullarini taqqoslashda zarur manba.

title: JTG/T 3673—2025 公路机电工程施工技术规范 — Technical Specifications for Construction of Highway Electromechanical Engineering
authors: 中华人民共和国交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of the PRC)
abs: Chinese recommended highway specification (MOT announcement 2025 No. 1, in force 01.04.2025) on the construction of highway electromechanical systems such as monitoring, communication, tolling, lighting and tunnel equipment. The linked file is the MOT view-only PDF in Chinese.

uz.t: JTG/T 3673—2025 Avtomobil yo‘llari elektromexanik ishlarini bajarish texnik qoidalari
uz.ab: Standart magistral yo‘llarda kuzatuv, aloqa, to‘lov yig‘ish, yoritish va tunnel uskunalari kabi elektromexanik tizimlarni montaj qilish va qabul qilish talablarini belgilaydi; 2025-yil 1-apreldan amalda. Fayl Xitoy Transport vazirligining faqat ko‘rish uchun PDF nusxasi (xitoy tilida). O‘zbekistonda pullik avtomagistrallar va intellektual transport tizimlari qurilayotgani sababli bunday uskunalarni o‘rnatish talablarini ishlab chiqishda foydali.

title: JTG 4110—2024 公路路政管理技术标准 — Technical Standard for Highway Administration Management
authors: 中华人民共和国交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of the PRC)
abs: Chinese highway industry standard (MOT announcement 2024 No. 37, in force 01.11.2024) on the technical side of highway administration: protection of road assets and right-of-way, control of roadside construction and overloading, and enforcement facilities. The linked file is the MOT view-only PDF (scanned, Chinese).

uz.t: JTG 4110—2024 Avtomobil yo‘llarini ma’muriy boshqarish (yo‘l nazorati) texnik standarti
uz.ab: Xitoy Transport vazirligining 2024-yil 1-noyabrdan amalda bo‘lgan standarti yo‘l mulki va yo‘l bo‘yi mintaqasini muhofaza qilish, yo‘l chetidagi qurilishlarni nazorat qilish, ortiqcha yuklangan transportga qarshi kurash va nazorat inshootlari uchun texnik talablarni belgilaydi. Fayl skanerlangan, xitoy tilida. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l bo‘yi mintaqasidan noqonuniy foydalanish va og‘ir yuk tashuvchilar nazoratini kuchaytirishda tajriba manbai.

title: 交通运输部关于印发《公路水运工程质量事故报告和调查处理办法》的通知（交安监规〔2026〕2号） — Measures for Reporting and Investigation of Highway and Waterway Engineering Quality Accidents
authors: 中华人民共和国交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of the PRC)
abs: Chinese Ministry of Transport regulation of 24 April 2026 on classifying, reporting and investigating quality accidents on highway and waterway construction projects: four severity levels, a 1-hour notification and 24-hour written report, 60-day investigation deadlines, remediation to at least the original design standard and accountability rules. It repeals the 2016 rules.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llari va suv transporti inshootlari qurilishidagi sifat avariyalari haqida xabar berish va ularni tekshirish tartibi (Xitoy, 2026)
uz.ab: Xitoy Transport vazirligining 2026-yil 24-apreldagi hujjati qurilish davridagi sifat avariyalarini to‘rt darajaga ajratadi (1 mln yuandan kam zarar – avariya emas, sifat muammosi), mas’ul shaxs 1 soat ichida xabar berishi, 24 soat ichida yozma hisobot taqdim etilishi, tergov 60 kunda yakunlanishini belgilaydi. Qayta qurish kamida dastlabki loyiha darajasida bo‘lishi va xarajatni aybdor tomon qoplashi shart. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l va ko‘prik qurilishida sifat nazorati va javobgarlik tizimini takomillashtirish uchun foydali namuna.

title: Yo‘l belgilari uchun tez quriydigan organik qoplamalar olish texnologiyasini ishlab chiqish
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, ixtisoslik 02.00.14 – Organik moddalar va ular asosidagi materiallar texnologiyasi. Himoya Toshkent kimyo-texnologiya ilmiy-tadqiqot instituti huzuridagi DSc.30/2025.27.12.K/T.01.01 raqamli ilmiy kengashda 2026-yil 30-iyul soat 11:00 da bo‘lib o‘tgan. Havola UzA dagi himoya e’loniga beriladi; avtoreferat PDF topilmadi.

title: Technical Cooperation Project (Individual Expert): Traffic Safety Promotion Advisor — Uzbekistan
abs: One-page JICA project sheet for an individual expert (Traffic Safety Promotion Advisor) assigned to Uzbekistan for August 2023 – August 2025, with the Supreme Prosecutor's Office and the Traffic Police Department of the Ministry of Internal Affairs as counterparts. It outlines three activity lines: improving crash data collection and sharing (police and insurers), strengthening crash analysis including joint accident reports, and public awareness work with companies and schools.

uz.t: Texnik hamkorlik loyihasi (yakka ekspert): Yo‘l harakati xavfsizligini rivojlantirish bo‘yicha maslahatchi — O‘zbekiston
uz.ab: JICA ning O‘zbekistonga 2023-yil avgust – 2025-yil avgust davrida yuborilgan yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi bo‘yicha maslahatchi loyihasi tavsifi; hamkorlar — Bosh prokuratura va IIV Yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi xizmati. Loyiha YTH ma’lumotlarini yig‘ish va sug‘urta kompaniyalari bilan almashishni yaxshilash, avariyalarni tahlil qilish va birgalikda hisobotlar tayyorlash hamda korxona va maktablarda targ‘ibot o‘tkazishni ko‘zda tutadi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida xavfli uchastkalarni aniqlash va muhandislik choralarini asoslash uchun sifatli avariya ma’lumotlari bazasi zarur, shu sababli loyiha yo‘l sohasi uchun bevosita ahamiyatli.

title: Compendium on Pavement Maintenance and Rehabilitation Practices (REAAA Technical Report TC-13)
abs: REAAA technical report dated December 2025 collecting 11 case studies from Australia, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan and Thailand under three themes: pothole repair, asphalt recycling and pavement resilience. Cases include hot-in-place patching, a Malaysian cold-mix standard, a Japanese moisture-hardening cold mix, repeated recycling with rejuvenators, steel-slag porous asphalt, in-situ stabilisation and a geosynthetic hybrid rehabilitation design.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamalarini saqlash va reabilitatsiya qilish amaliyoti to‘plami (REAAA TC-13 texnik hisoboti)
uz.ab: Osiyo va Avstraliya yo‘l muhandislari assotsiatsiyasining 2025-yil dekabrdagi hisoboti oltita mamlakatdan 11 ta amaliy holatni jamlagan: chuqurchalarni yamash, asfaltni qayta ishlash (regeneratsiya) va qoplamaning chidamliligi. Masalan, Yaponiyaning namlikda qotadigan sovuq aralashmasi past haroratda ham tez mustahkamlik olgan, Avstraliyada joyida barqarorlashtirish chuqur asfalt qatlamiga nisbatan issiqxona gazlarini taxminan 56% kamaytirgan, Tailandda geosintetik bilan gibrid loyiha egilishni ~30% kamaytirgan. O‘zbekistonda bahorgi chuqurchalarni sovuq aralashma bilan yamash va eski asfaltni qayta ishlatish dolzarb bo‘lgani uchun bu tajribalar bevosita qo‘llanishi mumkin.

title: A Study on the Policy Improvement of the Future National Road Network Comprehensive Plan
abs: KOTI policy study (December 2024) reviewing Korea's 2nd National Road Network Master Plan 2021–2030 in light of Road Act amendments and changing traffic patterns. It analyses changes in the national arterial network, proposes concepts such as underground expressways and ultra-high-speed roads, and recommends how to make the statutory master plan more policy-relevant. The record page carries the English abstract; a downloadable file was not visible.

uz.t: Kelajakdagi milliy yo‘l tarmog‘i bosh rejasi siyosatini takomillashtirish bo‘yicha tadqiqot
uz.ab: Koreya transport institutining 2024-yil dekabrdagi tadqiqoti mamlakatning eng yuqori huquqiy yo‘l rejasi — 2021–2030-yillarga mo‘ljallangan 2-milliy yo‘l tarmog‘i bosh rejasini Yo‘llar to‘g‘risidagi qonundagi o‘zgarishlar va transport oqimlari o‘zgarishi asosida qayta ko‘rib chiqadi. Unda magistral tarmoqning o‘zgarishi tahlil qilingan, yer osti ekspress yo‘llari va o‘ta tezkor yo‘llar kabi yangi konsepsiyalar taklif etilgan. O‘zbekistonda avtomobil yo‘llari tarmog‘ini uzoq muddatli rejalashtirish va uni qonunchilik bilan bog‘lash uchun foydali namuna; sahifada inglizcha annotatsiya bor, fayl ko‘rinmadi.

title: Development Strategies of Smart School Zone in Korea
abs: KOTI policy report (October 2024) on AI-based child traffic-safety measures in school zones, which local governments had deployed without a common framework. It defines a smart school zone, groups service functions (safe-driving prompts, enforcement, crash prevention, pedestrian support) into a standard model, and sets out a staged process from site selection to road-type classification and service choice. Record page with English abstract.

uz.t: Koreyada “aqlli maktab zonasi”ni rivojlantirish strategiyalari
uz.ab: KOTI ning 2024-yil oktabrdagi hisoboti maktablar atrofidagi bolalar xavfsizligi uchun sun’iy intellektga asoslangan choralarni tizimlashtiradi: xavfsiz haydashga undash, qoidabuzarlikni nazorat qilish, avariyalarning oldini olish va piyodalarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash funksiyalari mahalliy hokimiyatlar uchun yagona standart modelga birlashtirilgan. Joy tanlash, yo‘l turini aniqlash va xizmatlarni tanlash bosqichlari ko‘rsatilgan. O‘zbekistonda maktab oldidagi piyodalar o‘tish joylarini jihozlash va ularni yo‘l toifasiga qarab standartlashtirishda tayanch bo‘la oladi.

title: A Preliminary Study on Developing an Autonomous Driving Difficulty Map
abs: KOTI study (February 2025) proposing a method and map-based system for rating how difficult individual road segments are for automated vehicles. Using Korean service cases and crash reports, it models traffic and geometric factors (volume, lanes, width, curve radius, tunnels, bridges) with an XGBoost/SHAP approach to support test-zone management and C-ITS planning. Record page with English abstract.

uz.t: Avtonom haydash qiyinligi xaritasini ishlab chiqish bo‘yicha dastlabki tadqiqot
uz.ab: KOTI ning 2025-yil fevraldagi tadqiqoti yo‘l uchastkalarining avtonom avtomobillar uchun qanchalik murakkabligini miqdoriy ko‘rsatkichlar asosida baholash va xaritada ko‘rsatish usulini taklif qiladi. Transport oqimi, bo‘laklar soni, yo‘l kengligi, egri radiusi, tunnel va ko‘priklar kabi omillar mashinaviy o‘qitish (XGBoost, SHAP) yordamida tahlil qilingan. O‘zbekistonda kelgusida aqlli transport tizimlari va avtonom transport sinov hududlarini tanlashda yo‘l geometriyasi ma’lumotlaridan qanday foydalanish mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi.

title: Analysis on the serviceability of pavement on national highways under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
abs: NILIM 2024 annual report article summarising the first round (FY2017–2021) of periodic pavement inspections on MLIT national highways and long-term serviceability surveys at 12 sites. About 45% of asphalt sections target 13 years of service; cracking (~47%), roughness/IRI (~32%) and rutting (~15%) drive the worst asphalt ratings, while IRI (~57%) dominates for concrete pavements.

uz.t: MLIT tasarrufidagi milliy avtomagistrallarda yo‘l qoplamasining ekspluatatsion yaroqliligi tahlili
uz.ab: NILIM ning 2024-yilgi yillik hisobotidagi maqola Yaponiya milliy yo‘llarida 2017–2021-yillarda o‘tkazilgan birinchi davriy qoplama ko‘rigi natijalarini umumlashtiradi. Asfalt qoplamalarning taxminan 45% uchun xizmat muddati 13 yil qilib belgilangan; eng yomon holatga asosan yoriqlar (~47%), notekislik IRI (~32%) va iz hosil bo‘lishi (~15%) sabab bo‘lgan, sement-beton qoplamada esa IRI (~57%) ustun. O‘zbekistonda qoplamalarni muntazam ko‘rikdan o‘tkazish va ta’mir navbatini belgilash tizimini yaratishda tayyor metodik namuna.

title: Analytical study toward the building of an evaluation technique for local scour around a highway bridge foundation
abs: NILIM 2024 annual report article testing whether semi-three-dimensional flow analysis can reproduce local scour around a bridge pier protected by bed protection works, against a hydraulic model test. The non-hydrostatic model roughly matched the observed scour pattern, while the common hydrostatic approximation differed markedly in depth and extent.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘li ko‘prigi poydevori atrofidagi mahalliy yuvilishni baholash usulini yaratish bo‘yicha analitik tadqiqot
uz.ab: Maqolada ko‘prik tayanchi atrofidagi o‘zan yuvilishini yarim uch o‘lchamli oqim modeli bilan hisoblash laboratoriya tajribasi bilan solishtirilgan. Gidrostatik bo‘lmagan model yuvilish shakli va joyini taxminan to‘g‘ri bergan, amaliyotda keng qo‘llanadigan gidrostatik yaqinlashuv esa chuqurlik va ko‘lamda sezilarli xato ko‘rsatgan. O‘zbekistonda tog‘ va tog‘oldi daryolari ustidagi ko‘priklarda sel va toshqin paytida tayanchlarning yuvilishi asosiy xavflardan biri bo‘lgani uchun natijalar foydali.

title: Building a strategic management cycle for road structures
abs: NILIM 2024 annual report article by the Road Structures Department director proposing a management cycle linking design, inspection and repair to required performance. Drawing on the second round of statutory bridge and tunnel inspections (ending FY2023), it identifies uneven diagnosis quality, weak records of diagnostic reasoning and heavy workload, and proposes recording performance estimates alongside the four-level soundness rating.

uz.t: Yo‘l inshootlarini strategik boshqarish siklini qurish
uz.ab: NILIM yo‘l inshootlari departamenti direktori maqolasida loyihalash, ko‘rik va ta’mirni inshootdan talab qilinadigan ishlash ko‘rsatkichlariga bog‘laydigan boshqaruv sikli taklif etiladi. Ikkinchi davriy ko‘rik (2023-moliya yiligacha) natijasida tashxis sifati notekisligi, xulosalar asosining yozilmasligi va mutaxassislar yetishmasligi aniqlangan; to‘rt bosqichli holat bahosiga qo‘shimcha ravishda yuklama, zilzila va jala ostidagi kutilayotgan holatni qayd etish tavsiya qilingan. O‘zbekistonda ko‘priklar ma’lumotlar bazasi va ko‘rik reglamentini ishlab chiqishda tayanch bo‘ladi.

title: Research and development toward the realization of road utilization that is wise, safe, and sustainable
abs: NILIM 2024 annual report overview by the Road Traffic Department director, framed by Japan's 2040 road vision and WISENET2050. It covers AI/probe-data traffic monitoring and congestion prediction, road-to-vehicle merging support for automated driving, data-led zero-accident measures on residential streets, and the road sector's carbon-neutral strategy (road traffic ~16% of national emissions).

uz.t: Oqilona, xavfsiz va barqaror yo‘ldan foydalanishni ta’minlashga qaratilgan ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlari
uz.ab: NILIM Yo‘l harakati departamenti direktorining sharh maqolasi Yaponiyaning 2040-yilgi yo‘l konsepsiyasi va WISENET2050 doirasidagi ishlarni bayon qiladi: kamera tasvirlari va ETC2.0 ma’lumotlari asosida harakatni kuzatish va tirbandlikni bashorat qilish, avtonom avtomobillarga qo‘shilishda yo‘l–transport aloqasi, turar-joy ko‘chalarida avariyalarni nolga tushirish choralari va yo‘l transporti chiqindilarini (mamlakat bo‘yicha ~16%) kamaytirish strategiyasi. O‘zbekiston yo‘l sohasi uchun raqamli monitoring va xavfsizlik siyosatini shakllantirishda yo‘nalish beradi.

title: Enhancement of Technical Information Associated with the Revision of the Regular Inspection Procedure for Road Bridges
abs: NILIM 2025 annual report article on the March 2024 revision of Japan's regular road-bridge inspection procedure, which now requires recording technical evaluations of load-carrying performance under rare events and durability-related distress. It also describes an optional detailed data protocol comparable with deterioration curves from over 20,000 MLIT bridges, nationwide hands-on sessions for about 8,000 officers, and an updated training course.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘li ko‘priklarini davriy ko‘rikdan o‘tkazish tartibining qayta ko‘rib chiqilishi munosabati bilan texnik ma’lumotlarni boyitish
uz.ab: Maqola Yaponiyada 2024-yil martida yangilangan ko‘priklarni davriy ko‘rik tartibini tushuntiradi: endi zilzila, jala va toshqin kabi kamdan-kam hodisalardagi yuk ko‘tarish qobiliyati va xizmat muddatiga ta’sir qiluvchi nuqsonlar bahosi yozilishi shart. 20 mingdan ortiq ko‘prik ma’lumotidan olingan yemirilish egri chiziqlari bilan solishtirish imkonini beruvchi ixtiyoriy protokol, ~8 000 mutaxassis uchun amaliy mashg‘ulotlar va yangilangan o‘quv kursi tasvirlangan. O‘zbekistonda ko‘priklar holatini baholash va ko‘rikchilarni tayyorlash tizimi uchun bevosita namuna.

title: Response to the Noto Peninsula Earthquake - Activities Related to Road Structures -
abs: NILIM 2025 annual report feature on the Road Structures Department's response to the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake: aerial surveys of slope failures, technical evaluation of damaged bridges and the Otani Tunnel lining spalling, advice to the road recovery committee and proposals for revising technical standards. Bridges designed after the post-1995 seismic code revision performed as expected.

uz.t: Noto yarim oroli zilzilasiga javob choralari — yo‘l inshootlari bo‘yicha faoliyat
uz.ab: 2024-yilgi Noto zilzilasidan so‘ng NILIM mutaxassislari ertasi kuniyoq yonbag‘ir o‘pirilishlarini havodan tekshirgan, shikastlangan ko‘priklar va Otani tunneli qoplamasining ko‘chishini baholagan hamda tiklash usullari va texnik me’yorlarni qayta ko‘rib chiqish bo‘yicha takliflar bergan. 1995-yildan keyingi qat’iy seysmik me’yorlar bo‘yicha loyihalangan ko‘priklar kutilgan darajada ishlagani qayd etilgan. Seysmik faol O‘zbekiston uchun zilziladan keyingi yo‘l inshootlarini tezkor baholash tartibini ishlab chiqishda muhim tajriba.

title: Research on the Applicability of the Understanding Road Damage Status Utilizing SAR Satellite Images - Verification in the 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake
abs: NILIM 2025 annual report article testing whether high-resolution X-band SAR satellite images can reveal road damage, using six slope failures from the 2024 Noto earthquake. Detectability depended strongly on slope orientation relative to the radar; failures of about 25 m × 25 m on radar-facing slopes were clearly identifiable, while vegetation and radar shadow hindered others.

uz.t: SAR sun’iy yo‘ldosh tasvirlari yordamida yo‘l shikastlanishini aniqlash imkoniyatlari bo‘yicha tadqiqot — 2024-yil Noto zilzilasida tekshiruv
uz.ab: Tadqiqotda yuqori aniqlikdagi X-diapazonli radar sun’iy yo‘ldosh tasvirlari orqali yo‘l shikastlanishini aniqlash mumkinligi Noto zilzilasidagi oltita o‘pirilish misolida sinalgan. Natija yonbag‘irning radarga qaragan tomoniga kuchli bog‘liq: radarga qaragan yonbag‘irdagi taxminan 25×25 m o‘lchamli o‘pirilishlar aniq ko‘ringan, o‘simlik va radar soyasi esa aniqlashni qiyinlashtirgan. O‘zbekistonning tog‘li yo‘llarida (Qamchiq, Toshkent–O‘sh) sel va o‘pirilishdan keyin tezkor baholash uchun istiqbolli usul.

title: Effects of Measures to Secure Road Traffic During Heavy Snowfall on Motor Vehicle Traffic
abs: NILIM 2025 annual report article analysing how a December 2023 government call to avoid non-essential travel during heavy snowfall in Hokuriku affected traffic on National Routes 8 and 18. Light-vehicle traffic fell during the call period, with trips cancelled rather than shifted, while heavy-vehicle operators responded mainly to actual snowfall conditions and warnings.

uz.t: Kuchli qor yog‘ishi paytida yo‘l harakatini ta’minlash choralarining avtotransport harakatiga ta’siri
uz.ab: Maqolada 2023-yil dekabrida Xokuriku mintaqasida kuchli qor paytida aholiga zarur bo‘lmagan safarlardan tiyilish haqida berilgan chaqiruvning 8 va 18-milliy yo‘llardagi harakatga ta’siri tahlil qilingan. Yengil avtomobillar soni kamaygan va safarlar boshqa vaqtga ko‘chirilmay bekor qilingan, og‘ir yuk mashinalari esa asosan haqiqiy qor sharoiti va ogohlantirishlarga qarab harakat qilgan. O‘zbekistonning qishda yopiladigan dovon yo‘llarida (Qamchiq, Taxtaqoracha) aholini ogohlantirish va harakatni boshqarish choralarini rejalashtirishda foydali.

title: Development of Maintenance Engineers for Road Structures in Cooperation with Regional Development Bureaus, Etc.
abs: NILIM 2025 annual report article on how the Road Structures Department builds regional maintenance engineers with MLIT Regional Development Bureaus: staff secondments (38 since FY2015), the March 2024 review of regular inspection procedures after two five-year rounds, experience-based bridge maintenance training, and joint dispatch for disaster and defect response.

uz.t: Mintaqaviy rivojlanish byurolari bilan hamkorlikda yo‘l inshootlarini saqlash bo‘yicha muhandislarni tayyorlash
uz.ab: Maqolada NILIM ning mintaqaviy byurolar bilan yo‘l inshootlarini saqlash bo‘yicha muhandislarni tayyorlash tizimi bayon etilgan: 2015-yildan beri 38 nafar xodim institutda stajirovka o‘tagan, ikki besh yillik ko‘rik sikli natijasida 2024-yil martida ko‘rik tartibi qayta ko‘rilgan, ish stajiga moslashtirilgan o‘quv dasturlari va avariya holatlarida qo‘shma ekspert guruhlari tashkil etilgan. Ilmiy-tadqiqot instituti va hududiy yo‘l tashkilotlari o‘rtasida bilim almashinuvini yo‘lga qo‘yishda O‘zbekiston uchun tayyor model.

title: Functional Wearing Courses (PIARC Technical Report 2026R07EN)
abs: PIARC TC 4.1 review of current and emerging practice for functional wearing courses that deliver skid resistance, ride quality and low noise. It groups surface treatments (milling, seal renewal, recycling, thin overlays) for asphalt and cement-concrete pavements and explains at which construction or maintenance stage each can be used.

uz.t: Funksional ustki (eskiruvchi) qoplama qatlamlari
uz.ab: Hisobot asfaltbeton va sement-beton qoplamalarda ishqalanish, ravonlik va shovqinni kamaytirishni ta’minlovchi ustki qatlamlar bo‘yicha jahon amaliyotini umumlashtiradi: frezalash, yuzaki ishlov (seal) yangilash, regeneratsiya va yupqa qatlamlar qaysi bosqichda qo‘llanishi tushuntiriladi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida ta’mirlashlararo muddatni uzaytirish va xavfsiz ishqalanishni saqlash uchun texnologiya tanlashda bevosita qo‘llanma bo‘ladi.

title: Low-Cost Pavement Systems (PIARC Technical Report 2025R01EN)
abs: Report on the benefits and pitfalls of low-cost pavements, from earth and gravel roads to surface-treated and paved roads, illustrated by real-world examples. It proposes an adaptable methodology based on material efficiency, innovative construction and sustainability, stressing that low construction cost does not automatically mean low life-cycle cost.

uz.t: Kam xarajatli yo‘l to‘shamasi tizimlari
uz.ab: Tuproq va shag‘al yo‘llardan tortib yuzaki ishlov berilgan va asfaltlangan yo‘llargacha bo‘lgan arzon to‘shama turlari, ularning afzallik va kamchiliklari amaliy misollar bilan ko‘rib chiqiladi; mahalliy materiallardan samarali foydalanishga asoslangan moslashuvchan metodika taklif etiladi. Hisobotda qurilish arzonligi hayotiy sikl xarajati arzonligini anglatmasligi ta’kidlanadi. O‘zbekistonda qishloq va mahalliy yo‘llar tarmog‘ini kengaytirish dasturlari uchun juda dolzarb.

title: Measures for Reducing Carbon Footprint of Pavements - A PIARC Collection of Case Studies (2025R02EN)
abs: International case studies, including from low- and middle-income countries, on cutting greenhouse-gas emissions of pavements. Emissions are assessed across the whole life cycle following EN 15804 stages, and the measures cover low-carbon materials, technologies and construction methods.

uz.t: Yo‘l to‘shamalarining uglerod izini kamaytirish choralari — amaliy misollar to‘plami
uz.ab: To‘plamda turli mamlakatlar (shu jumladan rivojlanayotgan davlatlar) tajribasidan yo‘l to‘shamasining butun hayotiy sikli davomida (EN 15804 bosqichlari: material, qurilish, foydalanish, yaroqsiz holat, qayta ishlash) chiqindi gazlarni kamaytirish misollari keltirilgan. Kam uglerodli materiallar, iliq asfalt, qayta ishlash kabi yechimlar va hisoblash usullari solishtiriladi. O‘zbekistonning “yashil” iqtisodiyot va iqlim majburiyatlari doirasida yo‘l qurilishida emissiyani baholash uchun asos bo‘ladi.

title: Earthworks Decarbonisation - A PIARC Collection of Case Studies (2026R01EN)
abs: Collection of case studies on reducing the carbon footprint of earthworks, which form a large share of road civil works. It compares carbon-calculation tools and describes contractor practices such as switching energy sources, alternative materials and CO2 capture.

uz.t: Yer ishlarini dekarbonizatsiya qilish — amaliy misollar to‘plami
uz.ab: Yo‘l qurilishi hajmining katta qismini tashkil etuvchi yer ishlari (yer polotnosi, qazish, ko‘tarma)da CO2 chiqindilarini kamaytirish tajribalari jamlangan: uglerod izini hisoblash vositalari solishtiriladi, texnika uchun energiya manbaini almashtirish, muqobil materiallar va CO2 ni ushlash amaliyotlari tasvirlanadi. O‘zbekistonda yirik avtomagistral loyihalarida yer ishlarini rejalashtirish va ekologik baholash uchun foydali.

title: Snow and Ice Databook 2026
abs: Seventh edition of the PIARC Snow and Ice Databook, compiling winter-service organisation and practice in 23 countries using a common chapter structure (six countries new, including China and Ukraine). Released at the XVII World Winter Service and Road Resilience Congress in Chambéry in March 2026.

uz.t: Qor va muz bo‘yicha ma’lumotlar to‘plami 2026
uz.ab: PIARCning ettinchi nashri 23 mamlakatda yo‘llarni qishki saqlash tashkiloti, iqlim sharoiti, muzga qarshi materiallar, texnika va xizmat darajalarini yagona tuzilmada taqqoslaydi (Xitoy, Ukraina, Polsha va boshqalar yangi qo‘shilgan). Har to‘rt yilda yangilanadi. O‘zbekistonning tog‘ dovonlari (Qamchiq, Taxtaqoracha) va shimoliy hududlarida qishki xizmat me’yorlarini takomillashtirishda xalqaro taqqoslash manbai.

title: Road Closure Criteria - A PIARC Briefing Note - At a Glance of World Practices (2026R04EN)
abs: Briefing note on the practice of deliberately closing roads during extreme weather (snow, floods, landslides, high winds). It classifies measures as early-warning, precautionary, preventive and reactive, explains how weather and road-condition data set closure triggers, and gives regional case studies.

uz.t: Yo‘llarni yopish mezonlari — jahon amaliyotiga qisqa nazar
uz.ab: Qor bo‘roni, toshqin, ko‘chki va kuchli shamol paytida yo‘llarni oldindan yopish amaliyoti tahlil qilinadi; choralar erta ogohlantirish, ehtiyot, oldini olish va javob choralariga ajratiladi, ob-havo prognozi va yo‘l holati ma’lumotlari asosida yopish chegaralari qanday belgilanishi ko‘rsatiladi. O‘zbekistonning sel va ko‘chki xavfi yuqori tog‘ yo‘llari uchun yopish reglamentlarini ishlab chiqishda namuna bo‘ladi.

title: Damage-Resilient Bridges in Seismic Areas - Technical Report (2023R09EN)
abs: PIARC TC 4.2 analysis of worldwide case studies on seismic retrofit of road bridges. It reviews typical earthquake damage, the evolution of seismic codes and provisions that improve performance, and how countries prioritise bridges for retrofit using decision trees or case-by-case review.

uz.t: Seysmik hududlarda shikastlanishga chidamli ko‘priklar
uz.ab: Hisobotda zilzilalarda ko‘priklarda uchraydigan tipik shikastlanishlar, seysmik me’yorlar evolyutsiyasi va ko‘prik ishini yaxshilovchi talablar ko‘rib chiqiladi; mamlakatlar ko‘priklarni kuchaytirish navbatini qanday belgilashi (qaror daraxti yoki alohida baholash) va kuchaytirish usullarini tanlash mezonlari (xavf darajasi, xarajat-foyda, tarmoq barqarorligi) tushuntiriladi. Seysmik faol O‘zbekiston uchun mavjud ko‘priklar fondini baholash va KMK/ShNQ talablarini yangilashda juda muhim manba.

title: Sustainability of Tunnel Operation: New Approaches - A PIARC Briefing Note And Collection Of Case Studies (2025R03EN)
abs: Briefing note with international case studies on making road-tunnel design and operation more sustainable in environmental, economic and social terms. It notes that electricity is a major share of tunnel operating cost over lifetimes exceeding 80 years and groups cases into design, energy supply/resilience and operation/organisation.

uz.t: Tunnellardan barqaror foydalanish: yangi yondashuvlar
uz.ab: Avtomobil tunnellarini loyihalash va ekspluatatsiya qilishda energiya tejash, ta’minot barqarorligi va tashkiliy yechimlar bo‘yicha xalqaro misollar keltirilgan; elektr energiyasi 80 yildan ortiq xizmat muddatida asosiy xarajat ekanligi ta’kidlanadi. Qamchiq dovonidagi tunnellar va rejalashtirilayotgan yangi tog‘ tunnellari ekspluatatsiyasini optimallashtirish uchun foydali.

title: Management of Road Worksites - PIARC Special Project (2025SP01)
abs: Mixed-methods study (literature review, survey of 247 practitioners from 68 countries, 13 interviews, 24 case studies) on safety, mobility and environmental impacts of road worksites. It finds management is reactive and compliance-driven, notes gaps between high- and low-income countries and neglect of vulnerable users, and proposes a maturity framework and toolkit based on ISO 31000.

uz.t: Yo‘l ishlari maydonlarini boshqarish
uz.ab: 68 mamlakatdan 247 mutaxassis so‘rovi, intervyular va 24 amaliy misol asosida yo‘l ta’mirlash maydonlarida xavfsizlik, harakat o‘tkazuvchanligi va ekologiyaga ta’sir o‘rganilgan; hozirgi boshqaruv asosan reaktiv va faqat me’yorga moslikka yo‘naltirilgani, piyoda va zaif ishtirokchilar e’tibordan chetda qolishi aniqlangan. ISO 31000 asosidagi yetuklik modeli va amaliy vositalar taklif etiladi — O‘zbekistonda ta’mirlash paytida harakatni tashkil etish sxemalarini takomillashtirish uchun foydali.

title: Road Safety Challenges and Solutions in Rural and Interurban Areas - A PIARC Briefing Note (2025R08EN)
abs: Briefing note explaining why rural and interurban roads carry a disproportionate share of deaths (speed, unforgiving roadsides, poor facilities for walking and cycling, slow emergency response). It reviews countermeasures from clear zones and barriers to enforcement and real-time monitoring, and advocates a Safe System approach.

uz.t: Qishloq va shaharlararo yo‘llarda harakat xavfsizligi: muammolar va yechimlar
uz.ab: Qishloq va shaharlararo yo‘llarda o‘lim holatlari harakat hajmiga nisbatan yuqoriligi sabablari (tezlik, yo‘l yoqasidagi to‘siqlar, piyoda yo‘laklari yo‘qligi, tez yordamning kechikishi) tahlil qilinadi; xavfsiz zona, to‘siqlar, belgilar, alohida piyoda-velo yo‘laklari va avtomatik nazorat kabi choralar ko‘rib chiqiladi. O‘zbekistonda qishloqlar orqali o‘tuvchi xalqaro va davlat yo‘llarida xavfsizlikni oshirish uchun to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qo‘llaniladi.

title: Rural Roads: Pillars of Rural Development - Case Studies (2023R27EN)
abs: Case studies from six low- and middle-income African countries on how rural roads drive socio-economic development. They identify barriers such as under-investment, poor maintenance and limited financing, and argue for integrated, inclusive approaches to rural accessibility.

uz.t: Qishloq yo‘llari — qishloq taraqqiyotining tayanchi
uz.ab: Olti Afrika mamlakati misolida qishloq yo‘llarining ta’lim, sog‘liqni saqlash va bozorlarga kirish orqali iqtisodiy rivojlanishga ta’siri baholanadi; kam investitsiya, saqlashning yetarli emasligi va moliyaviy cheklovlar asosiy to‘siqlar sifatida ko‘rsatiladi. O‘zbekistonda qishloq yo‘llarini rivojlantirish strategiyasi va ularning samarasini baholash metodikasi uchun qiyosiy manba.

title: Road Safety Audits Guidelines for Road Projects - A PIARC Technical Report (2023R40EN)
abs: Guidelines presenting Road Safety Audit as part of Road Infrastructure Safety Management alongside impact assessment, inspection and network assessment. Audits are done by independent trained auditors while the client decides on recommendations; appendices give stage-by-stage checklists and a report template.

uz.t: Yo‘l loyihalarida harakat xavfsizligi auditi bo‘yicha qo‘llanma
uz.ab: Qo‘llanmada yo‘l xavfsizligi auditi infratuzilma xavfsizligini boshqarish tizimining (ta’sirni baholash, inspeksiya, tarmoq bahosi) bir qismi sifatida tushuntiriladi; audit loyihachilardan mustaqil, malakali auditorlar tomonidan o‘tkazilishi, buyurtmachi esa tavsiyalar bo‘yicha qaror qabul qilishi belgilanadi. Ilovalarda har bir loyiha bosqichi uchun tekshiruv ro‘yxatlari va hisobot shabloni berilgan — O‘zbekistonda audit amaliyotini joriy etish uchun tayyor vosita.

title: Guidelines for the Implementation of ISO 55001 in Road Organizations (2023R56EN)
abs: Practical guidelines for road administrations implementing the ISO 55001 asset-management standard. They explain ISO 55000/55001/55002, weigh benefits and risks, and draw on a survey of administrations and ten case studies at different maturity levels to identify key success factors.

uz.t: Yo‘l tashkilotlarida ISO 55001 standartini joriy etish bo‘yicha qo‘llanma
