uz.ab: Qo‘llanma ISO 55000/55001/55002 aktivlarni boshqarish standartlarini yo‘l sohasiga moslab tushuntiradi, joriy etishning foyda va xatarlarini baholaydi hamda turli yetuklik darajasidagi o‘nta amaliy misol asosida muvaffaqiyat omillarini ko‘rsatadi. Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasining yo‘l aktivlarini (to‘shama, ko‘priklar) boshqarish tizimini xalqaro standartga moslashtirish uchun muhim.

title: Measures for Increasing the Adaptability of Road Bridges to Climate Change - Technical Report (2023R10EN)
abs: Based on responses from fifteen countries and nineteen case studies, the report identifies climate impacts on road bridges, with flooding and scour the most cited threats. It recommends revising bridge design codes and assessing impacts in a cause-and-consequence framework because effects vary by region.

uz.t: Avtomobil ko‘priklarining iqlim o‘zgarishiga moslashuvchanligini oshirish choralari
uz.ab: 15 mamlakat so‘rovi va 19 amaliy misol asosida iqlim o‘zgarishining ko‘priklarga ta’siri (asosan toshqin va tayanchlar ostining yuvilishi, kuchli shamol) tahlil qilinadi; ko‘prik loyihalash me’yorlarini qayta ko‘rib chiqish va ta’sirni sabab-oqibat modelida baholash tavsiya etiladi. O‘zbekistonda sel oqimlari va daryo o‘zanlari ustidagi ko‘priklarni loyihalash va kuchaytirishda hisobga olinishi lozim.

title: Increasing Resilience of Earth Structures to Natural Hazards (PIARC Technical Report 2023R54EN)
abs: Technical report reviewing the concept of resilience for road earth structures and analysing member case studies on the most common hazards, typical damage and repair or adaptation measures. It concludes that resilience must be built into the whole life cycle from design to management, with recommendations in chapters 10–11.

uz.t: Yer inshootlarining tabiiy xavflarga chidamliligini oshirish
uz.ab: Hisobotda yo‘l ko‘tarmalari, o‘yma va qiyaliklarga ta’sir qiluvchi asosiy tabiiy xavflar (yog‘ingarchilik, toshqin, ko‘chki, zilzila), tipik shikastlanishlar va ularni tiklash/moslashtirish choralari a’zo mamlakatlar misolida tahlil qilinadi; chidamlilikni loyihalashdan ekspluatatsiyagacha butun hayotiy siklda ta’minlash tavsiya etiladi. O‘zbekistonning ko‘chki va selga moyil tog‘ oldi yo‘llari uchun dolzarb.

title: Monitoring and Regulation to Reduce Overloading and Associated Infrastructure Damage on Road Networks - A PIARC Technical Report (2023R35EN)
abs: Report on the safety, infrastructure and environmental impacts of overloaded and non-compliant trucks, especially in low- and lower-middle-income countries. It explains economic drivers of overloading such as imbalanced freight flows and presents monitoring technologies and regulatory tools that improve compliance.

uz.t: O‘ta yuklanishni kamaytirish uchun monitoring va tartibga solish
uz.ab: Hisobotda ortiqcha yuklangan yuk mashinalarining yo‘l to‘shamasi va ko‘priklarni buzishi, xavfsizlik va ekologiyaga ta’siri, ayniqsa daromadi past mamlakatlarda, tahlil qilinadi; ortiqcha yuklashning iqtisodiy sabablari (yo‘nalishlar bo‘yicha yuk oqimlarining nomutanosibligi) va harakatda tortish (WIM) kabi yangi nazorat vositalari ko‘rsatiladi. O‘zbekistonda tranzit yuk oqimi o‘sayotgani sababli o‘q yuklamasini nazorat qilish tizimini kuchaytirishda bevosita foydali.

title: Innovative Pavement Maintenance and Repair Strategies - Collection of Case Studies (2022R28EN)
abs: Collection of case studies on innovative maintenance and repair of flexible and (semi-)rigid pavements on different road classes. It covers both functional and structural aspects, from special materials and techniques to organisational strategies, summarising findings from each case.

uz.t: Yo‘l to‘shamalarini saqlash va ta’mirlashning innovatsion strategiyalari
uz.ab: Nobikr va yarim bikr to‘shamalarni turli toifadagi yo‘llarda saqlash va ta’mirlash bo‘yicha innovatsion yechimlar — maxsus materiallar, ta’mirlash texnologiyalari hamda tashkiliy-strategik yondashuvlar — amaliy misollarda jamlangan. O‘zbekiston yo‘l xo‘jaligi korxonalari uchun ta’mirlash usullarini tanlashda xalqaro tajriba bazasi.

title: Models for Sight Distance in Road Design - A Worldwide Comparison of Standards - A PIARC Technical Report (2023R37EN)
abs: Comparison of sight-distance models in the road design standards of 18 countries, covering stopping, overtaking and decision sight distance plus minimum and maximum longitudinal gradients. It discusses adapting the models to new vehicle technologies and their transferability to low- and middle-income countries.

uz.t: Yo‘l loyihalashda ko‘rinish masofasi modellari — standartlarning jahon miqyosida taqqoslanishi
uz.ab: 18 mamlakat (AQSh, Kanada, Fransiya, Yaponiya, Avstraliya va b.) yo‘l loyihalash me’yorlaridagi to‘xtash, quvib o‘tish va qaror qabul qilish ko‘rinish masofalari hamda bo‘ylama qiyalik chegaralari taqqoslanadi; avtomatlashtirilgan transport sharoitiga moslash masalasi ham ko‘riladi. O‘zbekistondagi ShNQ/KMK yo‘l loyihalash me’yorlarini xalqaro amaliyot bilan solishtirish uchun qimmatli.

title: Integration of New Technologies in Winter Service - A PIARC Technical Report (2023R39EN)
abs: 54-page collection of nine case studies from six countries on new technologies that make winter maintenance more effective, environmentally sound and user-oriented. Each case includes contact details of its author for follow-up.

uz.t: Qishki xizmatga yangi texnologiyalarni joriy etish
uz.ab: Olti mamlakatdan to‘qqizta amaliy misol orqali qishda yo‘llarni saqlashda yangi texnologiyalar (yo‘l ob-havo tizimlari, aqlli tuz sepish, ma’lumotlarga asoslangan boshqaruv) samaradorlikni oshirishi va ekologik zararni kamaytirishi ko‘rsatiladi. O‘zbekiston tog‘ yo‘llarida qishki xizmatni raqamlashtirish uchun foydali.

title: Use Of Recycled Materials In Pavements - Briefing Note (2022R10EN)
abs: 17-page briefing note closing a three-part PIARC series on recycled pavement materials. It covers in-place recycling with hydraulic or bituminous binders (including preliminary investigation) and in-plant recycling for asphalt, concrete and base layers, ending with recommendations.

uz.t: Yo‘l to‘shamalarida qayta ishlangan materiallardan foydalanish
uz.ab: Qisqa qo‘llanmada joyida (sement yoki bitum bog‘lovchi bilan) va zavodda regeneratsiya qilish texnologiyalari, mavjud to‘shamani dastlabki tekshirish hamda asfalt, beton va asos qatlamlari uchun qayta ishlangan aralashmalar bo‘yicha tavsiyalar berilgan. O‘zbekistonda eski asfaltbetonni qayta ishlatish orqali bitum va chaqiq tosh tejashga xizmat qiladi.

title: Road Bridges - New Rehabilitation Materials and Technologies - Technical Report (2022R23EN)
abs: Report compiling 41 case studies of bridge problems and the repair or strengthening techniques used, with a synthesis table. About a quarter involve carbon/glass fibre-reinforced polymers and another quarter ultra-high-performance fibre-reinforced concrete; the authors note these are still not widely adopted by contractors.

uz.t: Avtomobil ko‘priklari — yangi ta’mirlash materiallari va texnologiyalari
uz.ab: Hisobotda ko‘priklardagi 41 ta muammo va ularni ta’mirlash/kuchaytirish usullari jamlangan: holatlarning chorak qismida uglerod yoki shisha tolali kompozitlar (FRP), yana chorak qismida o‘ta mustahkam tolali beton (UHPFRC) qo‘llangan. O‘zbekistondagi eskirgan temirbeton ko‘priklarni kuchaytirishda zamonaviy materiallarni tanlash uchun amaliy manba.

title: Life Cycle and Risk Management - A PIARC Technical Report (2023R51EN)
abs: Technical report on lifecycle planning — forecasting asset performance from construction to disposal under different investment scenarios — which is most valuable for high-value or critical assets. It treats risk as both threat and opportunity and explains how to integrate risk identification, analysis and mitigation into asset management and resource allocation.

uz.t: Hayotiy sikl va xatarlarni boshqarish
uz.ab: Hisobot yo‘l aktivlarining qurilishdan to foydalanishdan chiqarishgacha turli moliyalashtirish ssenariylarida holatini prognozlash (hayotiy sikl rejalash) va xatarlarni (tahdid va imkoniyat sifatida) aniqlash, tahlil qilish hamda resurslarni taqsimlashga integratsiya qilishni tushuntiradi. O‘zbekistonda cheklangan ta’mirlash mablag‘larini ustuvor ob’ektlarga yo‘naltirish uchun metodik asos.

title: Overweight Vehicles: Impact On Road Infrastructure And Safety - PIARC Special Project (2022SP01)
abs: Special project gathering global information on overweight freight vehicles, their effects on pavements, bridges and safety, and the finances of infrastructure managers. It shows how gross-weight limits vary between countries and summarises best practices to prevent overloading.

uz.t: Og‘ir vaznli transport vositalari: yo‘l infratuzilmasi va xavfsizlikka ta’siri
uz.ab: Turli mamlakatlarda yuk avtomobillari uchun belgilangan umumiy vazn chegaralari, ortiqcha yuklanishning to‘shama va ko‘priklarga ta’siri, ag‘darilish xavfi va to‘qnashuv og‘irligining ortishi hamda oldini olish bo‘yicha eng yaxshi amaliyotlar jamlangan. O‘zbekistonda yuk tashish me’yorlarini va o‘q yuklamasi chegaralarini qayta ko‘rib chiqishda foydali.

title: Road Safety Annual Report 2024
abs: ITF/IRTAD annual report with validated road-safety data for 35 member countries plus observers. Road deaths in 2023 fell about 2.7% versus 2022, only seven countries are on track to halve deaths by 2030, and young adults and powered two-wheeler users stand out as high-risk groups.

uz.t: Yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi bo‘yicha yillik hisobot 2024
uz.ab: ITF/IRTAD hisobotida 35 mamlakatning tasdiqlangan ma’lumotlari asosida 2023 yilda yo‘lda halok bo‘lganlar soni 2022 ga nisbatan taxminan 2,7% kamaygani, faqat yetti mamlakat 2030 yilgacha o‘limni ikki baravar kamaytirish maqsadiga yetishi mumkinligi ko‘rsatiladi; 18–24 yoshlilar va mototsiklchilar eng yuqori xavf guruhi. O‘zbekiston yo‘l xavfsizligi ko‘rsatkichlarini xalqaro darajada solishtirish va maqsadlar qo‘yish uchun manba.

title: Sayoz joylashgan metropoliten tonnel qoplamalari konstruktiv yechimlari va hisoblash usullarini takomillashtirish
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, ixtisoslik 05.09.02 – Geotexnika (ko‘priklar, transport tonnellari va metropolitenlar). Himoya Toshkent davlat transport universiteti huzuridagi DSc.10/2025.27.12.T.01.01 raqamli ilmiy kengashda 2026-yil 9-iyul soat 11:00 da belgilangan. Havola uza.uz dagi rasmiy himoya e’loniga olib boradi; avtoreferat PDF fayli topilmadi.

title: Shaharlarda avtomobil to‘xtash va saqlash joylarini rejalashtirish usullarini takomillashtirish
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 18.00.02 – shaharsozlik va arxitektura ixtisosligi. Himoya Toshkent arxitektura-qurilish universiteti huzuridagi PhD.03/2026.09.01.T.03.M bir martalik ilmiy kengashida 2026-yil 7-oktabr, soat 10:00 ga belgilangan. Ish shaharlarda avtomobillarni to‘xtatish va saqlash joylarini rejalashtirish usullarini takomillashtirishga qaratilgan. Havola rasmiy himoya e’loniga olib boradi; avtoreferat ochiq havolada topilmadi.

title: O‘zbekistonda transport sohasidagi davlat boshqaruvining tashkiliy-huquqiy asoslarini takomillashtirish
abs: Yuridik fanlar bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi avtoreferati, 12.00.02 – konstitutsiyaviy huquq, ma’muriy huquq, moliya va bojxona huquqi ixtisosligi. Himoya TDTrU huzuridagi PhD.10/2026.08.05.Yu.01.10 ilmiy kengashida 2026-yil 17-oktabrga belgilangan. Ishda barcha transport turlarini qamrovchi Transport kodeksi, multimodal operator, e-CMR/e-TIR elektron hujjatlari va intellektual transport tizimlarini huquqiy tartibga solish takliflari asoslangan.

title: Yo‘l bitumlarining fizik-mexanik va ekspluatatsion xossalarini tadqiq qilish
abs: Yo‘l bitumining penetratsiya, yumshash harorati, cho‘ziluvchanlik, qovushqoqlik, adgeziya va eskirishga chidamliligi laboratoriya natijalari va adabiyotlar asosida baholangan. Iqlim va transport yuklamasining bitum xossalariga ta’siri ko‘rib chiqilib, polimer bilan modifikatsiyalangan bitumning afzalliklari ko‘rsatilgan. Ilm-Fan Xabarnomasi, 15-jild, 1-son (2026), Zenodo’da CC BY 4.0 litsenziyasi bilan ochiq.

title: Scientific and practical justification of safe vehicle speeds in mountainous areas of the M-39 highway of international importance
abs: Proposes a mathematical model for safe speed on mountain roads using curve radius, pavement adhesion, traffic intensity and density, a geometric coefficient and an acceptable risk level, applied to mountain sections of the M-39 highway. Recommends dynamic signs, warning panels and automated speed monitoring at dangerous curves. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(3), 2026, pp. 18–23; DOI 10.56143/3030-3893-2026-3-18-23.

uz.t: Xalqaro ahamiyatga ega M-39 avtomobil yo‘lining tog‘li hududlarida transport vositalarining xavfsiz tezligini ilmiy-amaliy asoslash
uz.ab: Maqolada burilish radiusi, qoplamaning ilashish koeffitsiyenti, harakat jadalligi va zichligi hamda maqbul xavf darajasini hisobga oluvchi xavfsiz tezlik modeli taklif etilib, M-39 yo‘lining tog‘li uchastkalariga qo‘llangan. Xavfli burilishlar va ko‘rinish cheklangan joylarda dinamik belgilar, ogohlantiruvchi tablolar va avtomatlashtirilgan tezlik nazoratini joriy etish tavsiya qilinadi. Tog‘li dovonlardagi avariyalarni kamaytirish va tezlik cheklovlarini asoslash uchun bevosita foydali.

title: Study of the impact of heavy trucks on the smoothness of asphalt concrete pavement
org: TDTrU / Termiz davlat muhandislik va agrotexnologiyalar universiteti (O‘zbekiston)
abs: Surveys roughness on km 1360–1425 of the M-39 highway (southern Uzbekistan) in both directions with the TRASSA mobile laboratory using IRI, and links wheel-path rutting to heavy freight traffic. Mean IRI was 1.76 m/km (Tashkent–Termez) and 1.49 m/km (reverse), with 8.4% and 3.7% of length above the 3 m/km limit for category I roads and a maximum of 8.08 m/km. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(3), 2026, pp. 186–190.

uz.t: Og‘ir yuk avtomobillarining asfaltbeton qoplama tekisligiga ta’sirini o‘rganish
uz.ab: M-39 yo‘lining 1360–1425-km uchastkasida TRASSA ko‘chma laboratoriyasi bilan ikki yo‘nalishda xalqaro notekislik indeksi (IRI) o‘lchangan: o‘rtacha 1,76 va 1,49 m/km, I toifali yo‘llar uchun 3 m/km chegarasidan oshgan qism 8,4% va 3,7%, eng yuqori qiymat 8,08 m/km. Og‘ir yuk transporti g‘ildirak izi bo‘yicha kolea hosil bo‘lishini kuchaytirishi ko‘rsatilib, qoplama holatini yaxshilash bo‘yicha tavsiyalar berilgan. Janubiy tranzit yo‘laklarida ta’mirlashni rejalashtirish uchun real o‘lchov ma’lumotlari beradi.

title: Assessment of cycling infrastructure and bikeability in Tashkent city
abs: Evaluates cycling facilities on selected Tashkent streets using field observation, a GIS inventory, an online survey of 309 respondents and an equal-weighted Bikeability Index. Lane availability was rated lowest (38.8% unsatisfactory or poor); Shevchenko, Navoi and Shahrisabz streets scored best, while gaps and lack of parking lowered others. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(3), 2026, pp. 50–53.

uz.t: Toshkent shahrida velosiped infratuzilmasi va velosipedda harakatlanish qulayligini baholash
uz.ab: Dala kuzatuvi, GIS inventarizatsiyasi, 309 kishilik so‘rovnoma va Bikeability indeksi asosida Toshkent ko‘chalaridagi velosiped infratuzilmasi baholangan. Velosiped yo‘lakchalari mavjudligi eng past baholangan (38,8% qoniqarsiz), T. Shevchenko, A. Navoiy va Shahrisabz ko‘chalari eng yaxshi yo‘laklar sifatida ajratilgan. Shahar ko‘chalarini loyihalash va yo‘lakchalar tarmog‘idagi uzilishlarni bartaraf etishda foydalanish mumkin.

title: Comparative analysis of low-temperature cracking resistance in Uzbekistan bitumens using bending beam rheometry
abs: Compares unmodified BND bitumen with polymer-, crumb-rubber- and sulfur-modified binders after RTFOT and PAV ageing, using a Bending Beam Rheometer at −12, −18 and −24 °C (creep stiffness S(60) and m-value). PMB and crumb-rubber binders resisted embrittlement better than BND, supporting performance-grade binder selection in Central Asia. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(2), 2026, pp. 122–125.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston bitumlarining past haroratda yoriqbardoshligini egiluvchi balka reometri (BBR) yordamida qiyosiy tahlil qilish
uz.ab: Oddiy neft bitumi (BND), polimer, rezina maydasi va oltingugurt bilan modifikatsiyalangan bitumlar RTFOT va PAV usulida eskirtirilib, −12, −18 va −24 °C da BBR sinovidan o‘tkazilgan. PMB va rezina bilan modifikatsiyalangan bog‘lovchilar mo‘rtlashishga ancha chidamli ekani aniqlangan. Qishki yoriqlar ko‘p uchraydigan hududlar uchun bitum markasini PG tizimi bo‘yicha tanlashni asoslaydi.

title: Development of an automated pavement condition assessment tool based on Ge-Road mobile monitoring data and the ASTM D6433 methodology
abs: Describes an Excel-based tool that processes pavement distress data collected with the Ge-Road mobile app to compute the Pavement Condition Index per ASTM D6433 automatically, aiming to cut manual errors and speed up maintenance planning for road agencies. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(2), 2026, pp. 132–137.

uz.t: Ge-Road mobil monitoring ma’lumotlari va ASTM D6433 metodikasi asosida qoplama holatini avtomatlashtirilgan baholash vositasini ishlab chiqish
uz.ab: Ge-Road mobil ilovasi orqali to‘plangan qoplama nuqsonlari ma’lumotlaridan ASTM D6433 bo‘yicha qoplama holati indeksi (PCI)ni avtomatik hisoblovchi Excel vositasi yaratilgan. Qo‘lda hisoblash xatolarini kamaytirish va ta’mir ehtiyojlarini tezroq aniqlash maqsad qilingan. Yo‘l xo‘jaligi tashkilotlarida aktivlarni boshqarish va diagnostikani raqamlashtirish uchun amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

title: Evaluation of the impact of dynamic loads on road pavements and pavement strength under temperature factors
org: TDTrU / Termiz davlat muhandislik va agrotexnologiyalar universiteti (O‘zbekiston)
abs: Assesses pavement strength with dynamic loading devices and the effect of heavy vehicle loads on deflection and service life, showing that asphalt temperature strongly influences test results. Proposes converting field measurements at actual temperature to design conditions. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(2), 2026, pp. 34–37.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamalariga dinamik yuklamalar ta’siri va harorat omillari sharoitida qoplama mustahkamligini baholash
uz.ab: Dinamik yuklash qurilmalari yordamida qoplama mustahkamligi va og‘ir avtomobillar yuklamasining egilish hamda xizmat muddatiga ta’siri baholangan. Asfaltbeton harorati sinov natijalariga kuchli ta’sir qilishi sababli dala o‘lchovlarini hisobiy haroratga keltirish usuli taklif etilgan. Issiq iqlimli O‘zbekistonda ekspluatatsiyadagi yo‘llarni diagnostika qilishda bevosita qo‘llanadi.

title: Adhesion property of asphalt binder
abs: Reviews the adhesion mechanism between bitumen and aggregates, the role of aggregate mineralogy, texture and porosity and of binder chemistry and rheology, and how moisture and temperature drive stripping, ravelling and cracking; discusses ways to improve moisture resistance. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(2), 2026, pp. 20–22.

uz.t: Asfalt bog‘lovchisining adgeziya xossasi
uz.ab: Bitum va tosh material orasidagi adgeziya mexanizmi, toshning mineral tarkibi, sirt teksturasi va g‘ovakligi hamda bitumning kimyoviy va reologik xossalarining roli tahlil qilingan. Namlik va harorat ta’sirida qoplamaning uvalanishi, yorilishi va qatlamlanishi mexanizmlari hamda namga chidamlilikni oshirish yo‘llari ko‘rib chiqilgan. Mahalliy shag‘al va qum bilan bitum yopishqoqligi past bo‘lgan holatlar uchun foydali.

title: Analytical study of seismic isolation systems in bridge structures
abs: Reviews seismic isolation and energy-dissipation systems for bridges, classifying adaptive and stationary isolation and their rigid, flexible, sliding, elastic and gravitational bearing components, and argues that anti-seismic devices should be treated as essential structural elements. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(2), 2026, pp. 62–66.

uz.t: Ko‘prik konstruksiyalarida seysmik izolyatsiya tizimlarini analitik o‘rganish
uz.ab: Ko‘priklarni zilziladan himoyalovchi seysmik izolyatsiya va energiya so‘ndiruvchi tizimlar tasniflangan: adaptiv va statsionar tizimlar, qattiq, egiluvchan, sirpanuvchi, elastik va gravitatsion tayanch elementlari. Antiseysmik qurilmalarni ko‘prikning mustaqil konstruktiv elementi sifatida ko‘rish taklif qilinadi. Yuqori seysmik hududdagi O‘zbekiston ko‘priklarini loyihalash va kuchaytirish uchun dolzarb.

title: Mechanics of the interaction between reinforced concrete beams and rigid stays in span structures of highway overpasses
abs: Develops differential and matrix formulations and a MIDAS Civil model of a three-span (49.5+75.0+49.5 m) overpass to study how stay bending stiffness affects moments and deflections, with recommendations on stiffness, anchorage and joint detailing for seismic areas. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(2), 2026, pp. 138–143.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘l o‘tkazgichlari oraliq qurilmalarida temirbeton to‘sinlar va qattiq tortqilar o‘zaro ta’siri mexanikasi
uz.ab: 49,5+75,0+49,5 m uch oraliqli yo‘l o‘tkazgich MIDAS Civil dasturida modellashtirilib, tortqilarning egilishdagi bikirligi eguvchi momentlar va salqiliklarga ta’siri o‘rganilgan. Bikirlikni optimallashtirish, ankerlash va tugunlarni konstruksiyalash bo‘yicha tavsiyalar berilgan. Seysmik hududlarda katta oraliqli yo‘l o‘tkazgichlar loyihalash uchun foydali.

title: Analysis of the state of the road infrastructure at the intersection of the Dombirobod Small Ring Road and Chilonzor street in Tashkent
abs: Inventories traffic control devices and counts flows at a major Tashkent junction: 5,121 veh/h entering in the morning peak and 6,000 veh/h in the evening peak; priority, pedestrian and speed-limit signs are missing. A two-phase Webster signal plan with an 88 s cycle gives a degree of saturation of 0.78. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 4(2), 2026, pp. 166–170.

uz.t: Toshkentdagi Dombirobod Kichik halqa yo‘li va Chilonzor ko‘chasi chorrahasida yo‘l infratuzilmasi holatini tahlil qilish
uz.ab: Chorrahada harakatni boshqarish vositalari xatlovdan o‘tkazilgan va transport oqimi sanalgan: ertalabki cho‘qqida 5121, kechki cho‘qqida 6000 avt/soat; ustuvorlik, piyodalar o‘tish joyi va tezlik cheklovi belgilari umuman yo‘q. Webster usuli bo‘yicha 88 soniyali ikki fazali svetofor sikli (to‘yinganlik darajasi 0,78) taklif etilgan. Shahar chorrahalarini tashkil etish bo‘yicha amaliy namuna.

title: Methodology for Assessing Embodied Carbon in Bridge Structures
abs: Proposes formulas and step-by-step procedures for estimating embodied carbon of bridge materials and construction works (operational carbon excluded), as a framework for sustainability assessment. Engineer, Special Issue 1(1), 2026, pp. 94–97.

uz.t: Ko‘prik konstruksiyalarida mujassamlangan uglerodni baholash metodikasi
uz.ab: Ko‘prik materiallari ishlab chiqarilishi va qurilish ishlaridan chiqadigan issiqxona gazlarini hisoblash formulalari va bosqichma-bosqich tartibi taklif etilgan; foydalanish davri emissiyasi kiritilmagan. Raqamli natijalar keltirilmagan, metodika amaliy hisob uchun asos sifatida berilgan. “Yashil” infratuzilma va xalqaro moliyalashtiriladigan ko‘prik loyihalarida uglerod hisobini yuritish uchun foydali.

title: Use of basalt reinforcement, mesh, and fabrics as structural materials in geotechnical and earthworks
org: Sharof Rashidov nomidagi Samarqand davlat universiteti (O‘zbekiston)
abs: Examines basalt-fibre composite rebar, mesh and fabrics for geotechnical, earthwork and hydraulic structures, compares their properties with steel reinforcement and identifies suitable applications. Engineer, Special Issue 1(1), 2026, pp. 59–64.

uz.t: Bazalt armatura, to‘r va matolarni geotexnik va yer ishlarida konstruktiv material sifatida qo‘llash
uz.ab: Bazalt tolali kompozit armatura, to‘r va matolarning fizik-mexanik xossalari po‘lat armatura bilan solishtirilib, geotexnik, gidrotexnik inshootlar va yer ishlarida eng maqbul qo‘llanish sohalari aniqlangan. Korroziyaga chidamli mahalliy bazalt materiallaridan yo‘l poyi va qiyaliklarni mustahkamlashda foydalanish imkoniyatini ko‘rsatadi.

title: Economic efficiency of implementing modern prefabricated reinforced retaining walls
abs: Compares construction, installation and defect-repair costs of prefabricated reinforced retaining walls with conventional walls for highway bridges and overpasses, concluding that prefabrication speeds construction and lowers life-cycle costs. Engineer, Special Issue 1(1), 2026, pp. 98–104.

uz.t: Zamonaviy yig‘ma elementlardan iborat armaturalangan tirkama devorlarni qo‘llashning iqtisodiy samaradorligi
uz.ab: Avtomobil yo‘l ko‘priklari va o‘tkazgichlarida yig‘ma armaturalangan tirkama devorlar an’anaviy devorlar bilan qurilish, montaj va ekspluatatsiyadagi nuqsonlarni bartaraf etish xarajatlari bo‘yicha solishtirilgan. Yig‘ma devorlar qurilishni tezlashtirishi va uzoq muddatli xarajatlarni kamaytirishi asoslangan. Ko‘prik kirish qismlarini loyihalashda iqtisodiy tanlov uchun foydali.

title: Application of new seismically insulated supporting parts for seismic protection of bridge intermediate buildings
org: TDTrU / FA Mexanika va inshootlar seysmik mustahkamligi instituti (O‘zbekiston)
abs: Reports experimental tests of newly developed seismic-isolating bearings for bridges and overpasses, comparing amplitude-frequency responses and span displacements with conventional fixed and movable bearings and concluding the new parts are effective. Engineer, Special Issue 1(1), 2026, pp. 44–48.

uz.t: Ko‘prik oraliq tayanchlarini seysmik himoyalash uchun yangi seysmik izolyatsiyalovchi tayanch qismlarni qo‘llash
uz.ab: Ko‘prik va yo‘l o‘tkazgichlar uchun yangi seysmik izolyatsiyalovchi tayanch qismlar tajribada sinalgan, ularning amplituda-chastota tavsiflari an’anaviy qo‘zg‘aluvchan va qo‘zg‘almas tayanchlar bilan solishtirilgan. Yangi qism oraliq qurilma siljishlarini kamaytirishda samarali ekani ko‘rsatilgan. Mahalliy ishlanma sifatida seysmik hududdagi ko‘priklarda qo‘llash uchun ahamiyatli.

title: Improvement of pavement concrete by industrial waste microfillers
abs: Formulates pavement concrete with industrial-waste microfillers in its most effective mix variants and reports measured yield stress, surface activity and water separation of the mixtures. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 3(1), 2025, pp. 5–7; DOI 10.56143/3030-3893-2025-1-5-7.

uz.t: Sanoat chiqindilaridan olingan mikroto‘ldirgichlar bilan yo‘l betonini yaxshilash
uz.ab: Sanoat chiqindilaridan olingan mikroto‘ldirgichlar qo‘shilgan yo‘l betoni tarkiblarining eng samarali variantlari ishlab chiqilgan, aralashmaning oquvchanlik chegarasi, sirt faolligi va suv ajratishi o‘lchangan. Sement-beton qoplamali magistral yo‘llar qurilishida sement sarfini kamaytirish va chiqindilardan foydalanish uchun ahamiyatli.

title: Temperature stability of asphalt concrete under conditions of high summer temperatures in Tajikistan
abs: Evaluates BND 60/90, PMB 90, PG 70-28 and PG 76-22 binders and gradations for Tajikistan's hot climate through climate mapping, rutting, moisture susceptibility and rheological tests; polymer-modified binders sharply reduced rutting at 60 °C, PG 76-22 performing best, and their extra cost is offset by longer life. Международный научный журнал «Инженер» (TDTrU), 3(3), 2025, pp. 78–83.

uz.t: Tojikistonda yozgi yuqori harorat sharoitida asfaltbetonning issiqqa chidamliligi
uz.ab: BND 60/90, PMB 90, PG 70-28 va PG 76-22 bog‘lovchilari issiq iqlim uchun iqlim xaritalash, kolea hosil bo‘lishi, namga sezgirlik va reologik sinovlar orqali solishtirilgan. Polimer bilan modifikatsiyalangan bitumlar 60 °C da koleani keskin kamaytirgan, eng yaxshi natija PG 76-22 da; qo‘shimcha xarajat uzoqroq xizmat muddati bilan qoplanadi. Iqlimi o‘xshash O‘zbekiston janubi uchun bevosita qo‘llanadigan qo‘shni mamlakat tajribasi.

title: Avtomobil transportida tashilgan yuklar hajmi (yillik) — statistik ko‘rsatkich, 2000–2025
abs: Milliy statistika qo‘mitasining SIAT tizimidagi rasmiy ko‘rsatkichi: avtomobil transportida tashilgan yuklar hajmi, 2000–2025-yillar bo‘yicha yillik qatorlar. Birinchi marta 2022-yil 29-iyunda e’lon qilingan, oxirgi yangilanish 2026-yil 14-iyul. Yo‘llardagi yuk oqimi dinamikasini tahlil qilish va yo‘l ehtiyojlarini prognozlashda asosiy manba.

title: In-Service Repair of Highway Bridges and Pavements by Internal Time-Release of Repair Chemicals
abs: The project embedded adhesive-filled glass tubes in concrete so that cracking breaks the tubes and releases adhesive into the crack while the structure stays in service. Lab frames, full-scale bridge deck slabs and small beams were tested with cyanoacrylate, epoxy and silicone. Cyanoacrylate sealed cracks best and shrinkage tubes acted as control joints, but beam results were largely inconclusive and the work was described as preliminary.

uz.t: Ta’mirlovchi kimyoviy moddalarni ichkaridan sekin ajratish orqali ko‘prik va qoplamalarni foydalanish davrida ta’mirlash
uz.ab: Betonda yoriq paydo bo‘lganda uning ichiga joylangan shisha naychalar sinib, yelimni o‘zi yoriqqa chiqarishi — ya’ni inshootni to‘xtatmasdan "o‘z-o‘zini ta’mirlash" g‘oyasi sinaldi. Laboratoriya ramalarida, to‘rtta to‘liq o‘lchamli ko‘prik qoplamasi plitasida va kichik balkalarda sianoakrilat, epoksid va silikon yelimlar tekshirildi. Sianoakrilat yoriqlarni eng mustahkam yopdi; faqat sirtqi yelimli plita ikkinchi yuklashda dastlabki 1500 psi o‘rniga taxminan 1800 psi ko‘tardi (≈20% ko‘p), nazorat plitasi esa ≈33% kuchsizlandi, biroq balkalarda yoriq ≈1/3 dyuymgacha kengayib, natija aniq bo‘lmadi. O‘zbekistonda yozgi issiq va keskin harorat farqidan betonning kirishib yorilishi keng tarqalgan, shu sababli bu yondashuv ko‘prik qoplamalarini suv va tuzdan himoya qilishda kelajakda qo‘llanishi mumkin bo‘lgan g‘oya sifatida qiziqarli.

title: Mechanics-Based Asphalt Binder Test Method for Low Temperature Performance Prediction
abs: Standard low-temperature binder grading (AASHTO M320/MP1a) failed to explain why same-grade sections in northern Ontario cracked very differently. Using 17 trial sections, extended conditioning, spectroscopy of aged binders and notched fracture tests, the study showed physical aging, notch sensitivity and field oxidation beyond PAV predictions drive early cracking. A fracture-energy based criterion predicted cracking onset more closely than current grading.

uz.t: Past haroratda bitum ishlashini bashorat qilishning mexanikaga asoslangan sinov usuli
uz.ab: Shimoliy Ontariodagi 17 ta tajriba uchastkasida bir xil PG markali bitumli qoplamalar nega turlicha yorilishi o‘rganildi: bir yo‘lda bir xil markali ikki uchastkada ko‘ndalang yoriqlar soni qariyb 20 baravar farq qildi. Bitumlar uzoqroq (12 va 72 soat) sovuqda saqlanib, spektroskopiya va kesikli namunalarda sinish sinovlari o‘tkazildi; 12 soatdan so‘ng sifatsiz bitumlar markasini 10–13 °C ga yo‘qotdi, yaxshisi faqat 3 °C, sirtqi 2,5 sm qatlamdagi oksidlanish esa laboratoriya RTFO+PAV eskirtirishidan 2,5–4,2 baravar kuchli chiqdi. Muallif sinish energiyasiga asoslangan mezonni taklif qildi va u yoriqlar boshlanishini amaldagi M320 usulidan aniqroq bashorat qildi. O‘zbekistonda qishki sovuq va yozgi kuchli quyosh bitumni tez eskirtiradi, shuning uchun bitum markasini real eskirish sharoitida baholash tamoyili mahalliy bitum sifatini nazorat qilishda foydali.

title: Smart Antenna Array for NDE of FRP-Wrapped Concrete Bridge Members
abs: Concrete bridge members strengthened with FRP wraps can hide debonds that visual inspection cannot find. The project built a prototype of six phased-array microwave antennas near 10 GHz that electronically focus the beam and compare scattered signals with a sound reference point. Lab specimens showed debonds of about 1–1.5 mm thickness under two FRP layers and between FRP layers were detected, though field evaluation was still needed.

uz.t: Kompozit bilan o‘ralgan beton ko‘prik elementlarini buzmasdan tekshirish uchun aqlli antenna massivi
uz.ab: Eskirgan beton ko‘prik elementlarini kuchaytirish uchun ular FRP (shisha yoki uglerod tolali kompozit) bilan o‘raladi, ammo o‘rama ostida beton bilan kompozit orasida havo bo‘shlig‘i (ajralish) paydo bo‘lsa, uni ko‘z bilan ko‘rib bo‘lmaydi. Loyihada ≈10 GGs chastotali mikroto‘lqinni elektron yo‘l bilan fokuslaydigan oltita antenna massividan iborat prototip yaratildi: u taxminan 1 soniyada bir uchastkani skanerlaydi va signalni shikastlanmagan nuqta bilan solishtiradi. Laboratoriyada ikki qatlam FRP ostidagi qalinligi 1–1,5 mm bo‘shliqlar va ko‘p qatlamli kompozit ichidagi ajralishlar aniqlandi, lekin dala sinovlari hali zarurligi qayd etildi. O‘zbekistonda eski temir-beton ko‘priklarni kompozit bilan kuchaytirish ko‘paysa, bunday buzmasdan nazorat usullari ta’mir sifatini tekshirish uchun kerak bo‘ladi.

title: Long-Term Remote Sensing System for Bridge Piers
abs: Existing pier tilt monitors use few expensive sensors that drift and miss slow, long-term movement. This project used arrays of low-cost electrolytic tilt sensors with redundancy and algorithms that convert tilt to 3D pier movement and filter normal thermal motion. Arrays tripled signal-to-noise ratio, detected pier movements above 0.0265° and vertical displacements of 0.045 in., and a field system on a New York bridge ran over 13 months.

uz.t: Ko‘prik tayanchlarini uzoq muddat masofadan kuzatish tizimi
uz.ab: Ko‘prik tayanchlari suv yuvishi, cho‘kish yoki tiqilib qolgan tayanch qismlar tufayli asta-sekin og‘ishi mumkin, ammo mavjud qimmat datchiklar vaqt o‘tishi bilan "suzadi" va sekin harakatni sezmaydi. Loyihada ko‘plab arzon elektrolitik qiyalik datchiklari guruhlarga birlashtirildi va maxsus algoritmlar ularning ma’lumotini tayanchning uch o‘lchamli siljishiga aylantirib, haroratdan kelib chiqadigan oddiy kunlik harakatni ajratdi. Guruhlash signal/shovqin nisbatini ≈1 dan ≈3 ga oshirdi, 0,0265° dan katta og‘ish va 0,045 dyuymli vertikal siljish aniqlandi, Nyu-Yorkdagi ko‘prikda 16 datchikli tizim 13 oydan ortiq uzluksiz ishladi. O‘zbekistonda daryo va kanallar ustidagi ko‘priklar (masalan, sel va yuvilish xavfi bor joylarda) uchun tayanchlarni arzon uzluksiz kuzatish tizimi sifatida ahamiyatli.

title: Investigation of a Full-Lane Acoustic Scanning Method for Bridge Deck NDE
abs: Chain dragging and hammer sounding miss many corrosion-induced delaminations in bridge decks, while contact impact-echo is slow. The project built a towed, contactless impact-echo scanner covering a 12-ft lane with twelve microphones and rotating hammers, plus finite element modeling of defect vibrations. Stationary tests matched predicted frequencies and defect edges well, but rolling-hammer noise prevented defect detection while moving.

uz.t: Ko‘prik qoplamasini to‘liq tasma bo‘yicha akustik skanerlash usulini tadqiq etish
uz.ab: Ko‘prik qoplamalarida armatura korroziyasidan paydo bo‘ladigan ichki qatlamlanishni zanjir sudrash yoki bolg‘a bilan urib tekshirish sub’ektiv va ko‘p nuqsonni o‘tkazib yuboradi. Loyihada 12 futlik (≈3,7 m) bo‘lakni bir o‘tishda qamrab oladigan, 12 ta oddiy mikrofon va aylanuvchi bolg‘achalardan iborat, sirtga tegmaydigan tirkama skaner yaratildi va nuqsonlar tebranishi chekli elementlar usulida modellashtirildi. Joyida turgan holatda o‘lchangan chastotalar modelga mos keldi va nuqson chegaralari aniq ko‘rindi, ammo harakatlanishda bolg‘achalarning g‘adir-budur sirtdagi shovqini nuqsonlarni yashirib qo‘ydi, shuning uchun prototip hali dalaga tayyor emasligi qayd etildi. O‘zbekistonda ko‘priklarni harakatni to‘xtatmasdan tez tekshirish ehtiyoji katta, bu ish arzon mikrofonlar bilan shunday skaner yaratish yo‘lini ko‘rsatadi.

title: Development of a Second Generation Neutron-Based Detector for Chloride in Concrete
abs: Measuring chloride in concrete normally requires drilling and chemical analysis. The project developed a second-generation prompt gamma neutron activation detector using electronic collimation (a planar NaI detector in coincidence with an HPGe detector) to shrink the sampled volume from about 100,000 to about 1,000 cm3. Collimation was confirmed with radioisotope sources, but no concrete measurements were made because no portable neutron source was available.

uz.t: Betondagi xloridni aniqlovchi ikkinchi avlod neytron detektori
uz.ab: Betondagi xlorid miqdorini aniqlash odatda burg‘ulash, maydalash va kimyoviy tahlil talab qiladi, shu sababli dalada kam bajariladi. Loyihada neytron nurlanishi ta’sirida chiqadigan gamma nurlarni o‘lchaydigan ikkinchi avlod detektor ishlab chiqildi: ikki detektorni bir vaqtda ishlatuvchi elektron kollimatsiya o‘lchanadigan hajmni ≈100 000 sm³ dan ≈1000 sm³ ga kamaytirishi kerak edi. Radioaktiv manba bilan sinovda bu usul fon signallarini 4442 tadan 3 tagacha kamaytirdi (og‘ir qo‘rg‘oshin himoyasi o‘rniga), ammo ko‘chma neytron manbai bo‘lmagani uchun betonda o‘lchov va dala sinovi o‘tkazilmadi. O‘zbekistonda sho‘r tuproqlar va qishki tuz sepish betonga xlorid kiritadi, shuning uchun xloridni buzmasdan aniqlash g‘oyasi ko‘priklarni saqlash uchun muhim yo‘nalish.

title: Development of a Simple Test to Determine the Low Temperature Strength of Asphalt Mixtures
abs: Low-temperature strength tests for asphalt (IDT, DTT) are expensive or hard to interpret. The project showed that the Bending Beam Rheometer, run in three-point bending under load control, can measure strength of both binders and thin mixture beams, using size-effect theory to relate results to larger specimens. Air proved a suitable cooling medium for binders, giving values within about 6% of DTT.

uz.t: Asfalt aralashmalarining past haroratdagi mustahkamligini aniqlovchi oddiy sinov
uz.ab: Asfaltning past haroratda yorilishga qarshiligini o‘lchovchi mavjud mustahkamlik sinovlari (IDT, DTT) qimmat uskuna talab qiladi yoki natijasini talqin qilish qiyin. Tadqiqotchilar ko‘pchilik laboratoriyada bor bo‘lgan bitum sinovi qurilmasi — BBR (egiluvchi balka reometri) yordamida bitum va asfaltbetonning ingichka balkachalarini sindirib, mustahkamlikni aniqlash mumkinligini ko‘rsatdi va natijalarni katta namunalarga o‘tkazish uchun o‘lcham effekti (Veybull) nazariyasini qo‘lladi. Havoda sovutilgan bitum namunalari DTT natijasidan atigi ≈6% farq qildi (masalan, 3,7 va 3,9 MPa), etanol esa qiymatlarni keskin pasaytirgani uchun yaroqsiz deb topildi. O‘zbekiston laboratoriyalari uchun qo‘shimcha qimmat uskunasiz qishki yorilishga chidamlilikni baholash imkonini beradigan arzon yo‘l sifatida qiziqarli.

title: An Inexpensive Vision-Based Approach for the Autonomous Detection, Localization, and Quantification of Pavement Defects
abs: Automated pavement survey vehicles cost around $1 million and manual surveys are slow and subjective. The project mounted four low-cost Microsoft Kinect RGB-D cameras with a sun shade, strobe lighting, accelerometers and GPS/INS on a vehicle and developed crack detection and rolling-shutter correction methods. The system gave usable images below about 30 mph; about 70% of points were within 2.5 mm of a LIDAR scan.

uz.t: Qoplama nuqsonlarini avtonom aniqlash, joylashtirish va miqdorini baholashning arzon ko‘rish usuli
uz.ab: Yo‘l qoplamasi holatini avtomatik tekshiruvchi maxsus avtomobillar ≈1 mln dollar turadi, qo‘lda baholash esa sekin va sub’ektiv. Loyihada avtomobilga to‘rtta arzon Microsoft Kinect chuqurlik kamerasi, quyosh soyaboni, stroboskop yorug‘lik, akselerometr va GPS/INS o‘rnatilib, chuqur va yoriqlarni aniqlash hamda kamera buzilishini tuzatish algoritmlari ishlab chiqildi. Kaliforniyadagi 3,86 km yo‘lda sinovda nuqtalarning ≈70% lazer skaner (LIDAR) natijasidan 2,5 mm ichida bo‘ldi, tizim ≈30 mil/soat (≈48 km/soat) dan past tezlikda yaxshi tasvir berdi, yuqori tezlikda esa ishonchli natija ko‘rsatilmadi. O‘zbekistonda tarmoq bo‘ylab qoplama holatini arzon usulda kuzatish ehtiyoji katta, shu bois bunday past xarajatli tizimlar tumanlar darajasidagi yo‘l xizmatlari uchun foydali namuna.

title: Producing a Sustainable and Bio-Based Alternative for Petroleum-Based Asphalt
abs: Crumb rubber improves asphalt but greatly raises binder viscosity and mixing temperatures. Adding a bio-binder derived from swine manure to 15% crumb-rubber binder produced bio-modified rubber (BMR) asphalt, tested in binder and Superpave mixture tests. Up to 20% bio-binder cut viscosity by 71%, lowered mixing and compaction temperatures, and improved aged low-temperature fracture energy and moisture resistance.

uz.t: Neft asosidagi asfaltga barqaror bioasosli muqobil ishlab chiqarish
uz.ab: Eski avtoshinadan olingan rezina kukuni asfaltni yaxshilaydi, ammo bitum qovushqoqligini keskin oshirib, aralashtirish va zichlash haroratini ko‘taradi. Loyihada 15% rezinali bitumga cho‘chqa go‘ngidan olingan bio-bog‘lovchi qo‘shilib, "bio-modifikatsiyalangan rezina" (BMR) bitum yaratildi va bitum hamda Superpave aralashmalari sinovlaridan o‘tkazildi. 20% gacha bio-bog‘lovchi qovushqoqlikni 71% ga kamaytirdi, 5% qo‘shimchaning o‘zi 135 °C da 3 Pa·s chegarasidan pastga tushirdi, zichlash harorati taxminan 201–208 °C dan 190–198 °C gacha pasaydi, eskirgan namunalarda esa past haroratdagi sinish energiyasi va namlikka chidamlilik oddiy rezina-bitumdan yaxshi chiqdi. O‘zbekistonda eskirgan shinalarni yo‘l qurilishida utilizatsiya qilish va rezina-bitumni zavodda ishlatishni osonlashtirish uchun foydali tajriba.

title: Development of a Small Specimen Geometry for Asphalt Mixture Performance Testing
abs: Small specimens would let agencies test thin as-built asphalt layers. The study compared 38-mm cylinders and 25×50×110-mm prisms with standard 100-mm cylinders for five mixtures in dynamic modulus and direct tension fatigue tests. Results were statistically equivalent at low and intermediate temperatures and predicted fatigue cracking differed by 5% or less in most cases; vertical coring and PP 61 temperature limits are recommended.

uz.t: Asfalt aralashmalarini sinash uchun kichik namuna geometriyasi
uz.ab: Yo‘ldagi yupqa asfalt qatlamlaridan standart 100 mm li namuna olish qiyin, shuning uchun kichik namunalarda sinash imkoniyati o‘rganildi. Besh xil aralashmada 38 mm diametrli silindrlar va 25×50×110 mm prizmalar standart namunalar bilan dinamik modul va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri cho‘zilishdagi charchoq sinovlarida solishtirildi. Past va o‘rta haroratda natijalar statistik jihatdan bir xil chiqdi, Pavement ME bashoratidagi charchoq yoriqlari ko‘p hollarda 5% dan kam farq qildi; yuqori haroratda (54,4 °C) kichik namunalar qattiqroq ko‘rindi, shuning uchun vertikal kesib olish va sinov haroratini cheklash tavsiya etildi. O‘zbekistonda mavjud yo‘llardan kern olib, yangi qatlam sifatini laboratoriyada baholash uchun bu yondashuv amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

title: DART Field Validation and Prototype Refinement
abs: Full AASHTO M320 binder grading takes about two days, so wrong binders can go undetected on site. The project ruggedized the portable piezoelectric DART device and used it to fingerprint binders against certified references. In field cases from two state DOT labs it matched same-grade binders, distinguished grades and flagged failing samples, in as little as 2.5 hours; it supplements rather than replaces M320.

uz.t: DART tizimini dalada tekshirish va prototipni takomillashtirish
uz.ab: Bitumning PG markasini AASHTO M320 bo‘yicha to‘liq aniqlash laboratoriyada ≈2 kun oladi, shu sababli qurilishda noto‘g‘ri bitum ishlatilsa, bu kech aniqlanadi. Loyihada pyezoelektrik datchikli ko‘chma DART qurilmasi dalaga moslab mustahkamlandi va bitumning 150–70 °F oralig‘idagi "barmoq izi" sertifikatlangan namuna bilan solishtirildi. Ikki shtat laboratoriyasi namunalarida u bir markali bitumlarni mos deb topdi, turli markalarni ajratdi va me’yorga to‘g‘ri kelmagan namunalarni belgiladi; sinov 2,5 soatda bajariladi, ammo M320 o‘rnini bosmaydi, faqat to‘ldiradi. O‘zbekistonda bitum sifati muammosi dolzarb, shu sababli obyektda kelgan bitumni tez tekshiradigan bunday qurilma sifat nazoratini kuchaytirishi mumkin.

title: Development of an IDEAL Cracking Test for Asphalt Mix Design, Quality Control, and Quality Assurance
abs: No simple, performance-related cracking test existed for routine asphalt mix design and QC/QA. The project developed the IDEAL-CT, an indirect tensile test at 25 °C and 50 mm/min yielding a Cracking Tolerance Index, and validated it against other lab tests and field sections. It proved fast, sensitive to RAP/RAS, binder grade, content and aging, with most COVs below 20%, and six DOTs committed to implementation.

uz.t: Asfalt aralashmasini loyihalash va sifat nazorati uchun IDEAL yorilish sinovi
uz.ab: Asfalt aralashmasini loyihalash va sifat nazorati uchun oddiy, ammo yo‘ldagi yorilishni aks ettiradigan sinov yo‘q edi. Loyihada IDEAL-CT sinovi yaratildi: 150 mm diametrli namuna 25 °C da 50 mm/min tezlikda bilvosita cho‘zilishga sinaladi va "yorilishga chidamlilik indeksi" (CTIndex) hisoblanadi, sinov ≈1 daqiqa davom etadi. Indeks RAP qo‘shilganda keskin tushdi (172,9 dan 20% RAPda 42,8 gacha), bitum markasi va miqdori ortganda o‘sdi, natijalar tarqoqligi asosan 20% dan kam bo‘ldi va FHWA sinov poligoni hamda dala uchastkalaridagi yoriqlar bilan mos keldi; oltita shtat uni joriy qilishga kirishdi. O‘zbekiston laboratoriyalarida mavjud oddiy press bilan bajariladigan bu sinov qayta ishlangan asfalt (RAP) qo‘shilgan aralashmalarni nazorat qilish uchun juda mos.

title: Smart Installation and Monitoring System for Large Anchor Bolts of Support Structure for Highway Signs, Luminaires, and Traffic Signals
abs: Loosened anchor bolts at the base of sign, luminaire and signal supports risk collapse, and hammer checks are slow. The project developed a capacitive "smart washer" stack with 3D-printed insulation whose capacitance tracks bolt tension, calibrated on a 2.5-in. bolt from about 30 pF loose to about 140 pF at 132 kips. Lab tests were repeatable and detected tension loss, but outdoor use was limited by moisture sensitivity.

uz.t: Yo‘l belgilari, chiroqlar va svetoforlar tayanchlarining yirik anker boltlari uchun aqlli o‘rnatish va monitoring tizimi
uz.ab: Yo‘l belgilari, chiroq va svetofor tayanchlari asosidagi anker boltlar bo‘shab qolsa, inshoot qulashi mumkin, ularni bolg‘a bilan urib tekshirish esa sekin va kech ogohlantiradi. Loyihada 3D bosmada tayyorlangan izolyatsiyali sig‘imli "aqlli shayba" yaratildi: boltdagi tortish kuchi o‘zgarganda shaybalar orasidagi masofa va elektr sig‘imi o‘zgaradi; 2,5 dyuymli boltda bo‘sh holatda ≈30 pF, 132 kips tortishda ≈140 pF qayd etildi, takroriy o‘lchov xatosi 0,3% dan kam bo‘ldi. Laboratoriyada usul ishladi, ammo ochiq havoda 80% dan yuqori namlikda o‘lchov buzildi va chidamli suv o‘tkazmaydigan qoplama hali yo‘qligi ta’kidlandi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida yirik portal va konsol belgilar soni ko‘paymoqda, ularning boltlarini masofadan nazorat qilish g‘oyasi xavfsizlik uchun foydali.

title: Vertical Impedance Scanner for Concrete Bridge Deck Assessment without Direct Rebar Attachment
abs: Vertical electrical impedance testing of bridge decks previously required a direct connection to the rebar and slow single-channel carts. The project built a multi-channel towed scanner with a large-area electrode instead of a rebar connection, plus GPS/LiDAR localization, scanning over 1,500 ft2/min. Field tests in Utah and Nebraska showed impedance below about 10^4 ohms associated with poor cover protection and higher chloride; the technology was licensed commercially.

uz.t: Armaturaga ulanmasdan beton ko‘prik qoplamasini baholovchi vertikal impedans skaneri
uz.ab: Ko‘prik qoplamasida armatura atrofidagi betonning himoya qobiliyatini elektr impedansi bilan baholash ilgari armaturaga bevosita ulanishni va sekin aravachalarni talab qilardi. Loyihada armaturaga ulanmasdan katta maydonli elektrod orqali ishlaydigan, GPS va LiDAR bilan joylashuvni aniqlaydigan ko‘p kanalli tirkama skaner yaratildi; u daqiqasiga 1500 kv. futdan ortiq maydonni ≈2–3 mil/soat tezlikda skanerlaydi. Yuta va Nebraskadagi sinovlarda impedansi ≈10⁴ Om dan past joylarda xlorid ko‘p va himoya zaif, 10⁵ Om dan yuqorisida holat yaxshi ekani ko‘rsatildi, texnologiya tijorat litsenziyasiga berildi. O‘zbekistonda qishki tuz va sho‘r suvlar ko‘prik armaturasini zanglatadi, bunday tez skanerlash ta’mirga muhtoj uchastkalarni oldindan aniqlashga yordam beradi.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasining umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llari ro‘yxatini tasdiqlash to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 383-son qarori, 04.07.2024)
abs: Hukumat qarori bilan umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llarining yangilangan ro‘yxati xalqaro, davlat va mahalliy ahamiyatdagi yo‘llar bo‘yicha uchta ilovada tasdiqlangan. Xalqaro ahamiyatdagi yo‘llar jami 3 833 km, davlat ahamiyatidagi yo‘llar 14 316 km etib belgilangan, mahalliy yo‘llar hududlar kesimida keltirilgan. Qaror PQ-330 ijrosi doirasida qabul qilingan, Transport vazirligiga yo‘llardagi ko‘priklar ro‘yxatini tasdiqlash topshirilgan; 1- va 2-ilovalar 2025-yil 1-yanvardan kuchga kirgan.

title: «Ichki yo‘llarni sement-beton qoplama bilan qurish» loyihasini Osiyo taraqqiyot banki ishtirokida amalga oshirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PQ-157-son qarori, 15.04.2024)
abs: Qaror OTB ning 240 mln AQSh dollarlik krediti hisobidan 13 hududda jami 841 km ichki yo‘llarni sement-beton qoplama bilan qurish loyihasini tasdiqlaydi; loyihaning umumiy qiymati taxminan 304,9 mln dollar. Amalga oshirish muddati 2024–2032 yillar bo‘lib, 4 yil qurilish va undan keyingi 5 yil pudratchilar tomonidan saqlash nazarda tutilgan. Ijrochi — Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasi va «Avtoyo‘linvest» agentligi; yo‘l bo‘ylab 2,5 mln ko‘chat ekish ham belgilangan. Havola rus tilidagi rasmiy matnga olib boradi.

title: Islom taraqqiyot banki va OPEK xalqaro taraqqiyot jamg‘armasi ishtirokida «M39 «Olmaota — Bishkek — Toshkent — Shahrisabz — Termiz» avtomobil yo‘lining 1255 — 1315 km (60 km) qismini rekonstruksiya qilish» loyihasini amalga oshirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (PQ-158, 15.04.2024)
abs: Qaror M39 yo‘lining Qashqadaryo viloyatidagi 60 km qismini rekonstruksiya qilish loyihasini tasdiqlaydi: umumiy qiymati 195,5 mln dollar, shundan IsTB krediti 106,7 mln va OPEK jamg‘armasi krediti 47,2 mln dollar. Loyiha 2024–2029 yillarda (2 yillik kafolat davri bilan) amalga oshiriladi, tejalgan mablag‘lar hisobidan umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llarda vazn-gabarit nazorati punktlari qurish ko‘zda tutilgan. Ijrochilar — Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasi va «Avtoyo‘linvest» agentligi.

title: Yo‘llar va yo‘l infratuzilmasini lozim darajada saqlashni ta’minlashning amaldagi mexanizmlarini takomillashtirish hamda hududlarni obodonlashtirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PQ-241-son qarori, 01.07.2024)
abs: Qaror 2024-yil 1-sentabrdan yo‘llar, piyodalar yo‘lkalari va boshqa yo‘l infratuzilmasida qurilish, ta’mirlash yoki qazish ishlarini faqat ruxsatnoma asosida bajarish tartibini joriy etadi; ruxsatnoma Davlat xizmatlari markazlari va Yagona interaktiv portal orqali 5 kunda beriladi. Ruxsatnoma egasi ish joyi xavfsizligi va yo‘lni oldingi holatiga qaytarish uchun javobgar; muddat o‘tgach tiklanmasa, 10 kun ichida javobgarlik choralari ko‘riladi. Hujjatda yo‘l bo‘yi obodonlashtirish tajribasi ham belgilangan. Havola rus tilidagi rasmiy matnga olib boradi.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasining transport-logistika tizimini yanada rivojlantirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PQ-28-son qarori, 27.01.2025)
abs: Qaror va unga ilova qilingan konsepsiya O‘zbekiston transport-logistika tizimini 2030-yilgacha rivojlantirish maqsadlarini belgilaydi. Unda 42 371 km umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘l tarmog‘i, 2 183 km xalqaro va davlat ahamiyatidagi yo‘llarni qurish/rekonstruksiya qilish, ta’mir talab yo‘llar ulushini 24% (2024) dan 15% (2030) ga tushirish va yo‘l bo‘yida 400 ga yaqin zamonaviy servis obyektlari barpo etish rejalashtirilgan. Tranzit yuklar hajmini 13,9 mln tonnadan 22 mln tonnaga oshirish ham maqsad qilingan.

title: Avtomobilda yuk va yo‘lovchilarni xalqaro tashishning ruxsatnoma tizimini tubdan takomillashtirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 114-son qarori, 25.03.2026)
abs: Qaror 2026-yil 1-iyundan xalqaro yo‘nalishda chiqayotgan avtotransportga xorijiy va ko‘ptomonlama ruxsatnomalarni chegara bojxona postlarida berish, ularni axborot tizimida oldindan band qilish va 90 kun ichida qaytarish tartibini joriy etadi. Xitoy, Turkmaniston va Tojikiston bilan elektron ruxsatnoma almashinuvi (e-Permit) yo‘lga qo‘yilishi, tashuvchilarning ishonchlilik reytingi (yuqori 60–100 ball) hamda qoidabuzarlik uchun ruxsatnomalarni 3–12 oyga to‘xtatish belgilangan.

title: «Urganch–Xiva» pulli avtomobil yo‘lidan foydalanish tartibi to‘g‘risidagi vaqtinchalik nizom (Adliya vazirligida 30.09.2026 da 3949-son bilan ro‘yxatga olingan)
abs: Vaqtinchalik nizom O‘zbekistondagi birinchi pulli avtomobil yo‘llaridan biri — «Urganch–Xiva» yo‘lidan foydalanish tartibini belgilaydi: operator yo‘l haqini transport toifasi bo‘yicha Transport vazirligi belgilagan eng yuqori miqdordan oshirmay o‘rnatadi. To‘lov elektron shaxsiy hisob, to‘lov punkti yoki kechiktirilgan to‘lov (to‘siqsiz tizimda 5 ish kuni ichida) orqali amalga oshiriladi; operator bepul muqobil yo‘l haqida ma’lumot e’lon qilishi, yo‘lni saqlashi va yo‘l nuqsonlari tufayli yetkazilgan zararni qoplashi shart. Nizom pulli yo‘llar bo‘yicha hukumat qarori kuchga kirgunga qadar amal qiladi; havola Transport vazirligining rasmiy xabariga olib boradi.

title: Transport vositalari harakatini cheklashning ma’muriy-huquqiy jihatlarini takomillashtirish (yuridik fanlar bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi avtoreferati)
abs: Yuridik fanlar bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi avtoreferati, 12.00.02 – konstitutsiyaviy huquq, ma’muriy huquq, moliya va bojxona huquqi ixtisosligi; ish IIV Akademiyasida bajarilgan. Himoya TDTrU huzuridagi PhD.10/2026.08.05.Yu.01.10 ilmiy kengashida 2026-yil 28-noyabr soat 09:30 ga belgilangan. Ishda YTH, yo‘l ta’miri, favqulodda holatlar va ommaviy tadbirlarda transport harakatini cheklashning huquqiy asoslari, MJtKga yangi moddalar, foto-video qayd qurilmalarini og‘ir YTH ko‘rsatkichlari bo‘yicha joylashtirish va shahar yo‘llarida burilish oraliqlari bilan chorrahalar orasida kamida 50 m masofa bo‘yicha takliflar berilgan.
